paras.en: Emotional Australian engineer Robert Pether speaks after being freed from Iraq
paras.zh: 情绪激动的澳大利亚工程师罗伯特·佩瑟从伊拉克获释后发表讲话

paras.en: RobertPether has stressed his innocence and recalled his brush with death in his first comments since the Australian engineer departed Iraq after serving more than five years in jail.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·佩瑟在这位澳大利亚工程师服刑五年多离开伊拉克后的首次评论中强调了自己的清白，并回忆了自己与死神擦肩而过的经历。

paras.en: Pether and his Egyptian colleague KhalidRadwan were detained in Baghdad in 2021 after flying in for a meeting with bank officials to resolve a dispute with his engineering firm, CME Consulting.
paras.zh: 2021 年，Pether 和他的埃及同事 KhalidRadwan 在巴格达与银行官员开会以解决与其工程公司 CME Con​​sulting 的纠纷后被拘留。

paras.en: Pether was later sentenced and fined over allegations that his firm spent money that should have gone to an architect and a subcontractor.
paras.zh: 佩瑟后来因指控他的公司花费了本应交给建筑师和分包商的钱而被判刑并罚款。

paras.en: Speaking at Dublin airport, Pether said the convictions had not been overturned and neither him nor Radwan had been exonerated.
paras.zh: 佩瑟在都柏林机场发表讲话时表示，定罪尚未被推翻，他和拉德万都没有被证明无罪。

paras.en: We were innocent when we were taken on the 7th of April 2021, and we remain innocent today.
paras.zh: 当我们于 2021 年 4 月 7 日被带走时，我们是无辜的，今天我们仍然是无辜的。

paras.en: I was released from prison hours away from death. My body was shutting down after months of critical illness and excruciating pain, but I remained trapped in Iraq.
paras.zh: 我被释放出狱，距离死亡还有几个小时。经过几个月的重病和剧痛之后，我的身体已经停止运转，但我仍然被困在伊拉克。

paras.en: An emotional Pether also paid tribute to his family, who had spent years campaigning for his freedom – including his wife, Desiree.
paras.zh: 情绪激动的佩特还向他的家人致敬，他们多年来一直为他的自由而奋斗，其中包括他的妻子德西蕾。

paras.en: She is an incredible person, someone that I have so much respect for, and being able to come home was incredible. Just the emotion that it brings is, you can’t describe it. I mean, it’s been years.
paras.zh: 她是一个令人难以置信的人，我非常尊重她，能够回家真是令人难以置信。只是它带来的情感是你无法描述的。我的意思是，已经好几年了。

paras.en: Pether was released from jail last year due to his deteriorating health, but was banned from leaving the country until last week, when an Iraqi court dismissed proceedings against him and lifted the travel ban, citing a lack of evidence.
paras.zh: 佩瑟因健康状况恶化而于去年出狱，但直到上周才被禁止出境，当时伊拉克法院以缺乏证据为由驳回了针对他的诉讼并取消了旅行禁令。

paras.en: He was allowed to board a flight on Monday to Ireland, via Turkey, after painstaking negotiations involving officials in Ireland, Australia, Egypt and Iraq – an international pro bono team at Slaney Advisors.
paras.zh: 经过爱尔兰、澳大利亚、埃及和伊拉克官员（Slaney Advisors 的国际公益团队）的艰苦谈判后，他于周一获准登上经土耳其飞往爱尔兰的航班。

paras.en: ‘I haven’t made any decisions about my future’: Frydenberg
paras.zh: “我还没有对我的未来做出任何决定”：弗莱登伯格

paras.en: Josh Frydenberg says he hasn’t decided whether he will run again for the seat of Kooyong in inner Melbourne which he held for more than a decade and lost in 2022.
paras.zh: 乔什·弗莱登伯格 (Josh Frydenberg) 表示，他尚未决定是否再次竞选墨尔本内城区 Kooyong 选区，他曾担任该选区十多年，并于 2022 年落选。

paras.en: But his language suggests that maybe he’d like to.
paras.zh: 但他的语言表明他也许愿意。

paras.en: Speaking to RN Breakfast, he says Kooyong is still dear to his heart, and that he has maintained close relationships to the voters in his community.
paras.zh: 他在接受 RN Breakfast 采访时表示，Kooyong 仍然是他心中的挚爱，并且他与社区选民保持着密切的关系。

paras.en: We’re mid-term, the next election’s some 18 months away, but I’ll make a decision about my future … I won four elections there and have maintained a very close relationship with many of the local community. So it’s a place near and dear to my heart. It’s a place where my kids are educated. It’s a place where we live today. And it’s no surprise to you or to your listeners, I don’t think it’s as well represented as it needs to be.
paras.zh: 我们正处于中期选举中，距下一次选举大约还有 18 个月的时间，但我将对我的未来做出决定……我在那里赢得了四次选举，并与许多当地社区保持着非常密切的关系。所以这是一个离我心很近、很亲爱的地方。这是我的孩子们接受教育的地方。这是我们今天居住的地方。这对你或你的听众来说并不奇怪，我认为它没有得到应有的充分体现。

paras.en: Frydenberg says it’s seats like his – metropolitan electorates – that the party needs to win back.
paras.zh: 弗莱登伯格表示，该党需要赢回像他这样的大都市选民的席位。

paras.en: He warns the demographics in those areas have changed, and the Liberal party needs to appeal to those newer cohorts.
paras.zh: 他警告说，这些地区的人口结构已经发生了变化，自由党需要吸引这些新群体。

paras.en: It’s more urbanised, it’s younger, it’s more highly educated. And we as a party hold very few of the metropolitan seats which dominate the political landscape in Australia, and that’s what we need to win back as part of a broader strategy to get back to government.
paras.zh: 它更加城市化、更加年轻、受教育程度更高。作为一个政党，我们在澳大利亚政治格局中占据主导地位的大城市席位中所占的席位很少，而这正是我们需要赢回的席位，作为重返政府的更广泛战略的一部分。

paras.en: It’s the “festival of Josh”, as one news presenter described it – Josh Frydenberg’s more than week-long media blitz to promote his new memoir, but is it a distraction?
paras.zh: 正如一位新闻主持人所描述的那样，这是“乔什的节日”——乔什·弗莱登伯格为宣传他的新回忆录而进行了为期一周多的媒体闪电战，但这会分散注意力吗？

paras.en: “No,” says Nationals leader Matt Canavan, promising that he values the former Liberal treasurer’s contributions to the public debate – including calling for GST to be raised.
paras.zh: “不，”国家党领袖马特·卡纳万 (Matt Canavan) 说，并承诺他重视这位前自由党财长对公共辩论的贡献，包括呼吁提高商品及服务税。

paras.en: Frydenberg has left the door open to a political return, and told 60 Minutes on Sunday he wouldn’t yet close the door on his ambition to one day lead the nation.
paras.zh: 弗莱登伯格为政治回归敞开了大门，并在周日接受《60 分钟》节目采访时表示，他还不会关闭自己有一天领导国家的雄心壮志。

paras.en: But one unnamed Liberal told Nine Newspapers that Frydenberg needed to “piss or get off the pot”. Asked about the remarks, Canavan laughed drily and told News24:
paras.zh: 但一位不愿透露姓名的自由党人士告诉九号报纸，弗莱登伯格需要“撒尿或摆脱困境”。当被问及这些言论时，卡纳万冷笑着告诉 News24：

paras.en: No, everyone loves Josh. Look, he’s a great guy, Josh, and I welcome contributions to the policy debate … So look, it’s I don’t find it a distraction at all. I think it’s a contribution.
paras.zh: 不，每个人都喜欢乔希。看，他是一个很棒的人，乔什，我欢迎对政策辩论做出贡献……所以看，我根本不觉得这会分散注意力。我认为这是一种贡献。

paras.en: The eSafety commission says it “does not have powers to proactively prevent” the livestreaming of a US military execution, but says it will monitor and enforce existing standards that could obligate online platforms to block it themselves.
paras.zh: 电子安全委员会表示，它“没有权力主动阻止”美国军事处决的直播，但表示将监控和执行现有标准，这些标准可能会迫使在线平台自行阻止。

paras.en: The government yesterday said the looming execution of Nidal Hasan should not be shown to Australians, noting that platforms had a “responsibility” not to show it.
paras.zh: 政府昨天表示，不应向澳大利亚人展示尼达尔·哈桑即将被处决的情况，并指出平台有“责任”不向其展示。

paras.en: In a statement overnight, an eSafety commission spokesperson said it would monitor the situation.
paras.zh: 电子安全委员会发言人在隔夜的一份声明中表示，将密切关注事态发展。

paras.en: While eSafety does not have powers to proactively prevent a livestream from occurring online, online services have responsibilities under Australia’s online safety regulatory framework to protect users from harmful material.
paras.zh: 虽然 eSafety 无权主动阻止在线直播，但根据澳大利亚在线安全监管框架，在线服务有责任保护用户免受有害材料的侵害。

paras.en: As the regulator responsible for enforcing these obligations eSafety is in regular contact with online platforms and will continue to monitor the situation, considering any action as appropriate.
paras.zh: 作为负责执行这些义务的监管机构，eSafety 会定期与在线平台联系，并将继续监控情况，考虑采取适当的行动。

paras.en: Labor cabinet minister Murray Watt says a planned livestreamed execution in the US would be extremely distressing for the public, but won’t commit to legislative change to prevent Australians being able to watch it.
paras.zh: 工党内阁部长默里·瓦特表示，计划在美国直播执行死刑将使公众极其痛苦，但他不会承诺修改立法以阻止澳大利亚人观看现场直播。

paras.en: The eSafety commissioner, Julie Inman-Grant has said she does not have powers to “proactively prevent” the stream on 3 December.
paras.zh: eSafety 专员 Julie Inman-Grant 表示，她无权“主动阻止”12 月 3 日的直播。

paras.en: Watt tells ABC News Breakfast the government is trying to take “as much action as we can” to deal with rapidly evolving technology – like the digital duty of care bill which would force tech platforms to protect users against harmful content.
paras.zh: 瓦特告诉美国广播公司新闻早餐会，政府正在努力采取“尽可能多的行动”来应对快速发展的技术，例如数字谨慎责任法案，该法案将迫使技术平台保护用户免受有害内容的侵害。

paras.en: I just find the idea of a public streaming of a firing squad execution absolutely disgusting. When I first heard that was being proposed, I couldn’t believe that it was real. I think all Australians would agree that this is a very distressing thing to have publicised …
paras.zh: 我只是觉得公开直播行刑队处决的想法绝对令人恶心。当我第一次听说有人提出这个建议时，我简直不敢相信这是真的。我想所有澳大利亚人都会同意，这是一件非常令人痛苦的事情……

paras.en: We’ve seen now that the eSafety commissioner has said they don’t have those powers. I wouldn’t want to commit to any legislative change at this point in time, but what I do think it shows is this rapidly evolving situation that we’ve got with technology, which is why our government is trying to take as much action as we can, as quickly as we can.”
paras.zh: 我们现在看到电子安全专员表示他们没有这些权力。我不想在这个时候承诺任何立法变革，但我确实认为这表明了我们在技术方面所面临的快速发展的情况，这就是为什么我们的政府试图尽快采取尽可能多的行动。”

paras.en: Greens say big tech has been ‘laughing all the way to the bank’ and ‘we need proper regulations’
paras.zh: 绿党表示，大型科技公司一直在“一路笑到银行”，“我们需要适当的监管”

paras.en: Sarah Hanson-Young is leading the Greens’ negotiations with the government over legislation designed to hold tech companies responsible for preventing harm to Australians, in particular children. The legislation is expected to be tabled in parliament this week.
paras.zh: 莎拉·汉森-杨（Sarah Hanson-Young）正在领导绿党与政府就旨在让科技公司负责防止对澳大利亚人（尤其是儿童）造成伤害的立法进行谈判。该立法预计将于本周提交议会。

paras.en: Hanson-Young, the Greens’ manager of business in the Senate, said the party would wait to see the details of the legislation before deciding whether to support it. But the senator said the Greens supported the imperative, telling the ABC’s 7:30 program that big tech companies had been “running amok for far too long and we want laws that will actually hold them to account”.
paras.zh: 绿党在参议院的业务经理汉森-杨表示，该党将等待看到该立法的细节，然后再决定是否支持该法案。但这位参议员表示，绿党支持这一迫切要求，并在美国广播公司 (ABC) 的 7:30 节目中表示，大型科技公司“疯狂运行了太久了，我们希望制定法律真正让他们承担责任”。

paras.en: Putting in place a duty of care on these big tech platforms is something that’s well and truly overdue.
paras.zh: 在这些大型科技平台上落实谨慎义务确实是早就应该的了。

paras.en: And these big tech companies, social media platforms have been getting away with profiting off content that has been harmful, of technologies that have been designed to be deliberately addictive, even though they know the harm that that can do.
paras.zh: 这些大型科技公司、社交媒体平台一直在从有害内容和旨在故意让人上瘾的技术中获利，尽管他们知道这可能造成的危害。

paras.en: And they’ve just been laughing all the way to the bank. We need proper regulations on these tech companies.
paras.zh: 他们一直笑着到银行。我们需要对这些科技公司进行适当的监管。

paras.en: Good morning, Krishani Dhanji here with you, thanks to Martin Farrer for getting us started.
paras.zh: 早上好，Krishani Dhanji 和你在一起，感谢 Martin Farrer 让我们开始。

paras.en: The government is touting pay rises for health, disability and community service workers, while former Liberal treasurer Josh Frydenberg is continuing his media blitz today to promote his new memoir and keep everyone asking “will he or won’t he” return to parliament.
paras.zh: 政府正在大力宣传卫生、残疾人和社区服务人员的加薪，而前自由党财务主管乔什·弗莱登伯格(Josh Frydenberg)今天继续进行媒体闪电战，宣传他的新回忆录，让每个人都在问“他是否会”重返议会。

paras.en: I’ve got my coffee, I hope you’ve got yours – let’s get cracking!
paras.zh: 我有我的咖啡，希望你也有你的——让我们开始吧！

paras.en: Australia sending tanks, weapons, infantry and ammunition to Ukraine has put Greens politicians at odds.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚向乌克兰派遣坦克、武器、步兵和弹药让绿党政客产生了分歧。

paras.en: Sarah Hanson-Young on Monday said she supported giving Kyiv military aid if that’s what was needed, contradicting her party’s freshly minted leader DavidShoebridge during his first sitting week in the top job, who has said Greens policy is not to provide military support – only humanitarian.
paras.zh: 莎拉·汉森-杨周一表示，如果需要的话，她支持向基辅提供军事援助，这与该党新任领导人戴维·舒布里奇(David Shoebridge)在就任最高职位的第一周期间表示矛盾，后者表示绿党的政策不是提供军事支持，而是提供人道主义支持。

paras.en: “If that’s the support that people need in order to defend themselves from the invasion of Russia, I think Australians need to support that,” Hanson-Young told ABC’s 7.30.
paras.zh: 汉森-杨告诉美国广播公司 7.30 频道：“如果这是人们需要的支持，以抵御俄罗斯的入侵，我认为澳大利亚人需要支持。”

paras.en: We always come from a position of wanting to de-escalate military violence … we want to see humanitarian support, we want to see diplomatic support, but of course you can’t allow people to be left fending for themselves.
paras.zh: 我们的立场始终是希望降低军事暴力……我们希望看到人道主义支持，我们希望看到外交支持，但当然不能允许人们自生自灭。

paras.en: Charities and not-for-profit organisations will receive a $630m funding boost from the federal government after the Fair Work Commission awarded pay rises for health, disability and community services workers.
paras.zh: 在公平工作委员会批准健康、残疾和社区服务工作者加薪后，慈善机构和非营利组织将从联邦政府获得 6.3 亿美元的资金支持。

paras.en: The government said the funding would go to 128,000 charities and not-for-profit organisations across 92 government programs to cover the wage rises that seek to address historic undervaluing in female-dominated sectors.
paras.zh: 政府表示，这笔资金将捐给 92 个政府项目中的 128,000 个慈善机构和非营利组织，以支付工资上涨的费用，以解决女性主导行业历史上被低估的问题。

paras.en: The finance minister and minister for women, Katy Gallagher, said:
paras.zh: 财政部长兼妇女事务部长凯蒂·加拉格尔 (Katy Gallagher) 表示：

paras.en: We cannot close the gender pay gap without ... addressing the historic undervaluation of work performed predominantly by women.
paras.zh: 如果不解决历史上对主要由女性从事的工作的低估问题，我们就无法缩小性别工资差距。

paras.en: Australia’s gender pay gap is at a record low, and this is another significant step towards ensuring women are properly recognised and rewarded for their contribution.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚的性别工资差距创历史新低，这是确保女性的贡献得到适当认可和奖励的又一重要步骤。

paras.en: This move is also a clear signal to the community that this workforce and the support they provide our community is important and valued.
paras.zh: 此举也向社区发出了一个明确的信号，即这些劳动力及其为我们的社区提供的支持是重要且有价值的。

paras.en: Good morning and welcome to our live news blog. I’m Martin Farrer with the top overnight stories and then it’ll be Krishani Dhanji with the main action.
paras.zh: 早上好，欢迎来到我们的实时新闻博客。我是马丁·法雷尔（Martin Farrer），负责隔夜热门报道，然后由克里沙尼·丹吉（Krishani Dhanji）负责主要动作。

articles.title: Pupil arrested after two teachers shot at French school

paras.en: A pupil has been arrested after a principal and teacher were shot at a school in southern France on Monday morning.
paras.zh: 周一早上，法国南部一所学校校长和老师遭到枪击，一名学生被捕。

paras.en: The 14-year-old entered Lakanal middle school in Aubagne "with a shotgun inside a guitar case", regional officials told French media. He then opened fire before being restrained by a member of staff.
paras.zh: 当地官员告诉法国媒体，这名 14 岁的男孩进入了欧巴涅的拉卡纳尔中学，“吉他盒里装着一把猎枪”。然后他开枪，然后被一名工作人员制止。

paras.en: No children were harmed and the teachers were treated for injuries which are not life-threatening, according to Aubagne Mayor Jean-Pierre Squillari.
paras.zh: 欧巴涅市长让-皮埃尔·斯奎拉里 (Jean-Pierre Squillari) 表示，没有儿童受伤，教师也接受了治疗，没有生命危险。

paras.en: The Marseille prosecutor's office said it had opened an investigation for attempted murder.
paras.zh: 马赛检察官办公室表示，已对谋杀未遂展开调查。

paras.en: Local media reported that the incident was not thought to be related to ongoing protests over school conditions, citing police sources.
paras.zh: 当地媒体援引警方消息人士的话报道称，该事件被认为与正在进行的针对学校条件的抗议活动无关。

paras.en: It was reported in French media that the suspect's father was also taken into custody after weapons were found during a search of the family home. French Interior Minister Laurent Nunez later confirmed that both parents had been taken into custody.
paras.zh: 据法国媒体报道，嫌疑人的父亲在搜查其家中发现武器后也被拘留。法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯后来证实，父母均已被拘留。

paras.en: The pupil entered the school in Aubagne - a small city 11 miles east of Marseille - with a gun before several shots were heard, Bouches-du-RhÃ´ne departmental council president Martine Vassal told reporters.
paras.zh: 罗讷河口省议会主席马蒂娜·瓦萨尔告诉记者，这名学生持枪进入位于马赛以东 11 英里的小城市欧巴涅的学校，随后听到几声枪响。

paras.en: The head teacher, 53, was reportedly shot in the leg and lower back, while the 37-year-old teacher's thigh was hit. A third person is said to have sustained minor injuries.
paras.zh: 据报道，53 岁的班主任腿部和腰部中弹，37 岁的教师大腿中弹。据称，第三人受轻伤。

paras.en: Marseille prosecutor Nicolas Bessone said the 14-year-old injured the head and the other teacher on the first floor.
paras.zh: 马赛检察官尼古拉斯·贝索内 (Nicolas Bessone) 表示，这名 14 岁少年的头部和一楼的另一名老师受伤。

paras.en: He then went to the second floor and fired twice, "first in front of a teacher towards the floor, and a second time inside an occupied classroom, hitting the chalkboard", Bessone said.
paras.zh: 然后他到二楼开了两次枪，“第一次是在老师面前朝地板开枪，第二次是在一间有人的教室里，击中黑板”，贝松说。

paras.en: "Neither [that] teacher nor the students were injured, though they were severely shaken."
paras.zh: “虽然老师和学生都受到了严重的震动，但他们都没有受伤。”

paras.en: The boy was restrained by a member of staff in a school corridor, according to the city hall, and taken into police custody.
paras.zh: 据市政府称，这名男孩在学校走廊被一名工作人员制服，并被警方拘留。

paras.en: "All students were immediately confined and made safe within seconds," Squillari, speaking in his role as city mayor, said in an update on social media. A psychological support unit was set up on site to provide emergency support.
paras.zh: 斯奎拉里以市长的身份在社交媒体上发布的最新消息中表示：“所有学生立即被限制，几秒钟内就安全了。”现场设立了心理支持小组，提供紧急支持。

paras.en: Squillari also spoke to reporters and said: "The kids saw practically nothing since it happened in the hallway.
paras.zh: 斯奎拉里还对记者表示：“自从事件发生在走廊以来，孩子们几乎什么也没看到。

paras.en: "Psychologically, quite a few were affected, and those in a distressed state are being examined by the psychologist".
paras.zh: “从心理上来说，相当多的人受到了影响，那些处于痛苦状态的人正在接受心理学家的检查”。

paras.en: He said the suspect was a child "just like any other".
paras.zh: 他说，嫌疑人是一个“和其他孩子一样”的孩子。

paras.en: "The father had requested a meeting with the school's educational advisor, but we don't know any more than that," he told BFMTV.
paras.zh: “父亲要求与学校的教育顾问会面，但我们不知道更多，”他告诉 BFMTV。

paras.en: Two pupils told BFMTV a fire alarm sounded and when they went outside to take the stairs they were told not to go down, but they then came face-to-face with the alleged shooter.
paras.zh: 两名学生告诉 BFMTV，火警警报响起，当他们出去走楼梯时，他们被告知不要下去，但随后他们与据称的枪手面对面。

paras.en: One of them explained: "He was a metre away, with his hunting rifle. He fired at the ground."
paras.zh: 其中一人解释说：“他在一米开外，拿着猎枪。他向地面开枪。”

paras.en: "We started to run away, but he followed us for a while. We started screaming."
paras.zh: “我们开始逃跑，但他跟着我们一段时间。我们开始尖叫。”

paras.en: The school will be closed to pupils on Tuesday, Interior Minister Laurent NuÃ±ez told reporters as he visited the scene with Education Minister Ãdouard Geffray.
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯 (Laurent Nuñez) 与教育部长杜阿尔·格弗雷 (杜阿尔·格弗雷) 一起视察现场时告诉记者，学校将于周二对学生关闭。

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron extended his "full solidarity and total support" to the teachers, students and parents in shock.
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙向震惊的师生和家长表示“全力声援和全力支持”。

paras.en: "I salute the composure and exemplary response of the educational team, which made it possible to avoid the worst," he wrote on social media.
paras.zh: 他在社交媒体上写道：“我向教育团队的冷静和模范反应致敬，这使得避免最坏的情况成为可能。”

paras.en: Geffray wrote on social media: "This unacceptable act is yet further evidence of the rise of unchecked violence in our society, against which we must all take a stand."
paras.zh: 格弗雷在社交媒体上写道：“这种不可接受的行为进一步证明了我们社会中不受控制的暴力行为的增加，我们所有人都必须表明立场反对这种行为。”

articles.title: Qantas flight grounded after bedbug outbreak

paras.en: A Qantas flight from Italy to Australia was cancelled on Saturday, after an outbreak of bedbugs on the plane.
paras.zh: 周六，澳洲航空一架从意大利飞往澳大利亚的航班因飞机上爆发臭虫而被取消。

paras.en: During the previous flight on Friday - a nearly 17-hour journey from Perth to Rome - some passengers had complained that they were being bitten by bugs, according to the Sydney Morning Herald.
paras.zh: 据《悉尼先驱晨报》报道，在周五的上一趟航班中——从珀斯飞往罗马近 17 小时的旅程——一些乘客抱怨他们被虫子咬了。

paras.en: They were reportedly given antihistamines to help ease the itch of the bites, but supplies ran out.
paras.zh: 据报道，他们服用了抗组胺药来缓解叮咬处的瘙痒，但抗组胺药已经用完。

paras.en: The Boeing 787 Dreamliner had to be grounded for "a deep clean", a Qantas spokesperson told the BBC.
paras.zh: 澳洲航空发言人告诉 BBC，波音 787 梦想飞机必须停飞进行“深度清洁”。

paras.en: "We sincerely apologise to customers for the cancellation of Saturday's Rome to Perth service, which allowed our engineers and maintenance teams to carry out a deep clean of the aircraft after an issue was identified on a small number of economy seats," the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示：“我们对周六罗马至珀斯航班的取消向乘客表示诚挚的歉意，在少数经济舱座位出现问题后，我们的工程师和维护团队得以对飞机进行了深度清洁。”

paras.en: All affected customers were provided with accommodation and were rebooked on alternative flights within 48 hours of their original departure, the carrier said.
paras.zh: 该航空公司表示，所有受影响的乘客均在原定出发后 48 小时内获得了住宿并重新预订了替代航班。

paras.en: Bedbugs are small, wingless parasites that can live on clothes, furniture and bedding. Their bites can be itchy but they do not usually cause more serious health problems, the NHS website says, external.
paras.zh: 臭虫是一种无翅的小型寄生虫，可以生活在衣服、家具和床上用品上。英国国民医疗服务体系（NHS）网站称，它们的叮咬可能会很痒，但通常不会引起更严重的健康问题。

paras.en: But they can be difficult and expensive to get rid of. Treatment includes washing all bedding, clothing, and household materials like curtains on a hot wash and tumble dry, or they can be put in plastic bags in a freezer for three or four days.
paras.zh: 但摆脱它们可能很困难且成本高昂。治疗方法包括用热水清洗所有床上用品、衣服和家居用品（例如窗帘）并滚筒烘干，或者将它们放入塑料袋中，在冰箱中保存三到四天。

paras.en: Bedbugs causing travel chaos is not unusual - less than two weeks ago, several Southeastern train services in England were cancelled after drivers discovered the creepy-crawlies in their cabs.
paras.zh: 臭虫造成旅行混乱的情况并不罕见——不到两周前，英国东南部的几趟火车服务因司机在出租车里发现令人毛骨悚然的爬虫而被取消。

paras.en: In 2017, British Airways apologised to a family travelling from Vancouver to London, after they were left covered in bug bites from an overnight flight.
paras.zh: 2017 年，英国航空公司向一个从温哥华飞往伦敦的家庭道歉，因为他们在夜间飞行中被虫子咬伤。

paras.en: And Turkish Airlines faced with a PR nightmare last year after the New York Times reported, external of several instances of bedbug infestations on its planes - and allegations at the time that the airline did nothing about it.
paras.zh: 去年，《纽约时报》报道土耳其航空公司飞机上发生数起臭虫出没事件后，土耳其航空公司面临着一场公关噩梦，而且当时还指控该航空公司对此无所作为。

articles.title: Analysis: Trump's global headaches worsen weeks before crucial elections

paras.en: With elections that will decide control of Congress just weeks away and American voters already casting ballots in some battlegrounds, President Donald Trump has turned his eyes overseas â and to Russia, in particular - for help tackling one of his most pressing problems.
paras.zh: 距离决定国会控制权的选举仅剩几周时间，美国选民已经在一些战场上投票，唐纳德·特朗普总统已将目光转向海外，尤其是俄罗斯，寻求帮助解决他最紧迫的问题之一。

paras.en: World affairs seldom provide easy answers, however, and developments elsewhere have threatened to undermine his efforts to bring down fuel prices before they provide any political benefit.
paras.zh: 然而，世界事务很少能提供简单的答案，而其他地方的事态发展则可能会破坏他为降低燃油价格而做出的任何政治利益之前的努力。

paras.en: A whirlwind weekend started on Friday afternoon, as Trump announced a new deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin that would provide the US with hundreds of millions of tons of Russian diesel fuel in the coming months.
paras.zh: 周五下午，旋风般的周末开始了，特朗普宣布与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京达成一项新协议，该协议将在未来几个月内向美国提供数亿吨俄罗斯柴油。

paras.en: High energy prices, particularly for midwestern agricultural states that rely on diesel to power farm machinery and carry their goods to market, have been a growing source of frustration for American voters.
paras.zh: 高能源价格，特别是对于依赖柴油为农业机械提供动力并将其产品运往市场的中西部农业州来说，已经成为美国选民日益不满的一个根源。

paras.en: Polls suggest they view the Iran War as the leading cause for their woes, and overall support for Trump, and approval of his handling of the war and the US economy in particular, has dropped precipitously.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，他们认为伊朗战争是造成他们困境的主要原因，而对特朗普的总体支持率，尤其是对他处理战争和美国经济的支持率急剧下降。

paras.en: Trump heralded his Russian deal in a Truth Social post as bringing "lower prices for Americans," while he ordered his Treasury Department to suspend US restrictions that prevented Russian diesel from being sold on global markets.
paras.zh: 特朗普在《真相社会》帖子中宣称他的俄罗斯协议将“为美国人带来更低的价格”，同时他下令财政部暂停美国阻止俄罗斯柴油在全球市场上销售的限制。

paras.en: Two days later, Trump was back on his social media website, touting a new energy ceasefire agreement between Russia and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 两天后，特朗普回到他的社交媒体网站，宣传俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的新能源停火协议。

paras.en: The truth, however, was more complicated.
paras.zh: 然而，事实要复杂得多。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he had no advanced notice of the agreement, although he said his nation would abide by it. Russia, for its part, was silent. And on Sunday night, it launched a new wave of attacks on Ukrainian power plants.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，他没有提前收到该协议的通知，但他表示乌克兰将遵守该协议。俄罗斯则保持沉默。周日晚上，它对乌克兰发电厂发起了新一波攻击。

paras.en: "It's clear that Putin does not read Truth Social," Zelensky noted wryly on Monday. He added: "This winter, if Russia does not agree to an energy ceasefire, we will respond."
paras.zh: “很明显，普京不读《社会真相》，”泽伦斯基周一挖苦地指出。他补充道：“今年冬天，如果俄罗斯不同意能源停火，我们将作出回应。”

paras.en: Trump and Zelensky have had a tumultuous relationship throughout his second term. The American president alternates between blaming Russia and Ukraine for the continuing conflict he previously said would be easy to end once he returned to the White House.
paras.zh: 特朗普和泽连斯基在他的第二个任期内关系一直不稳定。这位美国总统时而将持续的冲突归咎于俄罗斯和乌克兰，他此前曾表示，一旦回到白宫，冲突就会很容易结束。

paras.en: In recent days, Zelensky has been the primary target of Trump's ire, as Ukraine's strikes on Russian oil infrastructure have contributed to worldwide energy shortages.
paras.zh: 最近几天，泽伦斯基一直是特朗普愤怒的主要目标，因为乌克兰对俄罗斯石油基础设施的袭击导致了全球能源短缺。

paras.en: On Saturday, Trump told reporters at the White House that it was time for Ukraine to get a new president. And both the Financial Times, external and CNN, external have reported that the US has threatened to cut off arms sales and intelligence sharing with Ukraine if Zelensky does not halt attacks on Russian refineries. Zelensky "better damn well stop," Trump said.
paras.zh: 周六，特朗普在白宫告诉记者，乌克兰是时候选出新总统了。英国《金融时报》（外部）和美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）外部均报道称，如果泽连斯基不停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击，美国威胁将切断与乌克兰的武器销售和情报共享。特朗普说，泽连斯基“最好停下来”。

paras.en: "I think that the president has a decade long public record of lashing out of people who aren't doing what he wants, when and how he wants to do it," Terry Haines, founder of independent think-tank Pangaea Policy, told the BBC.
paras.zh: 独立智囊团盘古大陆政策创始人特里·海恩斯对英国广播公司表示：“我认为，总统有长达十年的公开记录，他会猛烈抨击那些没有按照他想要的时间、方式做事的人。”

paras.en: It now appears Trump's celebration of the "energy truce" may have been a familiar move for this president, touting an agreement before it had been sealed and delivered. In the past, for instance, he has prematurely announced Middle East ceasefires and sweeping peace agreements.
paras.zh: 现在看来，特朗普庆祝“能源休战”对于这位总统来说可能是一个熟悉的举动，在协议签署和交付之前就大肆宣扬协议。例如，过去他曾过早宣布中东停火和全面和平协议。

paras.en: Whether it is impatience on the president's part with the slow pace of diplomacy or a savvy negotiating tactic to push a deal across the finish line, the result has been to set off a scramble as the world decides what it means â and how to react.
paras.zh: 无论是总统对缓慢的外交步伐感到不耐烦，还是精明的谈判策略推动协议冲过终点线，结果都是在世界决定协议的含义以及如何反应时引发了一场混乱。

paras.en: Those reactions didn't take long to arrive.
paras.zh: 这些反应很快就出现了。

paras.en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, who has become a vocal critic of the president's on the international stage, offered "strong support" for the energy ceasefire, but condemned the diesel deal as undermining peace and stability in Europe and helping Russia to finance its "illegal, unjustifiable war against Ukraine".
paras.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼在国际舞台上直言不讳地批评总统的政策，他对能源停火表示“强烈支持”，但谴责柴油协议破坏了欧洲的和平与稳定，并帮助俄罗斯为其“针对乌克兰的非法、不合理的战争”提供资金。

paras.en: In the US, Trump's diesel announcement prompted similar concern, even among members of his own party. Four Republican senators joined with Democrats in a letter calling on the president to "immediately reverse course".
paras.zh: 在美国，特朗普的柴油公告引发了类似的担忧，甚至在他自己的政党成员中也是如此。四名共和党参议员与民主党一起写信，呼吁总统“立即改变方针”。

paras.en: "Congress explicitly banned Russian energy imports in 2022 to prevent American dollars from financing Putin's brutal war against Ukraine," the senators wrote in a statement released on Sunday. "President Trump's decision to allow Russian diesel imports to the US runs directly counter to that law."
paras.zh: 参议员们在周日发布的一份声明中写道：“国会明确禁止在 2022 年进口俄罗斯能源，以防止美元资助普京对乌克兰的残酷战争。” “特朗普总统允许俄罗斯柴油进口到美国的决定直接违反了该法律。”

paras.en: What could be worse for the president than the criticisms is that the announced ceasefire has had little effect on the price of diesel, which continues to sit below its record highs but still well above $6 a gallon.
paras.zh: 对总统来说，比批评更糟糕的是，宣布的停火对柴油价格几乎没有影响，柴油价格继续低于历史高点，但仍远高于每加仑 6 美元。

paras.en: Meanwhile, as the latest twists in the Russia-Ukraine conflict unfolded, new violence in the Middle East threaten to further strain global energy markets, regardless of what happens with Russian oil.
paras.zh: 与此同时，随着俄罗斯-乌克兰冲突的最新进展，无论俄罗斯石油情况如何，中东新的暴力事件都有可能进一步加剧全球能源市场的压力。

paras.en: A wave of Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including strikes on airports and energy infrastructure that killed at least 13 over the weekend, have threatened to escalate a decade-long conflict that had been simmering throughout the US-Iran war.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯发动了一波袭击，包括周末对机场和能源基础设施的袭击，造成至少 13 人死亡，这有可能使美伊战争期间持续十年的冲突升级。

paras.en: "This is the Houthis sending a message that it's not just military targets, it's not just energy infrastructure, they're going to strike at civilian airports that could kill a lot of people," Michael Ratney, former US ambassador to Saudi Arabia, told the BBC.
paras.zh: 美国前驻沙特阿拉伯大使迈克尔·拉特尼 (Michael Ratney) 告诉 BBC：“胡塞武装发出的信息是，他们攻击的不仅仅是军事目标，也不仅仅是能源基础设施，他们还将袭击民用机场，造成多人死亡。”

paras.en: The US-Iran war was a conflict that none of the Arab nations in the region wanted, he said, and the latest Houthi offensive was a foreseeable result. With the US and Iran currently in an extended stand-off, any new hostilities could lead to more regional conflict and send oil prices soaring once more.
paras.zh: 他说，美伊战争是该地区所有阿拉伯国家都不希望发生的冲突，胡塞武装最新的攻势也是可以预见的结果。由于美国和伊朗目前处于长期对峙状态，任何新的敌对行动都可能导致更多地区冲突，并导致油价再次飙升。

paras.en: "I do think it gets uglier before it really deescalates," he said.
paras.zh: “我确实认为，在事态真正降级之前，事情会变得更加丑陋，”他说。

paras.en: In recent weeks, Trump has pointed to Ukraine, not the Middle East, as the primary source of the world's energy woes. He cites increased oil tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, which had been effectively shut by Iran's military threat.
paras.zh: 最近几周，特朗普指出乌克兰，而不是中东，是世界能源危机的主要根源。他列举了霍尔木兹海峡的油轮运输量增加的情况，该海峡实际上因伊朗的军事威胁而被封锁。

paras.en: That may, however, be wishful thinking â an attempt to convince the American public to direct their energy-related anger toward a conflict that began under a different president's watch.
paras.zh: 然而，这可能是一厢情愿的想法——试图说服美国公众将他们与能源相关的愤怒转向在另一位总统的监督下开始的冲突。

paras.en: There is only one president at a time, however. And when American voters casts their ballots they tend to hold those who are currently in power responsible.
paras.zh: 然而，一次只有一位总统。当美国选民投票时，他们倾向于让现任掌权者负责。

paras.en: After a rough weekend that again proved there are no easy fixes to the global energy crisis, that may be the worst news of all for the US president.
paras.zh: 在经历了一个艰难的周末之后，再次证明全球能源危机没有简单的解决办法，这对美国总统来说可能是最糟糕的消息。

articles.title: 'Freakish' discovery of 9 million-year-old capybara tooth supports idea that Atacama wasn't always a desert
articles.author: Damien Pine

paras.en: Researchers have discovered a roughly 9 million year old tooth belonging to a large, water-loving relative of modern day capybaras in the Atacama Desert of northern Chile. The fossilized molar adds to previous evidence suggesting that it's unlikely the Atacama, one of the driest places on Earth, was continuously dry for the last 40 million years.
paras.zh: 研究人员在智利北部阿塔卡马沙漠发现了一颗大约 900 万年前的牙齿，属于现代水豚的大型喜水近亲。这颗臼齿化石进一步证明，地球上最干旱的地方之一阿塔卡马不太可能在过去 4000 万年里持续干旱。

paras.en: The Atacama Desert, possibly the oldest desert on Earth, takes up the northern third of Chile. It's bounded by the Chilean Coast Range to the west, which blocks rain from the Pacific Ocean, and the enormous Andes to the east, which obstruct rain from the Atlantic Ocean. The driest part of the desert's hyperarid region gets less than 0.08 inches (2 mm) of rainfall a month.
paras.zh: 阿塔卡马沙漠可能是地球上最古老的沙漠，占据了智利北部的三分之一。它西边是智利海岸山脉，阻挡了来自太平洋的降雨，东边是巨大的安第斯山脉，阻挡了来自大西洋的降雨。沙漠极度干旱地区最干燥的地区每月降雨量不到 0.08 英寸（2 毫米）。

paras.en: Recent research estimates the Atacama's hyperarid core started forming between 47.8 million and 33.9 million years ago, in the Mid- to Late-Eocene, 20 million years before the Andes formed. It suggests the mountain ranges weren't the cause for the desert's aridification, and may have only intensified it.
paras.zh: 最近的研究估计，阿塔卡马的超级干旱核心开始形成于 4780 万年前至 3390 万年前，即始新世中晚期，比安第斯山脉形成早 2000 万年。这表明山脉并不是沙漠干旱化的原因，而且可能只会加剧干旱化。

paras.en: Capybaras (Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris) — the world's largest rodent — exclusively live close to stable freshwater sources and feed on plants that also require water to grow, so the discovery of an extinct capybara relative (Hydrochoerus Cardiatherium) tooth in the Atacama Desert is very strange.
paras.zh: 水豚 (Hydrochoerus Hydrochaeris) 是世界上最大的啮齿动物，它们专门生活在稳定的淡水源附近，以也需要水才能生长的植物为食，因此在阿塔卡马沙漠中发现已灭绝的水豚近亲 (Hydrochoerus Cardiatherium) 牙齿是非常奇怪的。

paras.en: "Finding a capybara tooth in a marine deposit in what today is one of the driest regions on Earth is just freakish," Priscilla Martinez, a geoscientist at the University of Arizona and co-author of a new paper describing the discovery, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 亚利桑那大学地球科学家、描述这一发现的新论文的合著者普里西拉·马丁内斯在一份声明中说：“在当今地球上最干旱的地区之一的海洋沉积物中发现水豚牙齿真是太奇怪了。”

paras.en: Capybaras are native to South America, although today, they are not found in Chile, where the tooth was unearthed, according to the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).
paras.zh: 据国际自然保护联盟 (IUCN) 称，水豚原产于南美洲，但如今在出土水豚牙齿的智利却找不到它们的踪迹。

paras.en: The tooth isn't the only clue that the Atacama was a wetter place in the late Miocene. Researchers found it in a layer holding the remains of a shallow marine environment that existed between 7 million and 10 million years ago, according to the statement. And they've also found microscopic pieces of plants, known as phytoliths, revealing that palm trees, grasses, gingers and other flowering plants grew there in what may have been a subtropical forest.
paras.zh: 这颗牙齿并不是证明阿塔卡马地区在中新世晚期是一个湿润地区的唯一线索。声明称，研究人员在 700 万至 1000 万年前存在的浅海环境遗迹层中发现了它。他们还发现了被称为植硅体的植物微观碎片，表明棕榈树、草、生姜和其他开花植物生长在可能是亚热带森林的地方。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: These findings and others are part of a growing body of evidence that the Atacama Desert was once wet enough for crocodiles and freshwater fish to thrive and palms to grow. The new study, published Sept. 5 in the journal Scientific Reports, shows that capybara relatives lived there as well during the late Miocene, which, because they are semiaquatic animals, is further evidence to support the hypothesis of a sporadically moist Atacama.
paras.zh: 这些发现和其他发现是越来越多证据的一部分，表明阿塔卡马沙漠曾经足够潮湿，适合鳄鱼和淡水鱼繁衍生息，也适合棕榈树生长。 9 月 5 日发表在《科学报告》杂志上的这项新研究表明，在中新世晚期，水豚的亲戚也生活在那里，因为它们是半水生动物，这进一步证明了阿塔卡马地区存在零星湿润的假说。

paras.en: The researchers aren't sure how exactly capybaras moved into the Atacama Desert. Although there were capybaras in South America at the time, the Andes created an 18,000-foot-high (5,500 meters) barrier between their current habitats and the site where the tooth was found. The researchers theorized that, instead of traversing the mountains, the ancient capybaras migrated along the western coast of South America, following wetlands, rivers and other water sources.
paras.zh: 研究人员不确定水豚究竟是如何进入阿塔卡马沙漠的。尽管当时南美洲也有水豚，但安第斯山脉在它们目前的栖息地和发现水豚牙齿的地点之间形成了一道 18,000 英尺高（5,500 米）的屏障。研究人员推测，古代水豚并没有穿越山脉，而是沿着湿地、河流和其他水源沿着南美洲西海岸迁徙。

paras.en: According to Samantha Hopkins, an Earth sciences professor at the University of Oregon who was not involved in the study, it's unlikely the tooth found its way to the site without capybaras living there.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈大学地球科学教授萨曼莎·霍普金斯（Samantha Hopkins）没有参与这项研究，她表示，如果没有水豚生活在那里，这颗牙齿不太可能到达该地点。

paras.en: "If you wanted to find a way that this capybara could be here while the Atacama was still as dry as it is today, you'd have a hard row to hoe," she told Live Science in an email, because the size of the tooth makes it hard to transport it long distances. The desert wind couldn't have blown it such a long way, and while large carcasses can float down waterways for miles, "if you're going to invoke a large enough waterway to do this, you've demonstrated that the Atacama wasn't as dry as it is today anyway."
paras.zh: 她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“如果你想找到一种方法，在阿塔卡马仍然像今天这样干燥的时候，让这只水豚出现在这里，你将很难锄地，”她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，因为牙齿的大小使其很难长距离运输。沙漠风不可能把它吹这么远，虽然大型尸体可以沿着水道漂浮数英里，“如果你要调用足够大的水道来做到这一点，你就已经证明了阿塔卡马河无论如何也不像今天那么干燥。”

paras.en: Gutstein, C. S., Martinez, P. R., Carrapa, B., Clementz, M. T., Cherem, J. J., Cozzuol, M. A., Strömberg, C. a. E., Suárez, M. E., Chavarría, C. C., & Roux, J. P. L. (2026). Late Miocene capybara in the Atacama Desert reveals a wetter climate and a transcontinental dispersal pathway. Scientific Reports. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-67368-2
paras.zh: Gutstein, C. S.、Martinez, P. R.、Carrapa, B.、Clementz, M. T.、Cherem, J. J.、Cozzuol, M. A.、Strömberg, C. a. E.、Suárez, M. E.、Chavarría, C. C. 和 Roux, J. P. L. (2026)。阿塔卡马沙漠中中新世晚期的水豚揭示了更湿润的气候和跨大陆的扩散途径。科学报告。 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-67368-2

paras.en: Damien Pine (he/him) is a freelance writer, artist, and former NASA engineer. He writes about science, physics, tech, art, and other topics with a focus on making complicated ideas accessible. He has a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Connecticut, and he gets really excited every time he sees a cat.
paras.zh: 达米恩·派恩（Damien Pine）（他/他）是一位自由作家、艺术家和前美国宇航局工程师。他撰写的文章涉及科学、物理、技术、艺术和其他主题，重点是让复杂的想法变得容易理解。他拥有康涅狄格大学机械工程学位，每次看到猫他都会非常兴奋。

articles.title: Big dogs age faster at an epigenetic level, new study finds
articles.author: RJ Mackenzie

paras.en: Great Danes and mastiffs rarely live more than a decade, while Chihuahuas can live twice as long. Exactly why big dogs die younger than small ones do has been unclear — but new findings may help to solve that mystery.
paras.zh: 大丹犬和獒犬的寿命很少超过十年，而吉娃娃犬的寿命可以是其两倍。究竟为什么大型犬比小型犬更早死亡尚不清楚，但新的发现可能有助于解开这个谜团。

paras.en: The research, published Thursday (Oct. 8) in the journal Science, looked at a chemical code written on top of dogs' DNA. This code, called the methylome, consists of chemical tags called methyl groups, which bind to DNA's building blocks.
paras.zh: 这项研究于周四（10 月 8 日）发表在《科学》杂志上，研究了写在狗 DNA 上的化学密码。这种代码称为甲基化组，由称为甲基的化学标签组成，这些标签与 DNA 的构建模块结合。

paras.en: Proteins constantly access DNA, loading up the information written in its code and taking that data away to be turned into new proteins for the cell. But these methyl groups can act as tiny roadblocks that stop that process in its tracks.
paras.zh: 蛋白质不断地访问 DNA，加载其代码中写入的信息，并将这些数据转化为细胞的新蛋白质。但这些甲基可以充当微小的障碍，阻止这一过程的进行。

paras.en: These groups are one type of "epigenetic marker," which collectively help to control gene activity, and their arrangement on DNA changes predictably as animals age, study co-author Blaise Mariner, a bioinformatician at Arizona State University, told Live Science. Across many studies and species, including humans, scientists have used this data to build epigenetic clocks that track animals' biological ages.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、亚利桑那州立大学生物信息学家布莱斯·马里纳 (Blaise Mariner) 告诉《Live Science》，这些群体是“表观遗传标记”的一种，它们共同帮助控制基因活性，并且随着动物年龄的增长，它们在 DNA 上的排列会发生可预测的变化。在包括人类在内的许多研究和物种中，科学家们利用这些数据建立了表观遗传时钟来跟踪动物的生物年龄。

paras.en: Dogs happen to be a great species for studying aging. Their owners devotedly track what they eat, how they live, and how their health changes over time. So Mariner and his colleagues built epigenetic clocks using DNA in blood samples taken from 894 dogs enrolled in the long-term Dog Aging Project based at the University of Washington.
paras.zh: 狗恰好是研究衰老的绝佳物种。它们的主人会专门追踪它们的饮食、生活方式以及健康状况随时间的变化。因此，Mariner 和他的同事利用来自华盛顿大学长期狗衰老项目的 894 只狗的血液样本中的 DNA 构建了表观遗传时钟。

paras.en: These samples revealed how the dogs' immune cells aged. These cells patrol the whole body, so "they're a really good measure of systemic aging," study co-author Noah Snyder-Mackler, a genomicist at Arizona State University, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 这些样本揭示了狗的免疫细胞如何老化。这些细胞在整个身体中巡逻，因此“它们是衡量系统衰老的一个非常好的指标”，该研究的合著者、亚利桑那州立大学的基因组学家诺亚·斯奈德-麦克勒（Noah Snyder-Mackler）告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: The team found that changes in DNA methylation closely tracked biological aging, in that the dogs with older-than-expected epigenetic ages had a higher risk of death from any cause. Once they looked at how different sizes of dogs aged, clear differences emerged.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，DNA甲基化的变化与生物衰老密切相关，表观遗传年龄大于预期的狗因任何原因死亡的风险更高。一旦他们观察了不同体型的狗的衰老情况，就会发现明显的差异。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Using our biomarker, this epigenetic clock, big dogs were aging a little bit faster per year of life than small dogs," Snyder-Mackler said.
paras.zh: 斯奈德-麦克勒说：“使用我们的生物标记物，即表观遗传时钟，大型犬的每年衰老速度比小型犬要快一些。”

paras.en: A key epigenetic change linked to larger body size was the loss of methyl groups at stretches of DNA called transposable elements. Also called "jumping genes," these elements can potentially move around the genome, but the methyl groups help stop them from doing so. But when that methylation is lost, the jumping genes can become too active and end up damaging other genes and causing inflammation, a key process that ramps up with age.
paras.zh: 与体型变大相关的一个关键表观遗传变化是称为转座元件的 DNA 片段中甲基基团的丢失。这些元素也被称为“跳跃基因”，可能会在基因组中移动，但甲基有助于阻止它们这样做。但当甲基化丢失时，跳跃基因可能会变得过于活跃，最终会损害其他基因并引起炎症，这是一个随着年龄增长而加剧的关键过程。

paras.en: In short, the new data suggests that out-of-control jumping genes may contribute to big dogs' faster aging.
paras.zh: 简而言之，新数据表明，失控的跳跃基因可能导致大型犬更快衰老。

paras.en: In aging dogs, the team found that some regions of the genome with few chemical tags became more methylated, while other areas that had been choked with methyl groups gradually lost them. Additionally, at least in terms of their epigenetics, dogs' immune cells appear to become more similar to one another as they age. Mariner said this "loss of cell identity" is a key hypothesis for what happens to the body as it ages.
paras.zh: 在衰老的狗中，研究小组发现基因组中一些化学标签很少的区域变得更加甲基化，而其他被甲基基团堵塞的区域则逐渐失去它们。此外，至少在表观遗传学方面，随着年龄的增长，狗的免疫细胞似乎变得更加相似。马里纳说，这种“细胞身份的丧失”是身体随着年龄增长而发生变化的一个关键假设。

paras.en: Immune cells are carefully specialized for different roles, such as preventing cancer or killing viruses. As these cells become more similar to one another, they become less able to fulfill their specialized roles, studies suggest.
paras.zh: 免疫细胞经过精心设计，具有不同的作用，例如预防癌症或杀死病毒。研究表明，随着这些细胞彼此变得更加相似，它们履行其特殊职责的能力就会降低。

paras.en: Humans have bred big dogs for size, and Snyder-Mackler said this push for large body size may have come at a cost.
paras.zh: 人类培育大型犬是为了体型较大，斯奈德-麦克勒表示，这种对体型较大的追求可能是有代价的。

paras.en: "Their bodies have to make this trade-off between really rapid growth and maintenance of that," he said, "versus investment in the immune system and integrity of the organism." For now, that idea is a hypothesis, though, as the current study doesn't directly address why big dogs' epigenetic aging has come to be this way.
paras.zh: “他们的身体必须在真正的快速生长和维持快速生长之间做出权衡，”他说，“与对免疫系统和有机体完整性的投资。”不过，目前这个想法还只是一个假设，因为目前的研究并没有直接解释为什么大型犬的表观遗传衰老会变成这样。

paras.en: Now, the team wants to build more informative clocks as the Dog Aging Project recruits more pooches to follow for longer periods. Snyder-Mackler said the team's data currently explains only part of how dogs' epigenetic ages vary. "What we really want to know is, what explains the rest of that variation?" he said.
paras.zh: 现在，随着狗老化项目招募更多的狗来进行更长时间的跟踪，该团队希望建立更多信息的时钟。斯奈德-麦克勒表示，该团队的数据目前只能部分解释狗的表观遗传年龄如何变化。 “我们真正想知道的是，如何解释其余的变异？”他说。

paras.en: The team was keen to build predictive models that might help dog owners anticipate their pets' age-related health concerns, Snyder-Mackler added.
paras.zh: 斯奈德-麦克勒补充说，该团队热衷于建立预测模型，帮助狗主人预测宠物与年龄相关的健康问题。

paras.en: What we learn about dogs from these studies may help us understand human aging, too. That's partly because dogs get some of the same diseases we do, but it's chiefly because they share humans' living spaces and environments.
paras.zh: 我们从这些研究中了解到的关于狗的知识也可能有助于我们了解人类的衰老。部分原因是狗会患上一些与我们相同的疾病，但主要是因为它们与人类共享生活空间和环境。

paras.en: "We're going to start looking, at the molecular level, [at] how these environmental exposures or experiences impact health and aging in dogs, which is going to be directly translatable to humans who are living in those same exact environments," Snyder-Mackler said.
paras.zh: 斯奈德-麦克勒说：“我们将开始在分子水平上研究这些环境暴露或经历如何影响狗的健康和衰老，这将直接适用于生活在同样环境中的人类。”

paras.en: "Most people love dogs," he added. "That means we can get a lot of really good data on them."
paras.zh: “大多数人都喜欢狗，”他补充道。 “这意味着我们可以获得很多关于它们的非常好的数据。”

paras.en: RJ Mackenzie is an award-nominated science and health journalist. He has degrees in neuroscience from the University of Edinburgh and the University of Cambridge. He became a writer after deciding that the best way of contributing to science would be from behind a keyboard rather than a lab bench. He has reported on everything from brain-interface technology to shape-shifting materials science, and from the rise of predatory conferencing to the importance of newborn-screening programs. He is a former staff writer of Technology Networks.
paras.zh: RJ Mackenzie 是一位荣获奖项提名的科学与健康记者。他拥有爱丁堡大学和剑桥大学的神经科学学位。在决定为科学做出贡献的最佳方式是在键盘后面而不是在实验室工作台后面后，他成为了一名作家。他报道了从大脑接口技术到变形材料科学，从掠夺性会议的兴起到新生儿筛查计划的重要性等各个方面。他是《科技网络》的前特约撰稿人。

articles.title: 'It could have been a very different history': Researchers are finally starting to pin down how many Indigenous people were living in the Americas when Columbus arrived
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: When Christopher Columbus made landfall in the Americas on Oct. 12, 1492, he encountered Indigenous Lucayans living on the Bahamian island now called San Salvador. Columbus wrote in his diary about "great multitudes of men" who greeted him that day, bartered with him and told him about other groups who lived on nearby islands.
paras.zh: 1492 年 10 月 12 日，克里斯托弗·哥伦布 (Christopher Columbus) 在美洲登陆时，遇到了居住在巴哈马岛屿（现称为圣萨尔瓦多）上的土著卢卡亚人。哥伦布在日记中写道，那天有“大量的人”向他致意，与他进行物物交换，并告诉他居住在附近岛屿上的其他群体的情况。

paras.en: But within a few decades after Columbus' arrival, the Indigenous people of the Americas were decimated by what anthropologist Eric Wolf called the "Great Dying" — a combination of epidemic disease, warfare and enslavement that led to a rapid decline in the Native population.
paras.zh: 但在哥伦布抵达后的几十年内，美洲原住民遭受了人类学家埃里克·沃尔夫所说的“大灭绝”的摧残——流行病、战争和奴役的结合导致了原住民人口的迅速下降。

paras.en: For centuries, researchers have been trying to figure out how many Indigenous people lived in the Americas just prior to the fateful arrival of European colonizers.
paras.zh: 几个世纪以来，研究人员一直试图弄清楚在欧洲殖民者到来之前有多少原住民生活在美洲。

paras.en: The answer to that question has been surprisingly elusive, and estimates based on historical censuses, archaeological sites and land carrying capacity in the Western Hemisphere have varied wildly.
paras.zh: 这个问题的答案令人惊讶地难以捉摸，而且基于历史人口普查、考古遗址和西半球土地承载能力的估计差异很大。

paras.en: Recent research into Native American demography has revealed that the population peaked several centuries before Europeans showed up on the shores of North America — and that if Europeans had arrived at that peak, the entire history of the continent may have been different.
paras.zh: 最近对美洲原住民人口统计的研究表明，人口在欧洲人出现在北美海岸之前几个世纪达到顶峰，如果欧洲人到达那个顶峰，整个大陆的历史可能会有所不同。

paras.en: Early estimates of the Indigenous population
paras.zh: 原住民人口的早期估计

paras.en: People have lived in the Americas for at least 14,000 years, having entered the continents via the region around the Bering Strait. Archaeological evidence shows these first Americans dispersed throughout the newly encountered lands fairly quickly. But what happened to the population between that dispersal and the arrival of Columbus is a huge unknown; estimates of the number of Indigenous people living in the Western Hemisphere in 1492 have ranged from 1 million to 112 million people.
paras.zh: 人们在美洲生活了至少 14,000 年，通过白令海峡周围地区进入大陆。考古证据表明，这些第一批美国人很快就分散到了新发现的土地上。但从这次分散到哥伦布到来之间，人口发生了什么仍然是一个巨大的未知数。据估计，1492 年居住在西半球的原住民人数为 100 万至 1.12 亿。

paras.en: "We don't have good quantitative estimates," George Milner, an anthropologist at Penn State, told Live Science. "The numbers are all over the place."
paras.zh: “我们没有很好的定量估计，”宾夕法尼亚州立大学的人类学家乔治·米尔纳告诉《生活科学》。 “数字到处都是。”

paras.en: One of the first modern researchers who attempted to quantify the Indigenous population prior to Columbus was anthropologist Henry Dobyns. In a 1983 book, Dobyns used estimates of how many people each type of landscape could support as well as historical records of 16th-century disease epidemics to arrive at an Indigenous population estimate of around 112 million people — more than 100 times larger than some previous experts had believed.
paras.zh: 在哥伦布之前，最早尝试量化土著人口的现代研究人员之一是人类学家亨利·多宾斯。在 1983 年的一本书中，多宾斯使用了每种类型的景观可以容纳多少人口的估计以及 16 世纪疾病流行的历史记录，得出了大约 1.12 亿人的土著人口估计——比一些以前的专家认为的要多 100 倍以上。

paras.en: "In essence, Dobyns filled up the landscape to its maximum carrying capacity, so that all environmentally similar places were occupied by the same number of people," Milner said. "He also made the assumption that epidemic disease spread widely and universally, which would make sense if the landscape was filled up."
paras.zh: 米尔纳说：“本质上，多宾斯将景观填满到其最大承载能力，以便所有环境相似的地方都被相同数量的人占据。” “他还假设流行病广泛且普遍地传播，如果景观被填满的话，这是有道理的。”

paras.en: But a burst of archaeological research in the 1970s and 1980s revealed that the Americas were not uniformly settled, Milner said. Dobyns' estimates were therefore much too high.
paras.zh: 但米尔纳说，20 世纪 70 年代和 80 年代的一系列考古研究表明，美洲并没有统一的定居点。因此，多宾斯的估计太高了。

paras.en: Researchers then began to focus on creating population estimates for specific regions of the hemisphere, using techniques such as the relative density of pottery sherds at a site, the number of stone tools and flakes, the number and size of houses, and mortality trends from human skeletons.
paras.zh: 然后，研究人员开始专注于对半球特定区域的人口进行估计，使用的技术包括某个地点陶片的相对密度、石器和石片的数量、房屋的数量和大小以及人类骨骼的死亡率趋势。

paras.en: In a 2019 study, geographers compiled 129 population estimates from 82 published studies to model the hemisphere-wide distribution of the Indigenous population in 1492. The researchers split the hemisphere into seven regions — the Caribbean, Mexico, Central America, Inca territory, Amazonia, North America and the rest of the Americas — and reached a combined estimate of 60.5 million. Their estimate for North America (modern-day Canada and the U.S.) was about 3 million to 6 million, less than one-third of Dobyns' estimate of 18 million.
paras.zh: 在 2019 年的一项研究中，地理学家从 82 项已发表的研究中汇总了 129 项人口估计数，以模拟 1492 年原住民人口在半球的分布情况。研究人员将半球分为七个区域——加勒比海、墨西哥、中美洲、印加领土、亚马逊流域、北美和美洲其他地区——并得出总计 6050 万人口的估计值。他们对北美（现在的加拿大和美国）的估计约为 300 万至 600 万，不到多宾斯估计的 1800 万的三分之一。

paras.en: The 2019 study found that the most populous groups in the Western Hemisphere in 1492 were the Aztecs, largely in modern-day Mexico; and the Inca, who lived along the west coast of South America.
paras.zh: 2019 年的研究发现，1492 年西半球人口最多的群体是阿兹特克人，主要分布在今天的墨西哥；以及居住在南美洲西海岸的印加人。

paras.en: But the people we know the most about from an archaeological standpoint are Indigenous groups in the U.S. and Canada.
paras.zh: 但从考古学的角度来看，我们最了解的人是美国和加拿大的土著群体。

paras.en: In a 2010 study, Milner and geographer George Chaplin zoomed in on the data from eastern North America, compiling historic group sizes and sizes of archaeological occupation areas to estimate the location and size of "population aggregates." Using this method, their overall estimate for the eastern U.S. and southeastern Canada was about 1.6 million people.
paras.zh: 在 2010 年的一项研究中，米尔纳和地理学家乔治·卓别林放大了北美东部的数据，编制了历史群体规模和考古占领区的规模，以估计“人口总量”的位置和规模。使用这种方法，他们对美国东部和加拿大东南部的总体估计人口约为 160 万人。

paras.en: "Our mean estimates," Milner and Chaplin wrote, "indicate that North America held roughly 2.8 to 5.7 million people" or a "best estimate" of 3.8 million people in the early 16th century, before European diseases dramatically decreased the size of the Indigenous population.
paras.zh: 米尔纳和卓别林写道，“我们的平均估计表明，在欧洲疾病导致原住民人口规模大幅减少之前，16 世纪初，北美大约有 2.8 至 570 万人”，或者“最佳估计”为 380 万人。

paras.en: "If you want to start estimating specific populations, you should use measures that work across regions," Robert Kelly, an archaeologist at the University of Wyoming, told Live Science. "People produce things that can be carbon-dated everywhere, because everyone had to build fires for heat and for cooking."
paras.zh: 怀俄明大学的考古学家罗伯特·凯利告诉《生活科学》杂志：“如果你想开始估计特定的人口，你应该使用跨地区有效的措施。” “人们生产的东西可以在任何地方进行碳测年，因为每个人都必须生火取暖和做饭。”

paras.en: Charcoal from hearths is one of the main human-made things that archaeologists use to radiocarbon-date a site. The radiocarbon data provides a range of dates showing when the firewood was likeliest to have been used.
paras.zh: 壁炉中的木炭是考古学家用来对遗址进行放射性碳测年的主要人造物品之一。放射性碳数据提供了一系列日期，显示木柴最有可能被使用的时间。

paras.en: In North America, many of those carbon-14 dates from charcoal, as well as from animal bones and plant remains from archaeological sites, have been entered into the Canadian Archaeological Radiocarbon Database (CARD).
paras.zh: 在北美，许多来自木炭以及考古遗址的动物骨骼和植物遗骸的碳 14 年代已被输入加拿大考古放射性碳数据库 (CARD)。

paras.en: In a 2009 study, Matthew Peros, a geographer at Bishop's University in Quebec, and co-authors mathematically combined the radiocarbon date ranges in CARD to generate a single curve that revealed how common C-14 dates were over time. At the time, CARD had about 25,000 records.
paras.zh: 在 2009 年的一项研究中，魁北克主教大学的地理学家 Matthew Peros 和合著者以数学方式组合了 CARD 中的放射性碳日期范围，生成了一条曲线，揭示了 C-14 日期随时间变化的常见程度。当时，CARD 拥有大约 25,000 条记录。

paras.en: Because time periods with more people most likely produced more material that could be carbon-dated, the shape of the radiocarbon date curve gave the team an idea of when the population of North America increased and decreased.
paras.zh: 由于人口越多的时间段很可能产生更多可进行碳测年的物质，放射性碳测年曲线的形状让研究小组了解了北美人口何时增加和减少。

paras.en: They found that the population of North America increased rapidly around 50 B.C. and peaked around A.D. 1150. From that time until European contact, the Indigenous population may have been declining, possibly because of increased mortality from diseases like tuberculosis as people aggregated into denser settlements.
paras.zh: 他们发现北美人口在公元前 50 年左右迅速增加。并在公元 1150 年左右达到顶峰。从那时起直到欧洲人接触，土著人口可能一直在下降，这可能是因为随着人们聚集到更密集的定居点，结核病等疾病的死亡率增加。

paras.en: "The 1150 date was an interesting finding that also surprised us," Peros told Live Science. "I had assumed it would be more like 1500 just following the arrival of the Europeans."
paras.zh: “1150 年是一个有趣的发现，也让我们感到惊讶，”佩罗斯告诉《Live Science》。 “我原以为欧洲人到来后，数量会增加到 1500 左右。”

paras.en: In a 2025 study, Kelly and co-authors found a similar temporal peak. By that time, CARD's dataset had ballooned to over 100,000 dates, making the estimate more robust.
paras.zh: 在 2025 年的一项研究中，凯利和合著者发现了类似的时间峰值。到那时，CARD 的数据集已激增至超过 100,000 个日期，使得估计更加可靠。

paras.en: "Although devastated by European contact, the Indigenous population did not simply increase to a peak at 1500 CE and then decline," the researchers wrote in the study. In fact, they found evidence for a slight recovery in population numbers just prior to 1500.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究报告中写道：“尽管受到欧洲人接触的破坏，土著人口并没有简单地在公元 1500 年达到顶峰，然后下降。”事实上，他们发现了 1500 年前人口数量略有回升的证据。

paras.en: But how large was that population? By combining the radiocarbon date curve with a starting population and factoring in average annual population growth, researchers can estimate the number of people living in North America around 1492, Peros said.
paras.zh: 但这个人口有多少？佩罗斯说，通过将放射性碳测年曲线与起始人口相结合，并考虑到年平均人口增长因素，研究人员可以估计 1492 年左右生活在北美的人口数量。

paras.en: In their study, Peros and co-authors assumed that a handful of extended families — around 1,000 people — entered North America about 15,000 years ago as the founder population. With those inputs, the researchers estimated that the maximum population of North America was about 2.5 million in 1150 and had declined to about 1.8 million in 1492. But if people arrived significantly earlier than 15,000 years ago — which might be the case, given evidence from sites like White Sands in New Mexico, which dates to 23,000 years ago — or arrived in greater numbers, those population figures would be even higher.
paras.zh: 在他们的研究中，佩罗斯和合著者假设少数大家庭（大约 1,000 人）在大约 15,000 年前作为创始人人口进入北美。根据这些数据，研究人员估计，1150 年北美人口最多约为 250 万，到 1492 年已下降至约 180 万。但如果人们到达的时间明显早于 15,000 年前（新墨西哥州白沙遗址的证据可追溯到 23,000 年前，情况可能就是这样），或者到达的人数更多，那么人口数字会更高。

paras.en: "Had Europeans tried settling the continent at A.D. 1000, they would have run into a much, much larger Indigenous population," Kelly said. At that time, the city of Cahokia, near modern-day St. Louis, encompassed 6 square miles (16 square kilometers) and had a population of nearly 20,000 people.
paras.zh: 凯利说：“如果欧洲人在公元 1000 年试图在这片大陆定居，他们就会遇到数量大得多的土著人口。”当时，卡霍基亚市靠近现代的圣路易斯，面积 6 平方英里（16 平方公里），人口近 20,000 人。

paras.en: "They could have fielded thousands of warriors, and it would have been a very different experience for the Europeans," Kelly said. "It could have been a very different history."
paras.zh: 凯利说：“他们本可以派出数千名战士，这对欧洲人来说将是一次非常不同的经历。” “这可能是一段非常不同的历史。”

paras.en: - 13,000-year-old butchered bones of long-tusked beast found in Chile give more evidence of early first Americans
paras.zh: - 在智利发现的 13,000 年前被屠宰的长牙兽骨头为早期第一批美洲人提供了更多证据

paras.en: - Ancient DNA reveals mysterious Indigenous lineage that lived in Argentina for nearly 8,500 years — but rarely interacted with others
paras.zh: - 古代 DNA 揭示了在阿根廷生活了近 8,500 年但很少与他人互动的神秘土著血统

paras.en: - Ancient Indigenous lineage of Blackfoot Confederacy goes back 18,000 years to last ice age, DNA reveals
paras.zh: - DNA 揭示，黑脚邦联的古代土著血统可以追溯到 18,000 年前的最后一个冰河时代

paras.en: Experts told Live Science that the pre-1492 population of what is now the U.S. and Canada was between 2 million and 4 million. The archaeological deep dive in this region sets up the possibility that a full Western Hemisphere population estimate may be made someday.
paras.zh: 专家告诉《Live Science》，1492 年之前，现在的美国和加拿大人口在 200 万到 400 万之间。该地区的考古深入研究奠定了有一天可能对西半球人口进行全面估计的可能性。

paras.en: Milner is optimistic they'll eventually get there. "Will it be done in my lifetime? Probably not," he said. "It's time-consuming, laborious and not especially flashy work to do."
paras.zh: 米尔纳乐观地认为他们最终会实现这一目标。 “这会在我有生之年完成吗？可能不会，”他说。 “这是一项耗时、费力、而且不是特别华而不实的工作。”

paras.en: Nonetheless, demography is important work, he said, because it can help us make estimates to prepare for the future.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，他说，人口统计学仍然是重要的工作，因为它可以帮助我们做出估计，为未来做好准备。

paras.en: "The world's population has more than doubled in my lifetime; that's unheard of in human existence," Milner said. "Environmental scientists are really trying to look at what's happened over long periods of time to give us a range of variation of what might happen in the future. We have to make some informed decisions about how to manage our landscape and accommodate these changes."
paras.zh: 米尔纳说：“在我一生中，世界人口增加了一倍多；这在人类存在中是闻所未闻的。” “环境科学家确实在努力研究长时间内发生的情况，以便为我们提供未来可能发生的一系列变化。我们必须就如何管理我们的景观和适应这些变化做出一些明智的决定。”

paras.en: Understanding the number of Indigenous inhabitants in the Western Hemisphere in 1492 is also key to understanding the history of North America.
paras.zh: 了解 1492 年西半球土著居民的数量也是了解北美历史的关键。

paras.en: "North America was not an empty continent when the Europeans arrived," Peros said. "There were people and civilizations pretty much everywhere in the Americas for a long period of time. It is important for people to understand that when we talk about questions of reconciliation and when we do land acknowledgements."
paras.zh: “当欧洲人到达时，北美并不是一片空旷的大陆，”佩罗斯说。 “很长一段时间以来，美洲几乎到处都有人和文明。当我们谈论和解问题以及当我们进行土地承认时，人们必须理解这一点，这一点很重要。”

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: How much do you know about the first people to reach the Americas? Find out with our First Americans quiz!
paras.zh: 您对第一批到达美洲的人了解多少？通过我们的第一批美国人测验来找出答案！

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Thieves Pulled Off Another Shocking Art Heist in France. This Time, They Took a 330-Pound Bronze Book Cover Designed by Salvador Dalí

paras.en: Another flagrant museum heist has rocked France. On Sunday night or Monday morning, thieves stole an enormous bronze book cover designed by Salvador Dalí from a small contemporary art collection in the town of Issoire in central France.
paras.zh: 另一起明目张胆的博物馆抢劫案震惊了法国。周日晚上或周一早上，窃贼从法国中部伊苏瓦尔镇的一个小型当代艺术收藏品中偷走了萨尔瓦多·达利设计的巨大青铜书籍封面。

paras.en: The cover belongs to a massive book titled Livre de l’Apocalypse. The work was the collective achievement of seven artists and seven writers who, between 1958 and 1961, were recruited by French publisher Joseph Forêt to interpret and illustrate parts of the Book of Revelation, the canonical last book of the New Testament. These leading creatives—including Ossip Zadkine, Léonard Foujita, Jean Cocteau and Jean Giono—contributed 150 scroll-sized pages of text and biblical scenes that took more than 2,000 hours to complete, according to the Telegraph’s Henry Samuel.
paras.zh: 该封面属于一本名为《启示录》的巨著。该作品是七位艺术家和七位作家的集体成就，他们在 1958 年至 1961 年间被法国出版商 Joseph Forêt 招募，负责解释和插图《新约圣经》最后一本书《启示录》的部分内容。据《每日电讯报》的 Henry Samuel 报道，这些顶尖创意人士——包括 Ossip Zadkine、Léonard Foujita、Jean Cocteau 和 Jean Giono——贡献了 150 页卷轴大小的文本和圣经场景，花了 2000 多个小时才完成。

paras.en: Dalí’s cover leaves a fittingly grand first impression. He created it using a now-lost wax casting technique. Featuring a prominent crucifix, it is made from a constellation of materials, including bronze, gemstones, pearls, forks and seashells. Considered the most expensive book in the world at the time of its creation, the work is likewise famed for its enormous heft. It weighs roughly 463 pounds, with the cover alone tipping the scales at 330 pounds.
paras.zh: 达利的封面给人留下了恰如其分的宏伟第一印象。他使用现已失传的蜡铸造技术创造了它。它以突出的十字架为特色，由多种材料制成，包括青铜、宝石、珍珠、叉子和贝壳。该书在创作时被认为是世界上最昂贵的书，同样因其巨大的分量而闻名。它重约 463 磅，仅盖子重达 330 磅。

paras.en: “It is a monumental work, a masterpiece, unique in the world,” Christian Karoutzos, the book’s owner, who runs an art restoration company and contemporary art gallery in Issoire, tells Olivier Vidal and Christelle Marquès of ICI Pays d’Auvergne, a French radio station. “France was murdered last night. French heritage was murdered.”
paras.zh: “这是一部不朽的作品，一部杰作，在世界上独一无二，”这本书的主人克里斯蒂安·卡鲁佐斯（Christian Karoutzos）在伊苏瓦尔经营着一家艺术修复公司和当代艺术画廊，他告诉法国 ICI Pays d’Auvergne 广播电台的奥利维尔·维达尔（Olivier Vidal）和克里斯泰尔·马奎斯（Christelle Marquès）。 “法国昨晚被谋杀了。法国传统被谋杀了。”

paras.en: The book’s cover and several parchments were on display at Karoutzos’ small private contemporary art center when an unknown number of thieves forced their way through an exterior gate and demolished the book’s plexiglass display case. “They arrived like vandals. They smashed everything,” Karoutzos tells La Montagne’s David Allignon.
paras.zh: 这本书的封面和几张羊皮纸正在卡鲁佐斯的小型私人当代艺术中心展出，当时数量不详的窃贼闯入外门，拆毁了这本书的有机玻璃展示柜。 “他们像破坏者一样到来。他们砸碎了一切，”卡鲁佐斯告诉《蒙塔涅报》的大卫·阿利尼翁。

paras.en: Though all of the book’s parchments were left untouched, authorities remain baffled as to how the theft of such a heavy artwork was carried out so seamlessly.
paras.zh: 尽管这本书的所有羊皮纸都没有被碰过，但当局仍然困惑于如何如此天衣无缝地盗窃如此沉重的艺术品。

paras.en: Valued at 2 million francs at the time of its creation—about $408,000 in 1961 dollars and $4.5 million in today’s money—the book is considered priceless by many for its history and cultural significance. Issoire Mayor Bertrand Barraud described it as “the work of a lifetime” and called its loss “incalculable,” according to Euronews’ Christina Molle.
paras.zh: 这本书在创作时价值 200 万法郎（以 1961 年美元计算约为 408,000 美元，以今天的货币计算为 450 万美元），因其历史和文化意义而被许多人认为是无价之宝。据欧洲新闻台的克里斯蒂娜·莫尔报道，伊苏瓦尔市市长伯特兰·巴罗称其为“一生的工作”，并称其损失“无法估量”。

paras.en: “It has significant artistic value in and of itself, far greater than the individual value of each of the objects that make it up,” Jean-Christophe Castelain, editor-in-chief of the Journal des Arts, tells France24 in a translated interview. “What thief would be interested in an object that weighs 210 kilos? I’ll leave that question open.”
paras.zh: 《艺术杂志》主编让-克里斯托夫·卡斯特兰 (Jean-Christophe Castelain) 在翻译后的采访中告诉 France24：“它本身就具有重要的艺术价值，远远大于构成它的每件物品的个体价值。” “哪个小偷会对重 210 公斤的物体感兴趣？我不会回答这个问题。”

paras.en: For more than a decade after its completion in 1961, the book toured nearly 150 exhibitions around the world, including a stop at the French pavilion at the 1964 World’s Fair in Queens, New York.
paras.zh: 该书于 1961 年完成后的十多年来，在世界各地举办了近 150 个展览，其中包括在 1964 年纽约皇后区世界博览会的法国馆停留。

paras.en: “On exhibit will be a huge quarter‐ton volume, L’Apocalypse, a French translation of the Revelation of St. John the Divine,” the New York Times’ Walter Carlson reported at the time. “The volume was insured for $1 million for its trip from France. Admission will be charged to see it.”
paras.zh: “展出的将是一本重达四分之一吨的巨著《启示录》，这是《圣约翰启示录》的法文译本，”《纽约时报》的沃尔特·卡尔森当时报道道。 “该书从法国出发的旅程已投保 100 万美元。观看该作品需付费。”

paras.en: - The Unisphere, a giant stainless steel globe sculpture that was designed by Gilmore D. Clarke for the 1964 World’s Fair, is still visible at Flushing Meadows Corona Park in Queens.
paras.zh: - Unisphere 是一座巨大的不锈钢地球仪雕塑，由吉尔莫·D·克拉克 (Gilmore D. Clarke) 为 1964 年世界博览会设计，如今在皇后区的法拉盛梅多斯可乐娜公园 (Flushing Meadows Corona Park) 中仍然可见。

paras.en: - At its dedication ceremony, New York City planner Robert Moses said the Unisphere was “built to remain as a permanent feature of the park, reminding succeeding generations of a pageant of surpassing interest and significance.”
paras.zh: - 在落成仪式上，纽约市规划师罗伯特·摩西表示，大地球仪“的建造是为了作为公园的永久特色，提醒后代这是一场具有超越意义和意义的盛会。”

paras.en: Karoutzos bought the massive book in 2003 for “several million euros,” as he tells Le Figaro’s Alix Vermande. The tome’s previous owners had intended to divide it up and sell the separate pieces.
paras.zh: 卡鲁佐斯在 2003 年以“几百万欧元”的价格买下了这本巨著，他告诉《费加罗报》的阿利克斯·维芒德 (Alix Vermande)。这本书的前主人打算将其分割并出售单独的部分。

paras.en: The heist is the latest in a series of high-profile art thefts carried out across Europe in the past few months. In September, thieves stole four Pierre-Auguste Renoir paintings worth an estimated $2.5 million from a museum on the French Riviera. In August, 3,000-year-old Bronze Age artifacts were looted from Villena, Spain; that same month, four Renaissance works by Antonello da Messina were taken from a museum in Sicily.
paras.zh: 这起盗窃案是过去几个月欧洲各地发生的一系列备受瞩目的艺术品盗窃案中的最新一起。 9 月，窃贼从法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆偷走了四幅皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿的画作，估计价值 250 万美元。 8 月，西班牙维耶纳 (Villena) 的 3000 年前青铜器时代文物被洗劫一空；同月，安东内罗·达·梅西纳的四件文艺复兴时期作品被从西西里岛的一家博物馆盗走。

articles.title: Flu Season Started Early in Parts of the U.S., and Experts Say You Should Consider Getting the Seasonal Jab ASAP. Here's What to Know

paras.en: Every year, autumn brings gorgeous foliage, crisp air, shorter days—and a slew of respiratory illnesses. Flu season usually starts in October or November, but infection data suggests it has kicked off early in parts of the Northern Hemisphere.
paras.zh: 每年秋天都会带来绚丽的树叶、清新的空气、较短的白天以及一系列呼吸道疾病。流感季节通常在十月或十一月开始，但感染数据显示，在北半球部分地区，流感季节已经提前开始。

paras.en: Flu rates began rising in August or September in many western states, including California, Washington, Alaska and Hawaii. That’s unusual because the respiratory illness typically starts in the Southeast and spreads toward the West Coast. Infection rates have also been unusually early in places like Japan and the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: 在许多西部州，包括加利福尼亚州、华盛顿州、阿拉斯加和夏威夷，流感发病率从八月或九月开始上升。这是不寻常的，因为呼吸道疾病通常始于东南部并向西海岸传播。日本和英国等地的感染率也异常早。

paras.en: We’re “looking at an early flu season this year,” said James Watt, deputy director of infectious diseases at the California Department of Public Health, at a briefing on October 6, reports Catherine Ho at the San Francisco Chronicle.
paras.zh: 据《旧金山纪事报》的凯瑟琳·何 (Catherine Ho) 报道，加州公共卫生部传染病副主任詹姆斯·瓦特 (James Watt) 在 10 月 6 日的新闻发布会上表示，我们“预计今年流感季节会提前”。

paras.en: This early rise is concerning because people haven’t started getting their vaccines yet, says Danielle Zerr, an infectious-diseases specialist at Seattle Children’s, to Lena H. Sun at the Washington Post. “The way flu is circulating now, you wanted that vaccine in you two weeks ago, if not even a little before that.”
paras.zh: 西雅图儿童医院的传染病专家丹妮尔·泽尔 (Danielle Zerr) 向《华盛顿邮报》的莉娜·H·孙 (Lena H. Sun) 表示，这种早期上升令人担忧，因为人们还没有开始接种疫苗。 “按照流感现在的传播方式，你在两周前就需要接种疫苗，甚至更早一点。”

paras.en: Here’s what you need to know about this year’s early flu season.
paras.zh: 以下是您需要了解的有关今年早期流感季节的信息。

paras.en: The flu is caused by an infection with an influenza virus. There are two subtypes of Influenza A—H3N2 and H1N1—and one type of Influenza B, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). The severity of each season depends on which version of the virus is spreading. H3N2 influenza strains are linked to more severe flu seasons and more hospitalizations. This year, the other one, H1N1, is dominating.
paras.zh: 流感是由流感病毒感染引起的。根据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 的数据，甲型流感有两种亚型——H3N2 和 H1N1——以及一种乙型流感。每个季节的严重程度取决于正在传播的病毒版本。 H3N2 流感病毒株与更严重的流感季节和更多的住院治疗有关。今年，另一种 H1N1 流感占据主导地位。

paras.en: Flu spreads via droplets spewed when an infected person coughs, sneezes or talks. Symptoms generally appear one to four days after infection. Signs of illness can include fever or feverish chills, cough, sore throat, runny nose, muscle aches and fatigue. A sick individual is most contagious during their first three days of symptoms.
paras.zh: 流感通过感染者咳嗽、打喷嚏或说话时喷出的飞沫传播。症状通常在感染后一到四天出现。疾病迹象可能包括发烧或发烧发冷、咳嗽、喉咙痛、流鼻涕、肌肉酸痛和疲劳。病人在出现症状的前三天最具传染性。

paras.en: Since 2010, the flu has resulted in between 120,000 and 710,000 hospitalizations and has contributed to between 6,300 and 52,000 deaths each year in the U.S., according to estimates by the CDC.
paras.zh: 据美国疾病预防控制中心估计，自 2010 年以来，流感每年在美国导致 120,000 至 710,000 人住院治疗，并导致 6,300 至 52,000 人死亡。

paras.en: Experts don’t know for sure, but one possibility is that a new variant of H1N1 evolved a mutation that is better at evading some people’s immune systems. “That’s our best argument for what’s going on right now in terms of this early flu season,” says Alex Greninger, a virologist at the University of Washington, to Rob Stein at NPR.
paras.zh: 专家们并不确定，但一种可能性是，H1N1 流感的一种新变种进化出了一种突变，能够更好地逃避某些人的免疫系统。华盛顿大学病毒学家亚历克斯·格雷宁格 (Alex Greninger) 对美国公共广播电台 (NPR) 的罗布·斯坦因 (Rob Stein) 表示：“这是我们对当前流感季节早期所发生情况的最佳论据。”

paras.en: Another reason might be that because H3N2 dominated last year’s flu season, people have less recent immunity against the version that’s currently running rampant, Helen Chu, an infectious-diseases specialist at the University of Washington, tells the Washington Post.
paras.zh: 华盛顿大学传染病专家 Helen Chu 告诉《华盛顿邮报》，另一个原因可能是，由于 H3N2 主导了去年的流感季节，人们最近对目前猖獗的 H3N2 病毒的免疫力较低。

paras.en: It’s still too soon to tell what this year’s season will look like. Looking at the Southern Hemisphere can offer clues, since our seasons are flipped, writes Katelyn Jetelina for Your Local Epidemiologist. “Flu season was severe in many places this summer,” she explains, with Argentina recording its highest number of flu-like illness cases in a decade. That doesn’t necessarily mean things will look the same in the Northern Hemisphere, but it’s something epidemiologists are keeping an eye on.
paras.zh: 现在判断今年的季节会是什么样子还为时过早。凯特琳·杰特琳娜为当地流行病学家写道，观察南半球可以提供线索，因为我们的季节交替。她解释说：“今年夏天，许多地方的流感季节都很严重。”阿根廷的流感样疾病病例数创下十年来最高。这并不一定意味着北半球的情况会一样，但流行病学家正在密切关注。

paras.en: What’s more, “an early start doesn’t necessarily mean a more severe season,” says James Hay, an epidemiologist at the University of Oxford in England, to Nature’s Mariana Lenharo.
paras.zh: 此外，英国牛津大学的流行病学家詹姆斯·海伊 (James Hay) 对《自然》杂志的玛丽安娜·伦哈罗 (Mariana Lenharo) 表示，“提早开始并不一定意味着疫情会更加严重”。

paras.en: Flu vaccines for 2026-27 are already available, and the best thing you can do is get your shot as early as possible—even if you got one last year. The vaccine is adjusted every year to target the strains that researchers predict will be circulating that season. While it’s hard for them to get it exactly right, vaccines still offer an important level of protection that can reduce the severity of the illness.
paras.zh: 2026-27 年流感疫苗已经上市，您能做的最好的事情就是尽早接种疫苗——即使您去年接种过疫苗。该疫苗每年都会进行调整，以针对研究人员预测将在该季节传播的菌株。虽然他们很难做到完全正确，但疫苗仍然提供了重要的保护水平，可以减轻疾病的严重程度。

paras.en: “This is one of those seasons where the key message is to go get vaccinated now,” Greninger tells Nature.
paras.zh: 格雷宁格告诉《自然》杂志：“这是关键信息是立即接种疫苗的季节之一。”

articles.title: Just Inches Below the Forest Floor, Archaeologists in Germany Unearthed a Roman Temple Likely Dedicated to Mars, the God of War

paras.en: Archaeologists in Germany have discovered the remains of a Roman temple that appears to have been dedicated to Mars, the god of war.
paras.zh: 德国考古学家发现了一座罗马神庙的遗迹，这座神庙似乎是供奉战神马尔斯的。

paras.en: The structure was concealed just beneath the forest floor in the foothills of the eastern Taunus Mountains, on the northern outskirts of Frankfurt, according to a September 25 announcement from the Hesse State Office for Monument Preservation.
paras.zh: 根据黑森州纪念碑保护办公室 9 月 25 日的公告，该建筑隐藏在法兰克福北郊陶努斯山脉东部山麓的森林地面下方。

paras.en: The temple is rectangular and measures about 16 feet long. Inside, it appears to have contained a smaller, square chamber with just three roughly 20-inch-thick walls, Thomas Kurella reports for Hessenschau. Archaeologists believe the structure could be an ambulatory temple, with the three-walled central prayer room accessible through a wooden gate or door and surrounded by covered walkways.
paras.zh: 寺庙呈长方形，长约16英尺。托马斯·库雷拉 (Thomas Kurella) 为 Hessenschau 报道称，里面似乎包含一个较小的方形房间，只有三层大约 20 英寸厚的墙壁。考古学家认为，该建筑可能是一座流动寺庙，其三墙中央祈祷室可通过木门或门进入，周围环绕着有盖的走道。

paras.en: Researchers found an inscription suggesting that the temple was dedicated to Mars, according to Live Science’s Kristina Killgrove. They also unearthed a fragment of a statue that may have portrayed the war god. Another statuette likely represents Victoria, the Roman goddess of victory who often appears alongside Mars and was worshipped by the Roman military. The artifact is broken, but it still clearly bears the hallmarks of Victoria: wings, a palm branch and a laurel wreath, per Hessenschau.
paras.zh: 据《Live Science》的克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫称，研究人员发现了一段铭文，表明这座神庙是献给火星的。他们还出土了可能描绘战神的雕像的碎片。另一尊小雕像很可能代表罗马胜利女神维多利亚，她经常与玛尔斯一起出现，并受到罗马军队的崇拜。这件文物已破损，但仍清晰地带有维多利亚的标志：翅膀、棕榈树枝和月桂花环（根据 Hessenschau 的说法）。

paras.en: Archaeologists unearthed this temple during ongoing excavations of the Kapersburg fort—a Roman military fortification thought to date back to the second century C.E.—and its neighboring village, known as a “vicus,” which likely housed the soldiers’ families, merchants and other civilians.
paras.zh: 考古学家在卡珀斯堡堡垒（据认为可以追溯到公元二世纪的罗马军事防御工事）及其邻近的村庄（被称为“vicus”）的持续挖掘过程中发现了这座寺庙，该村庄可能居住着士兵的家人、商人和其他平民。

paras.en: The fort was likely constructed under the reign of Emperor Trajan or Emperor Hadrian, per Live Science. A Roman military unit called the Numerus Nidensium was stationed there for roughly 150 years, until the fort was abandoned in the middle of the third century C.E. The group likely originated in the nearby Roman town of Nida, now the Heddernheim quarter of Frankfurt.
paras.zh: 据《Live Science》报道，这座堡垒很可能是在图拉真皇帝或哈德良皇帝统治时期建造的。一支名为“Numerus Nidensium”的罗马军事单位驻扎在那里大约 150 年，直到公元三世纪中叶该堡垒被废弃。该组织可能起源于附近的罗马城镇奈达，即现在的法兰克福海德海姆区。

paras.en: Researchers believe roughly 160 men were stationed at the fort, while up to 700 people lived in the nearby village, per Hessenschau.
paras.zh: 据 Hessenschau 报道，研究人员认为这座堡垒驻扎了大约 160 人，附近村庄则居住着多达 700 人。

paras.en: The site is part of the Upper Germanic-Rhaetian Limes, which became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2005. This 342-mile stretch, which runs between the Rhine and the Danube rivers, formed part of the Roman Empire’s border, marking not only its military frontier but also the limits of its economic and cultural influence.
paras.zh: 该遗址是上日耳曼-雷蒂亚界线的一部分，于 2005 年成为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。这条 342 英里的河段横跨莱茵河和多瑙河，是罗马帝国边界的一部分，不仅标志着其军事边界，也标志着其经济和文化影响力的界限。

paras.en: Archaeologists have been excavating the fort for decades. However, they recently turned their attention toward the adjacent settlement after drought, pests and a storm cleared away some of the surrounding forest.
paras.zh: 几十年来，考古学家一直在挖掘这座堡垒。然而，由于干旱、害虫和暴风雨摧毁了周围的一些森林，他们最近将注意力转向了邻近的定居点。

paras.en: Because of the site’s location in the wooded foothills, it has remained largely untouched for centuries, leaving well-preserved structures and artifacts just beneath the top layer of soil. Previous excavations have unearthed a Roman votive stone, which is now on view at a museum in nearby Rosbach vor der Höhe.
paras.zh: 由于该遗址位于树木繁茂的山麓，几个世纪以来基本上没有受到任何影响，在土壤表层下留下了保存完好的结构和文物。之前的挖掘工作中出土了一块罗马许愿石，目前在 Rosbach vor der Höhe 附近的一家博物馆展出。

paras.en: This year, in addition to the temple, researchers found the remains of craft activities, including blacksmith pits and baking ovens that may have been used for drying grain, per Live Science. They didn’t find as many houses as they had suspected, suggesting that the site once functioned as an interstitial area between the fort and the settlement.
paras.zh: 据《Live Science》报道，今年，除了寺庙之外，研究人员还发现了手工艺活动的遗迹，包括铁匠坑和可能用于干燥谷物的烤炉。他们没有找到像他们怀疑的那样多的房屋，这表明该地点曾经是堡垒和定居点之间的间隙区域。

paras.en: The Romans held two festivals in honor of Mars each year, one in the spring and one in the fall. He was seen as the protector of not only Rome but also the Roman way of life.
paras.zh: 罗马人每年举行两个节日来纪念火星，一个在春天，一个在秋天。他不仅被视为罗马的保护者，也是罗马生活方式的保护者。

paras.en: Next to the recently excavated temple, a piece of jewelry from a later period indicates that the site continued to see use after the Roman military presence dissipated. The archaeologists are currently deciphering a Latin inscription on another votive stone from within the temple chamber, which may reveal further information, or even the name, of the ancient village near the Kapersburg fort.
paras.zh: 在最近出土的寺庙旁边，一件晚期的珠宝表明，在罗马军事存在消失后，该遗址继续被使用。考古学家目前正在破译神庙室内另一块许愿石上的拉丁文铭文，这可能会揭示卡珀斯堡堡垒附近古村庄的更多信息，甚至名称。

articles.title: California’s Tallest and Most Iconic Trees Are Getting Heatstroke
articles.author: Neel Dhanesha

paras.en: This story originally appeared on Vox and is part of the Climate Desk collaboration.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初出现在 Vox 上，是气候台合作的一部分。

paras.en: A grove of coast redwood trees is a forest of forests. Individual trees can live for thousands of years, and as they grow, their canopies develop mats of soils and ferns, creating something like a second forest floor hundreds of feet above the ground.
paras.zh: 海岸红杉树林是森林中的森林。单棵树可以存活数千年，随着它们的生长，它们的树冠会长出土壤和蕨类植物的垫子，形成距离地面数百英尺的第二层森林地面。

paras.en: These elevated ecosystems are home to creatures like the wandering salamander, which can spend its entire life cycle on top of a single tree, and the marbled murrelet, a seabird whose nesting habits were a mystery until one day in 1974, when a tree-trimmer stumbled upon a nest 150 feet above the ground. Sometimes a stray seed—a sitka spruce or oak or even another redwood—finds its way up a massive redwood and grows into another tree entirely, nestled among the branches of a giant.
paras.zh: 这些高地生态系统是诸如流浪蝾螈和大理石海雀等生物的家园，它们的整个生命周期都在一棵树上度过，而大理石海雀是一种海鸟，其筑巢习惯一直是个谜，直到 1974 年的一天，一名树木修剪工偶然发现了一个离地面 150 英尺高的巢穴。有时，一颗散落的种子——锡卡云杉或橡树，甚至其他红杉——会爬上一棵巨大的红杉，完全长成另一棵树，依偎在巨人的树枝间。

paras.en: For millennia, redwoods have been the anchors of this incredibly stable ecosystem; they can even survive wildfires that devastate other tree species.
