paras.zh: 其中之一是 Tsimdo 运动，以提格里尼亚语命名，大致可翻译为“参与”。

paras.en: "The Tsimdo concept initially surfaced through cross-border peace initiatives involving activists, religious figures, and local communities in the Tigray and Eritrea border villages in 2025," Dr. Jalale Getachew Birru, senior East Africa analyst with the US-based conflict monitor ACLED, told DW.
paras.zh: 美国冲突监测机构 ACLED 东非高级分析师贾拉勒·格塔丘·比鲁 (Jalale Getachew Birru) 博士告诉德国之声：“Tsimdo 概念最初是通过 2025 年提格雷和厄立特里亚边境村庄的活动人士、宗教人士和当地社区参与的跨境和平倡议浮出水面的。”

paras.en: It has since undergone several reconfigurations and now encompasses diverse groups within Ethiopia, mostly defined along ethnic lines and with long-standing grievances against the federal government.
paras.zh: 此后，它经历了几次重组，现在涵盖了埃塞俄比亚境内的不同群体，这些群体大多是按照种族界限定义的，并且对联邦政府有着长期的不满。

paras.en: The Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Alliance for Survival, or simply Alliance for Survival, that was proclaimed in September, stems from this movement. According to Jalale, the alliance aims at removing the current government and initiating a constitutional dialogue.
paras.zh: 9月宣布成立的埃塞俄比亚人民力量生存联盟，或简称生存联盟，就是源于这一运动。贾拉勒表示，该联盟的目标是推翻现任政府并启动宪法对话。

paras.en: The new alliance says a lot about the long history of unresolved conflict in Ethiopia, said Abdurahman Sayed, an analyst at the Horn of Africa Centre for Regional Integration.
paras.zh: 非洲之角区域一体化中心分析师阿卜杜拉赫曼·赛义德表示，新联盟充分说明了埃塞俄比亚长期未解决的冲突。

paras.en: "The fighting inside Ethiopia has never stopped," Sayed told DW.
paras.zh: 赛义德告诉德国之声：“埃塞俄比亚境内的战斗从未停止过。”

paras.en: "With the Oromo Liberation Army, it's been going on for decades, with the Amhara, it's been going on for the last three years, at least. With the Tigrayans, the Pretoria agreement about three years ago was just a cessation of hostility that would have led to some kind of sustainable peace by addressing the root causes of the conflict — but it failed to do that, so they're back to the conflict situation now."
paras.zh: “对奥罗莫解放军来说，这种情况已经持续了几十年，对阿姆哈拉人来说，至少在过去三年里一直在进行。对提格雷人来说，大约三年前的比勒陀利亚协议只是停止敌对行动，本可以通过解决冲突的根源来实现某种可持续的和平——但它未能做到这一点，所以他们现在又回到了冲突局势。”

paras.en: However, of the seven groups in the alliance, ACLED data shows that only three were involved in recent fighting: The Tigrayan Defence Forces (TDF), the Amhara Fano National Movement (AFNM), and a fairly recently formed ethnic Afar group called Ugugumo.
paras.zh: 然而，在该联盟的七个团体中，ACLED 数据显示，只有三个团体参与了最近的战斗：提格雷国防军 (TDF)、阿姆哈拉法诺民族运动 (AFNM) 和最近成立的阿法尔族团体乌古古莫 (Ugugumo)。

paras.en: Joint declaration by Sudan, Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia
paras.zh: 苏丹、埃及、厄立特里亚、索马里联合声明

paras.en: The success of the Alliance for Survival would depend in large part on the support they get through external actors, according to ACLED. Those could include neighboring Sudan, Egypt, Eritrea, and Somalia.
paras.zh: ACLED 表示，生存联盟的成功在很大程度上取决于他们通过外部参与者获得的支持。这些国家可能包括邻国苏丹、埃及、厄立特里亚和索马里。

paras.en: "All these four countries have grievances against Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government," Sayed said.
paras.zh: “这四个国家都对总理阿比·艾哈迈德政府心存不满，”赛义德说。

paras.en: "The Egyptians have issues with the Nile River and how it should be administered, including the dams that are already there and those planned to be built around the Nile River. The Sudanese also have their own concerns that Ethiopians are supporting the [Rapid Support Forces] militia, which is fighting the Sudanese army."
paras.zh: “埃及人对尼罗河以及如何管理它存在问题，包括已经在那里的水坝和计划在尼罗河周围建造的水坝。苏丹人也担心埃塞俄比亚人支持与苏丹军队作战的[快速支援部队]民兵。”

paras.en: In the case of Somalia, the issue of sea access has sparked tensions. Landlocked Ethiopia has negotiated access to the port of Berbera in Somaliland . In 2024, it signed a memorandum of understanding with the breakaway region, causing uproar in Somalia, which considers the deal a violation of its national sovereignty. Turkish mediation was needed to calm things down.
paras.zh: 就索马里而言，出海通道问题引发了紧张局势。内陆埃塞俄比亚已就进入索马里兰柏培拉港进行了谈判。 2024年，它与分裂地区签署了一份谅解备忘录，在索马里引起轩然大波，索马里认为该协议侵犯了其国家主权。需要土耳其的调解来平息事态。

paras.en: "So all those neighboring countries have their own concerns and they feel this threat that is coming from Ethiopia needs to be tackled collectively."
paras.zh: “因此，所有这些邻国都有自己的担忧，他们认为来自埃塞俄比亚的威胁需要集体应对。”

paras.en: On October 4, the leaders of the four countries issued a joint declarationthat didn't mention Ethiopia but seemed to send a strong signal. The leaders stressed the importance of international law, "particularly respect for the sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity of the states of the region."
paras.zh: 10月4日，四国领导人发表联合声明，虽然没有提及埃塞俄比亚，但似乎发出了强烈信号。领导人强调国际法的重要性，“特别是尊重该地区国家的主权、独立和领土完整”。

paras.en: And they maintained that "the governance of the Red Sea is the exclusive responsibility of the littoral states."
paras.zh: 他们认为“红海的治理是沿岸国家的专属责任”。

paras.en: Although the leaders of Sudan, Egypt, Eritrea and Somalia vowed to promote "peaceful solutions to conflicts," the reality on the ground may prove otherwise.
paras.zh: 尽管苏丹、埃及、厄立特里亚和索马里领导人誓言要推动“和平解决冲突”，但实际情况可能并非如此。

articles.title: Air strikes kill dozens of gold miners on Sudan-Egypt border

paras.en: At least 72 workers were killed in air strikes on a disputed border area between Sudan and Egypt that targeted artisanal gold miners, a human rights group said Sunday.
paras.zh: 一个人权组织周日表示，苏丹和埃及之间有争议的边境地区针对手工金矿矿工的空袭造成至少 72 名工人死亡。

paras.en: The attack, south of the remote Halayeb triangle, east of the River Nile, is the second of its kind this year.
paras.zh: 这次袭击发生在偏远的哈拉耶布三角以南、尼罗河以东，是今年的第二起此类袭击。

paras.en: It comes amid growing concern in Egypt over large-scale displacement from the three-and-a-half-year conflict in Sudan, which has spurred a cross-border exodus.
paras.zh: 与此同时，埃及对苏丹三年半冲突造成的大规模流离失所日益担忧，这场冲突引发了跨境逃亡。

paras.en: The Sudan-based Emergency Lawyers, a human rights and legal advocacy organization, said the attack occurred on Saturday in rugged and mountainous territory that it said lies within Sudan.
paras.zh: 总部位于苏丹的人权和法律倡导组织紧急律师组织表示，袭击事件周六发生在苏丹境内崎岖多山的地区。

paras.en: The Halayeb triangle, which is claimed by both Egypt and Sudan, is known for mining and the gold trade, along with other illicit goods and human trafficking.
paras.zh: 埃及和苏丹均声称拥有主权的哈拉耶布三角区以采矿和黄金贸易以及其他非法商品和人口贩运而闻名。

paras.en: The rights group accused the Egyptian air force of carrying out the strikes.
paras.zh: 该人权组织指责埃及空军发动了这次袭击。

paras.en: "The repeated attacks on the gold- and mineral-rich border regions reflect a desire by Egyptian authorities to expand and assert control over Sudan's natural resources," it claimed.
paras.zh: 声明称：“对黄金和矿产资源丰富的边境地区的多次袭击反映出埃及当局希望扩大和加强对苏丹自然资源的控制。”

paras.en: Egypt has yet to comment on the strikes, but has previously admitted conducting a "large-scale operation" against illegal gold mining within its borders.
paras.zh: 埃及尚未对此次袭击发表评论，但此前已承认对其境内的非法金矿开采进行了“大规模行动”。

paras.en: Independent verification remains difficult because of the remote location.
paras.zh: 由于位置偏远，独立核查仍然很困难。

paras.en: Sudan Doctors Network warned on Facebook of an expected increase in the number of casualties "due to the severity of some injuries and the difficulties in accessing medical care and essential services in the region."
paras.zh: 苏丹医生网络在脸书上警告称，“由于部分伤势严重，且该地区获得医疗服务和基本服务存在困难”，预计伤亡人数将会增加。

paras.en: One survivor told the AFP news agency there were thousands of people working at the remote site when it was hit.
paras.zh: 一名幸存者告诉法新社，袭击发生时有数千人在偏远地点工作。

paras.en: "After the air strike, people scattered. Some people came to Al-Ansary [gold] market, others went in the other direction. That's why no one knows exactly how many were killed," he said.
paras.zh: “空袭后，人们四散开来。一些人来到了安萨里（Al-Ansary）黄金市场，另一些人去了另一个方向。这就是为什么没有人确切知道有多少人被杀，”他说。

paras.en: Sudan's civil war between Abdel Fattah al-Burhan's military junta and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) has killed more than 200,000 people and triggered a severe humanitarian crisis.
paras.zh: 苏丹阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·布尔汉军政府与准军事快速支援部队 (RSF) 之间的内战已造成超过 20 万人死亡，并引发了严重的人道主义危机。

paras.en: Despite backing Sudan's army chief al-Burhan, Egypt considers the war at its border a threat to its security.
paras.zh: 尽管支持苏丹陆军参谋长布尔汉，但埃及认为边境战争对其安全构成威胁。

paras.en: The RSF has funded its operations by smuggling thousands of tons of gold from Sudan's Darfur and Kordofan regions. According to the UK-based think tank Chatham House, as much as 60% of unofficial gold exports end up in Egypt.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织通过从苏丹达尔富尔和科尔多凡地区走私数千吨黄金来为其行动提供资金。据英国智库查塔姆研究所称，多达 60% 的非官方黄金出口最终销往埃及。

paras.en: In June, air strikes on mining sites in the same border area were followed by a large-scale Egyptian security operation.
paras.zh: 6月，埃及对同一边境地区的矿场发动空袭，随后采取了大规模的安全行动。

paras.en: Hundreds of people, including foreigners, were arrested, accused of illegal gold mining and smuggling.
paras.zh: 包括外国人在内的数百人因非法开采金矿和走私而被捕。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Netanyahu demands probe into sources for award-winning Gaza film NAZA

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has called for an investigation into the anonymous sources featured in a documentary alleging that Israel’s military killed civilians in Gaza using AI-powered targeting systems.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡呼吁对一部纪录片中的匿名消息来源进行调查，该纪录片指控以色列军方使用人工智能瞄准系统在加沙杀害平民。

paras.en: The award-winning film, NAZA, draws on testimony from 24 unnamed Israeli military whistleblowers accusing the army of using the systems to kill numerous civilians in the besieged territory.
paras.zh: 获奖影片《NAZA》借鉴了 24 名未透露姓名的以色列军方举报人的证词，指控军队使用该系统杀害被围困地区的众多平民。

paras.en: “I demand that the chief of general staff, the head of the Shin Bet, and the attorney general launch a comprehensive investigation into the participants in the film ‘Naza’ and prosecute them for serious information security violations, criminal libel, and harm to Israel’s diplomatic and security interests,” Netanyahu said on X on Saturday evening.
paras.zh: “我要求总参谋长、辛贝特负责人和总检察长对电影《娜扎》的参与者展开全面调查，并以严重违反信息安全、刑事诽谤和损害以色列外交和安全利益的罪名起诉他们，”内塔尼亚胡周六晚间在X上表示。

paras.en: “The film presents a false, misleading, and biased narrative that defames the State of Israel and the [Israeli military] internationally, severely damaging Israel’s standing,” he added.
paras.zh: “这部电影呈现了虚假、误导性和有偏见的叙述，在国际上诽谤以色列国和[以色列军队]，严重损害了以色列的地位，”他补充道。

paras.en: In a statement last month, the Israeli military said it “categorically” rejected the whistleblowers’ allegations, calling some of their assertions “absurd’ and contradictory.
paras.zh: 以色列军方在上个月的一份声明中表示，“断然”拒绝了举报者的指控，称他们的一些说法“荒谬”且自相矛盾。

paras.en: It insisted that the selection and approval of strikes “are made by human personnel only”, in line with the military’s guidelines.
paras.zh: 它坚称，根据军方的指导方针，袭击的选择和批准“仅由人类人员进行”。

paras.en: Israeli army Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir has called for legal action against the participants to be considered and ordered an investigation into suspected leaks of classified military information used in the film’s production.
paras.zh: 以色列陆军参谋长埃亚勒·扎米尔呼吁考虑对参与者采取法律行动，并下令对涉嫌泄露电影制作中使用的机密军事信息的行为进行调查。

paras.en: NAZA takes its name from the Israeli military term for civilian casualties expected in air strikes, an abbreviated form of the Hebrew phrase for “collateral damage”.
paras.zh: NAZA 的名字来源于以色列军事术语，指空袭中预计造成的平民伤亡，是希伯来语“附带损害”短语的缩写形式。

paras.en: The film was awarded a special jury prize at the Venice International Film Festival and received a historic 25-minute standing ovation.
paras.zh: 该片荣获威尼斯国际电影节评审团特别奖，并获得历史性的 25 分钟起立鼓掌。

paras.en: It has also triggered a political storm in Israel.
paras.zh: 这也引发了以色列的政治风暴。

paras.en: The film’s directors, Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, have been accused of “treason”. Netanyahu and Culture Minister Miki Zohar have threatened to revoke their Israeli citizenship.
paras.zh: 该片导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔被指控犯有“叛国罪”。内塔尼亚胡和文化部长米基·佐哈尔威胁要取消他们的以色列公民身份。

paras.en: Last week, the head of Israel’s National Public Diplomacy Directorate, Tzipi Hotovely, awarded the creators of another film, NAZA: The Real Story, certificates of recognition for countering the “blood libels” made in the original NAZA film.
paras.zh: 上周，以色列国家公共外交局局长齐皮·霍托维利 (Tzipi Hotovely) 向另一部电影《NAZA：真实故事》的创作者颁发了表彰证书，以表彰他们反击原版 NAZA 电影中的“血腥诽谤”。

paras.en: According to a statement from the Prime Minister’s Office, NAZA: The Real Story features testimony from soldiers refuting the original claims.
paras.zh: 根据总理办公室的一份声明，《NAZA：真实的故事》中有士兵的证词反驳了最初的说法。

paras.en: In contrast, 43 Israeli rights groups defended the filmmakers of NAZA and denounced the threats being directed at them, according to Israel’s Channel 12 news.
paras.zh: 相比之下，据以色列第 12 频道新闻报道，43 个以色列权利组织为 NAZA 的电影制片人辩护，并谴责针对他们的威胁。

paras.en: Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza began on October 7, 2023, after Hamas’s armed wing, the Qassam Brigades, and other Palestinian groups attacked southern Israel, killing 1,139 people and taking about 240 captive.
paras.zh: 以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争于 2023 年 10 月 7 日开始，此前哈马斯的武装派别卡萨姆旅和其他巴勒斯坦组织袭击了以色列南部，造成 1,139 人死亡，约 240 人被俘。

paras.en: Since then, Israel has killed at least 74,000 Palestinians, including at least 21,000 children, according to Gaza’s Ministry of Health.
paras.zh: 据加沙卫生部称，自那时以来，以色列已经杀害了至少 74,000 名巴勒斯坦人，其中包括至少 21,000 名儿童。

articles.title: China sanctions Paraguay, Belize ministers over Taiwan ties

paras.en: China has sanctioned Paraguay’s communications minister and Belize’s foreign minister over ties to Taiwan.
paras.zh: 中国因与台湾的关系而制裁巴拉圭通讯部长和伯利兹外交部长。

paras.en: The Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs made the announcement on Monday, citing the safeguarding of China’s national sovereignty and opposition to Taiwan separatist activities as the reasons behind the measures, which went into effect the same day.
paras.zh: 中国外交部周一宣布了这一消息，称这些措施是为了维护国家主权、反对台湾分裂活动，并于同日生效。

paras.en: The measures against Paraguay’s Communications Minister Gustavo Villate and Belize’s Foreign Minister Francis Fonseca include the freezing of their assets in China and the denial of entry visas to Hong Kong and Macau.
paras.zh: 针对巴拉圭通讯部长古斯塔沃·维拉特和伯利兹外交部长弗朗西斯·丰塞卡的措施包括冻结他们在中国的资产以及拒绝向香港和澳门发放入境签证。

paras.en: The sanctions also prohibit Chinese organisations and individuals from engaging in transactions, cooperation or other activities with the ministers.
paras.zh: 制裁还禁止中国组织和个人与部长们进行交易、合作或其他活动。

paras.en: The Foreign Ministry said that “certain anti-China politicians” who are “driven by self-interest” have pushed their nations to maintain diplomatic relations with Taiwan.
paras.zh: 外交部表示，“某些反华政客”出于一己私利，推动本国与台湾保持外交关系。

paras.en: Beijing said the ministers had “taken a series of egregious actions and statements”, which are “damaging China’s core interests”.
paras.zh: 北京表示，部长们“采取了一系列令人震惊的行动和言论”，“损害了中国的核心利益”。

paras.en: Paraguay and Belize are two of 12 countries that maintain formal diplomatic relations with Taiwan.
paras.zh: 巴拉圭和伯利兹是与台湾保持正式外交关系的 12 个国家中的两个。

paras.en: China views Taiwan as its territory, a view the island’s government strongly rejects.
paras.zh: 中国将台湾视为其领土，但台湾政府强烈反对这一观点。

paras.en: The measures come two days after Taiwan’s National Day celebration.
paras.zh: 这些措施是在台湾国庆庆祝活动两天后出台的。

paras.en: In a National Day speech outside the Presidential Office on Saturday, Taiwan President William Lai Ching-te said the island “cherishes peace” and will “not give up our freedom”.
paras.zh: 周六，台湾总统赖清德在总统府外发表国庆讲话，表示台湾“珍视和平”，“不会放弃自由”。

paras.en: China’s Taiwan Affairs Office condemned Lai’s speech, saying it “disregards facts, distorts the truth, misleads the public, and reveals ulterior motives”.
paras.zh: 中国国台办谴责黎智英的言论，称其“罔顾事实，歪曲事实，误导公众，别有用心”。

paras.en: In January, Chinese President Xi Jinping pledged to achieve the “reunification” of China and Taiwan, calling the goal “unstoppable”.
paras.zh: 一月份，中国国家主席习近平承诺实现中国大陆和台湾的“统一”，称这一目标“势不可挡”。

paras.en: Paraguay’s Communications Minister Villate marked Taiwan’s National Day with a social media post, saying: “Paraguay reaffirms its relationship of friendship and cooperation, based on shared values and principles: the self-determination of peoples, human rights and democracy.”
paras.zh: 巴拉圭通讯部长维拉特在社交媒体上发帖庆祝台湾国庆日，他说：“巴拉圭重申其友好合作关系，其基础是共同的价值观和原则：人民自决、人权和民主。”

paras.en: The Belize embassy in Taiwan also posted a message on its Facebook celebrating the 37th anniversary of their diplomatic relations.
paras.zh: 伯利兹驻台湾大使馆也在脸书上发布消息，庆祝两国建交37周年。

paras.en: “Together, we look forward to a future of growth, opportunity, and lasting friendship,” the embassy wrote.
paras.zh: 大使馆写道：“我们共同期待一个充满增长、机遇和持久友谊的未来。”

paras.en: Last month, Taiwan’s Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung visited Belize. His ministry said the two sides had agreed to deepen ties.
paras.zh: 上个月，台湾外交部长林家龙访问了伯利兹。他的外交部表示，双方同意深化关系。

paras.en: Taiwan’s other allies in the Americas include Guatemala and Haiti. It also has formal diplomatic ties with three Caribbean islands.
paras.zh: 台湾在美洲的其他盟友包括危地马拉和海地。它还与三个加勒比岛屿建立了正式外交关系。

paras.en: The United States does not have formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan, but Washington is bound by law to provide the island with the means to defend itself.
paras.zh: 美国与台湾没有正式外交关系，但华盛顿有法律义务向台湾提供自卫手段。

paras.en: Earlier this month, the US delivered two fighter jets to Taiwan as the island seeks to build its defence capabilities to deter a feared attack from China.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，美国向台湾交付了两架战斗机，台湾正寻求建立防御能力，以阻止来自中国的可怕袭击。

articles.title: Countries warn against travel to Saudi Arabia following Houthi attacks

paras.en: Several countries have warned their citizens against travel to Saudi Arabia following a series of Houthi attacks on airports in the kingdom.
paras.zh: 在胡塞武装袭击沙特机场后，多个国家警告本国公民不要前往沙特阿拉伯。

paras.en: On Monday, Australia and New Zealand became the latest to issue advisories against travelling to the kingdom, following similar warnings from the United States, Canada, the UK, South Korea, and Japan.
paras.zh: 继美国、加拿大、英国、韩国和日本发出类似警告后，周一，澳大利亚和新西兰成为最新发布禁止前往该国旅行的建议的国家。

paras.en: Australia’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade said Australians should avoid King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh and “reconsider” travel to other Saudi airports.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚外交和贸易部表示，澳大利亚人应避免前往利雅得哈立德国王国际机场，并“重新考虑”前往沙特其他机场的旅行。

paras.en: New Zealand’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade urged citizens not to travel to the Saudi capital’s main gateway and the provinces of Najran, Jazan and Asir for any reason, and to avoid “non-essential” travel to Saudi Arabia as a whole.
paras.zh: 新西兰外交和贸易部敦促公民不要以任何理由前往沙特首都的主要门户以及奈季兰、吉赞和阿西尔省，并避免前往整个沙特阿拉伯的“非必要”旅行。

paras.en: The US embassy in Riyadh on Sunday advised US citizens to reconsider travel to the kingdom, citing the threat of attacks by Iran and the Iranian-backed Houthis.
paras.zh: 美国驻利雅得大使馆周日建议美国公民重新考虑前往沙特的旅行，理由是伊朗和伊朗支持的胡塞武装发动袭击的威胁。

paras.en: Global Affairs Canada issued an advisory against non-essential travel to any part of Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 加拿大全球事务部发布警告，禁止前往沙特阿拉伯任何地区进行非必要旅行。

paras.en: South Korea’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs recommended that its citizens in Saudi Arabia leave unless they are on essential business and advised anyone planning to travel to the kingdom to cancel their trip.
paras.zh: 韩国外交部建议在沙特阿拉伯的韩国公民除非有重要公务，否则应离开，并建议任何计划前往该国的人取消行程。

paras.en: The UK’s Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office urged citizens to avoid travel to Jeddah and Dammam, and to all airports apart from Medina International Airport, except for essential reasons.
paras.zh: 英国外交、联邦和发展办公室敦促公民避免前往吉达和达曼，以及除麦地那国际机场以外的所有机场，除非有必要原因。

paras.en: The warnings come as Saudi Arabia reels from five attacks on its airports in less than a week.
paras.zh: 发出警告之际，沙特阿拉伯在不到一周的时间里遭受了五次针对其机场的袭击。

paras.en: One person was killed and 11 others were injured on Sunday when a projectile struck King Khalid International Airport, according to Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA).
paras.zh: 据沙特阿拉伯民航总局 (GACA) 称，周日，一枚弹丸击中哈立德国王国际机场，造成 1 人死亡、11 人受伤。

paras.en: A Houthi strike on the same airport on Saturday killed 13 people and injured more than 300 others, marking the deadliest attack on Saudi Arabia in more than a decade.
paras.zh: 周六，胡塞武装对同一机场发动袭击，造成 13 人死亡、300 多人受伤，这是十多年来针对沙特阿拉伯最严重的袭击事件。

paras.en: The Houthis claimed responsibility for all four strikes on Saudi airports before Sunday’s attack, which has yet to be claimed by any group.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装声称对周日袭击之前对沙特机场的所有四次袭击负责，但尚未有任何组织声称对此次袭击负责。

paras.en: King Khalid international airport and King Fahd international airport in Dammam remain closed following the attacks, causing significant disruption to aviation across the Middle East.
paras.zh: 袭击发生后，哈立德国王国际机场和达曼法赫德国王国际机场仍然关闭，对整个中东地区的航空造成严重干扰。

paras.en: The attacks have also disrupted flights to and from King Abdulaziz International Airport in Jeddah.
paras.zh: 这些袭击还扰乱了往返吉达阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王国际机场的航班。

paras.en: More than 150 flights were cancelled and 374 flights were delayed at the Jeddah airport on Sunday, according to the flight tracking website Flightradar24.
paras.zh: 据航班跟踪网站 Flightradar24 称，周日吉达机场有 150 多个航班被取消，374 架航班延误。

paras.en: Brendan Sobie, an independent analyst and consultant in Singapore, said it was too early to predict the ramifications of the attacks for aviation across the region and beyond.
paras.zh: 新加坡独立分析师兼顾问布伦丹·索比表示，现在预测袭击事件对整个地区及其他地区航空业的影响还为时过早。

paras.en: “As has been the case with the Iran war and the impact from that crisis on the UAE, Kuwait and Bahrain, the impact of this latest crisis really depends on how long it lasts, how long Riyadh airport remains closed, and how long and to what extent are the restrictions once it reopens,” Sobie told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 索比告诉半岛电视台：“与伊朗战争的情况以及这场危机对阿联酋、科威特和巴林的影响一样，这场最新危机的影响实际上取决于危机持续多久、利雅得机场关闭多久，以及重新开放后限制的时间和程度。”

articles.title: Ukrainian MP calls U.S.-Russia diesel deal a 'betrayal'
articles.author: Michael Levitt

paras.en: Ukrainian MP calls U.S.-Russia diesel deal a 'betrayal'
paras.zh: 乌克兰议员称美俄柴油协议是“背叛”

paras.en: NPR's Joel Rose speaks with Ukrainian Minister of Parliament, Oleksandr Merezhko, about the U.S.'s diesel deal with Russia will impact Ukraine.
paras.zh: NPR 的乔尔·罗斯 (Joel Rose) 与乌克兰议会部长亚历山大·梅列日科 (Oleksandr Merezhko) 交谈，谈到美国与俄罗斯的柴油协议将影响乌克兰。

paras.en: President Trump and President Zelenskyy of Ukraine have had a stormy relationship, and this weekend, it's taken another chaotic turn. On Friday, Trump announced an agreement with Russia's President Putin to ease sanctions and reopen flows of diesel fuel. That did not go over well in Kyiv. Zelenskyy called Trump, quote, "weak," unquote. Trump responded yesterday saying Ukraine should get a new president.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统和乌克兰总统泽连斯基的关系曾一度风雨飘摇，而本周末，关系又出现了混乱。周五，特朗普宣布与俄罗斯总统普京达成协议，放松制裁并重新开放柴油供应。这在基辅的反响并不好。泽连斯基称特朗普为“软弱”，但未引述。特朗普昨天回应称乌克兰应该选出一位新总统。

paras.en: PRESIDENT DONALD TRUMP: I suggest they get a new leader who can make a deal because he could have made many deals, and for some reason, he never does.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统：我建议他们找一位能够达成协议的新领导人，因为他本来可以达成很多协议，但出于某种原因，他从未这样做过。

paras.en: ROSE: Then today, Zelenskyy offered to hold new elections, but only if there is a ceasefire, as he told ABC's "This Week."
paras.zh: 罗斯：今天，泽伦斯基提出举行新的选举，但前提是停火，正如他在美国广播公司的“本周”节目中所说的那样。

paras.en: PRESIDENT VOLODYMYR ZELENSKYY: Please tell Putin, give us two months, 60 days off - total ceasefire, 60 days - and we will organize elections.
paras.zh: 总统沃洛德米尔·泽连斯基：请告诉普京，给我们两个月 60 天的休息时间——全面停火，60 天——我们将组织选举。

paras.en: ROSE: Shortly afterward, President Trump posted on Truth Social that both parties have agreed to an energy ceasefire. But Zelenskyy told media outlets that was news to him. This geopolitical tussling matters. The war between Ukraine and Russia is in its fourth year. U.S. military and financial aid to Ukraine hangs in the balance, and the fighting has exacerbated a global energy crisis.
paras.zh: 罗斯：不久之后，特朗普总统在 Truth Social 上发帖表示，双方已同意能源停火。但泽伦斯基告诉媒体，这对他来说是新闻。这种地缘政治角力很重要。乌克兰和俄罗斯之间的战争已经进入第四个年头。美国对乌克兰的军事和财政援助悬而未决，战斗加剧了全球能源危机。

paras.en: To understand the view from Kyiv tonight, we called Oleksandr Merezhko. He's a member of Ukraine's Parliament and the chairman of its committee on foreign policy. I asked him if he knows anything about a ceasefire.
paras.zh: 为了了解今晚基辅的景色，我们给 Oleksandr Merezhko 打了电话。他是乌克兰议会议员及其外交政策委员会主席。我问他是否了解停火。

paras.en: OLEKSANDR MEREZHKO: First of all, there is absolutely no ceasefire because right now, I'm sitting in a dark apartment when there is no power, when there is no water. In the morning, there were nonstop air-raid alerts going off. Then I heard loud - rather loud explosions. So we don't have any ceasefire or energy truce whatsoever. And to me, this statement by President Trump came as a quite surprise.
paras.zh: 奥列克桑德·梅列日科：首先，绝对没有停火，因为现在我坐在一间黑暗的公寓里，没有电，没有水。早上，空袭警报不断响起。然后我听到很大的爆炸声——相当大的爆炸声。所以我们没有任何停火或能源休战。对我来说，特朗普总统的这一声明非常令人惊讶。

paras.en: ROSE: What do you think is going on? I mean, he says both parties have agreed.
paras.zh: 罗斯：你认为发生了什么事？我的意思是，他说双方都同意了。

paras.en: MEREZHKO: First of all, our President Volodymyr Zelenskyy - he didn't confirm that there is any ceasefire. But I'm afraid that it's part of internal American politics on the eve of the midterm elections. And maybe President Trump - well, actually, it's his typical political style, maybe, to make such statements which later are not confirmed.
paras.zh: 梅列日科：首先，我们的总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基——他没有确认停火。但恐怕这是中期选举前夕美国内部政治的一部分。也许特朗普总统 - 嗯，实际上，这也许是他典型的政治风格，做出了后来未得到证实的此类声明。

paras.en: ROSE: Diplomatically speaking, are things as bad as they look?
paras.zh: 罗斯：从外交角度来说，事情真的像看上去那么糟糕吗？

paras.en: MEREZHKO: Well, first of all, the good news about all the story is that American Congress - most of them are on the side of Ukraine. The situation is not that bad. Of course, there might be some disagreements between President Trump and President Zelenskyy, but it's a normal thing. So I think it's part of normal diplomatic or political process.
paras.zh: 梅列日科：嗯，首先，关于整个故事的好消息是美国国会 - 他们中的大多数人都站在乌克兰一边。情况并没有那么糟糕。当然，特朗普总统和泽连斯基总统之间可能存在一些分歧，但这是正常的事情。所以我认为这是正常外交或政治进程的一部分。

paras.en: ROSE: What is the state of Ukrainian infrastructure? And what is your incentive to try to stop attacks from Russia on that infrastructure right now?
paras.zh: 罗斯：乌克兰的基础设施状况如何？您现在试图阻止俄罗斯对该基础设施的攻击的动机是什么？

paras.en: MEREZHKO: Our critical infrastructure is being hit practically each day, and it's not in the best shape. But at the same time, the thing is that ahead of us is a very difficult winter and Putin will definitely weaponize. This winter, he wants to continue to destroy us. He wants to create humanitarian catastrophe. We're trying to prepare our power grid for that. But of course, we understand that the coming winter will be very difficult.
paras.zh: MEREZHKO：我们的关键基础设施几乎每天都受到冲击，而且状况不佳。但与此同时，问题是，我们面前将是一个非常艰难的冬天，普京肯定会武器化。今年冬天，他想继续摧毁我们。他想制造人道主义灾难。我们正在努力为此做好电网准备。但当然，我们知道即将到来的冬天将非常困难。

paras.en: ROSE: What has been the reaction in Ukraine today to these latest developments?
paras.zh: 罗斯：乌克兰今天对这些最新事态发展有何反应？

paras.en: MEREZHKO: We were outraged, honestly speaking, by this so-called diesel deal between President Trump and Putin because, yes, it's taken as a betrayal because we don't understand what's going on. Putin is conducting a crime of genocide against Ukrainian people. And if our closest friend, the United States, is giving some support or giving money to Russian war machine, it's tantamount to helping Putin to kill us.
paras.zh: 梅列日科：老实说，我们对特朗普总统和普京之间的所谓柴油协议感到愤怒，因为，是的，这被视为背叛，因为我们不明白发生了什么。普京正在对乌克兰人民犯下种族灭绝罪。如果我们最亲密的朋友美国向俄罗斯战争机器提供一些支持或提供资金，那就等于帮助普京杀死我们。

paras.en: ROSE: As you know, the midterm elections here in the U.S. are looming, and President Trump wants diesel supplies for Americans urgently, and he has blamed Ukraine, in part, for the high diesel prices that U.S. farmers and truckers are facing. How do you respond to that?
paras.zh: 罗斯：如你所知，美国中期选举即将到来，特朗普总统迫切希望为美国人提供柴油供应，他将美国农民和卡车司机面临的高柴油价格部分归咎于乌克兰。你对此有何回应？

paras.en: MEREZHKO: We wouldn't like Ukraine to become a hostage to internal political struggle in the United States. And we understand that situation before the midterm elections is getting tense, but Ukraine cannot be blamed. I believe it's very unfair and even immoral to blame the victim of the aggression. We're trying to protect ourselves. We're trying to destroy Russian war machine, which is killing us. And the only way to do it is to deprive Russia of oil revenues and its capabilities, including oil refineries. So - and I believe that the United States - it should support, not blame the victim. To me, it's deeply immoral.
paras.zh: 梅列日科：我们不希望乌克兰成为美国内部政治斗争的人质。我们知道中期选举前的局势正在变得紧张，但这不能归咎于乌克兰。我认为指责侵略的受害者是非常不公平的，甚至是不道德的。我们正在努力保护自己。我们正试图摧毁正在杀死我们的俄罗斯战争机器。而做到这一点的唯一方法就是剥夺俄罗斯的石油收入及其能力，包括炼油厂。因此，我相信美国应该支持受害者，而不是指责受害者。对我来说，这是非常不道德的。

paras.en: ROSE: I've been speaking to Oleksandr Merezhko. He is a member of Ukraine's Parliament and the chairman of its committee on foreign policy. Thank you very much for joining us.
paras.zh: 罗斯：我一直在和亚历山大·梅列日科谈过。他是乌克兰议会议员及其外交政策委员会主席。非常感谢您加入我们。

articles.title: Harrowing accounts of violence and sex abuse in women's prison told in new podcast
articles.author: Michael Levitt

paras.en: Harrowing accounts of violence and sex abuse in women's prison told in new podcast
paras.zh: 新播客讲述女子监狱中的暴力和性虐待的惨痛经历

paras.en: Madi Bolanos and Anna Sussman's new podcast We Are Jane Doe, by KQED and Snap Studios, investigates rampant sex abuse at the Central California Women's Facility in Chowchilla, Ca.
paras.zh: Madi Bolanos 和 Anna Sussman 的新播客《We Are Jane Doe》由 KQED 和 Snap Studios 制作，调查了位于加利福尼亚州乔奇拉的加州中部妇女设施中猖獗的性虐待行为。

paras.en: Don't tell anybody. That was the advice that Ali Prout received from her cellmate. Prout had told her that she had been raped by Gregory Rodriguez, a corrections officer at the Central California Women's Facility in Chowchilla, California.
paras.zh: 不要告诉任何人。这是阿里·普劳特从狱友那里得到的建议。普劳特告诉她，她被加利福尼亚州乔奇拉市中部妇女监狱的狱警格雷戈里·罗德里格斯强奸。

paras.en: ALI PROUT: She's like, you do what you have to do and be fake until you get out of here, and then you tell somebody.
paras.zh: 阿里·普劳特：她就像是，你做你必须做的事情，在离开这里之前保持假装，然后你告诉别人。

paras.en: ROSE: Prout followed that advice, and for months, she bore more abuse and quietly collected evidence until she was released in August of 2022. When she got out, that evidence she collected, along with her testimony, would help convict Rodriguez on more than 60 counts of sexual assault. He was sentenced to 224 years in prison. Prout's story, along with the abuse suffered by many other prisoners at the Central California Women's Facility in Chowchilla, are the subject of a new investigative podcast, We Are Jane Doe, by NPR member station KQED and Snap Studios. And a warning - this story will contain details of violence and sexual assault. Host Madi Bolaños and producer Anna Sussman join me now. Welcome to you both.
paras.zh: 罗斯：普劳特听从了这一建议，几个月来，她忍受了更多的虐待，并悄悄收集了证据，直到 2022 年 8 月获释。当她出狱后，她收集的证据以及她的证词将有助于对罗德里格斯定罪 60 多项性侵犯罪。他被判处224年监禁。普劳特的故事以及乔奇拉中部加州妇女监狱中许多其他囚犯遭受的虐待，成为 NPR 成员电台 KQED 和 Snap Studios 制作的新调查播客《We Are Jane Doe》的主题。警告 - 这个故事将包含暴力和性侵犯的细节。主持人马迪·博拉尼奥斯和制片人安娜·萨斯曼现在加入我。 Welcome to you both.

paras.en: ROSE: Anna, I want to start with you. Ali Prout's story is really central to the podcast. Tell us a little bit about her and why her story was so crucial to your investigation.
paras.zh: 罗斯：安娜，我想从你开始。阿里·普劳特的故事确实是播客的核心。请告诉我们一些关于她的信息，以及为什么她的故事对您的调查如此重要。

paras.en: SUSSMAN: She was convicted of a nonviolent offense, and very soon after she arrived at the Central California Women's Facility, an officer named Gregory Rodriguez said something inappropriate to her about how beautiful her lips were and how attractive she was, and she felt very uncomfortable. And shortly after that, he proceeded to assault her, and it was during the very first assault, she said, that she decided to single-handedly kind of make this plan to fight back. She said she knew she couldn't yell and fight in the same way that someone in the free world might be able to.
paras.zh: 苏斯曼：她被判犯有非暴力罪，在她到达加州中部妇女设施后不久，一位名叫格雷戈里·罗德里格斯（Gregory Rodriguez）的警官对她说了一些不恰当的话，说她的嘴唇多么美丽，她多么有吸引力，她感到非常不舒服。不久之后，他开始袭击她，她说，正是在第一次袭击期间，她决定单枪匹马地制定这个反击计划。她说她知道自己不能像自由世界中的人那样大喊大叫和打架。

paras.en: She knew she had to kind of pretend to go along with things because the big fear she had, and that lots of women we spoke with had, is more time being added to their sentence. Most of the women who are there are there for much longer amounts of time than she was set to serve. And for that reason, she still had a lot of fight in her, and she hadn't been kind of broken down by the system. And she hadn't been dehumanized year after year in the way that many women that we've interviewed are. Gregory Rodriguez had assaulted many, many women, and many women had tried various ways to fight back. But none of them had been successful because they hadn't been released as quickly as she had.
paras.zh: 她知道她必须假装同意一些事情，因为她和我们采访过的许多女性都有很大的恐惧，那就是她们的刑期会增加更多的时间。大多数在那里的女性在那里的时间比她预计的服务时间要长得多。也正因如此，她的内心还是充满了斗志，并没有被系统击垮。她并没有像我们采访过的许多女性那样年复一年地被非人化。格雷戈里·罗德里格斯（Gregory Rodriguez）袭击了很多很多女性，许多女性尝试了各种方式进行反击。但他们都没有成功，因为他们没有像她那么快被释放。

paras.en: ROSE: OK, so we know that her testimony ultimately played a major part in Rodriguez's arrest. What happened next?
paras.zh: 罗斯：好的，所以我们知道她的证词最终在罗德里格斯被捕中发挥了重要作用。接下来发生了什么？

paras.en: SUSSMAN: After Ali came forward, we asked the prison to give us all the data that they could about reports, claims of sexual assault at the prison. And what we saw from that data was pretty amazing, a dramatic rise in women reporting sexual assault inside that prison after Rodriguez was arrested.
paras.zh: 苏斯曼：阿里挺身而出后，我们要求监狱向我们提供有关监狱性侵犯报告和指控的所有数据。我们从这些数据中看到的结果非常惊人，罗德里格斯被捕后，报告监狱内性侵犯的女性人数急剧增加。

paras.en: ROSE: So a dramatic rise, and following that increase in complaints comes this really horrific incident that figures prominently in this podcast. The day is August 2, 2024. Over 150 inmates are rounded up in the prison cafeteria. They are held there for hours while their cells are raided by the corrections staff, and then they are attacked with gaseous chemical agents, tied up, beaten. Here's how some of the women describe that incident in your podcast.
paras.zh: 罗斯：急剧上升，随着投诉的增加，出现了这个播客中突出的非常可怕的事件。这一天是 2024 年 8 月 2 日。监狱食堂里关押着 150 多名囚犯。他们被关在那里几个小时，而他们的牢房遭到惩教人员的突击搜查，然后他们遭到气态化学制剂的袭击、捆绑、殴打。以下是一些女性在您的播客中描述该事件的方式。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED INMATE #1: It was like a concentration camp, actually, if I'm allowed to say that.
paras.zh: 身份不明的囚犯#1：实际上，如果允许我这么说的话，那就像一个集中营。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED INMATE #2: It was war (ph) zone, World War II zone.
paras.zh: 身份不明的囚犯#2：那是战区，二战区。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED INMATE #3: It was the most traumatizing experience I've ever dealt with in my life.
paras.zh: 身份不明的囚犯#3：这是我一生中经历过的最痛苦的经历。

paras.en: ROSE: The corrections staff had a name for this incident. They called it Operation Breakdown. You collected testimony and reviewed the security footage of this incident. After all of your reporting, Madi, what do you understand about how and why this happened?
paras.zh: 罗斯：惩戒人员给这起事件起了个名字。他们称之为“操作崩溃”。您收集了证词并查看了该事件的安全录像。在您进行了所有报道之后，马迪，您对这种情况如何以及为何发生有何了解？

paras.en: BOLAÑOS: OK, so we interviewed this woman named Antoinette Yancey. She's incarcerated at the Central California Women's Facility. She's also on a counsel that mediates issues between staff and prisoners. She told us that a sergeant came up to her and essentially warned her that if this rise in sexual assault complaints didn't stop, that there would be consequences. She was also part of a lawsuit that involved 12 other women, and they were suing CDCR for injuries that they got during that August 2 incident. And in that lawsuit, they also alleged that this was retaliation for a rise in sexual assault complaints. Now, just last month, the DOJ came out with its own report. And it looked into August 2, and it also found that it was retaliation for sexual assault complaints.
paras.zh: 博拉尼奥斯：好的，我们采访了这位名叫安托瓦内特·扬西的女士。她被监禁在加州中部妇女监狱。她还担任调解工作人员和囚犯之间问题的律师。她告诉我们，一名警官走到她面前，警告她，如果性侵犯投诉的增加不停止，就会产生后果。她还参与了一起涉及其他 12 名女性的诉讼，她们因 8 月 2 日事件中受伤而起诉 CDCR。在那起诉讼中，他们还声称这是对性侵犯投诉上升的报复。现在，就在上个月，司法部发布了自己的报告。并且调查了8月2日，也发现这是对性侵犯投诉的报复。

paras.en: ROSE: You know, I find it striking that the corrections staff must have known that this would all be caught on the security cameras, but this still went ahead. What do you make of that?
paras.zh: 罗斯：你知道，我发现令人惊讶的是，惩教人员一定知道这一切都会被安全摄像机捕捉到，但这种情况仍然发生。你对此有何看法？

paras.en: BOLAÑOS: What we learned in our reporting is that there is kind of this culture at the facility where there's almost this unchecked power. And so, yes, the officers know that they're being recorded, but they also don't face harsh consequences for their actions, and that seems to allow this to continue.
paras.zh: 博拉尼奥斯：我们在报告中了解到，该设施中有一种文化，那里几乎存在不受控制的权力。所以，是的，警察知道他们正在被记录，但他们也不会因为他们的行为而面临严厉的后果，这似乎让这种情况继续下去。

paras.en: ROSE: What did the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation say when you brought these allegations to them?
paras.zh: 罗斯：当你向加州惩教与康复部提出这些指控时，他们怎么说？

paras.en: BOLAÑOS: Well, they said that they take every allegation of sexual assault seriously, and they investigate them. And they also said that they have a zero-tolerance policy for retaliation.
paras.zh: 博拉尼奥斯：嗯，他们说他们认真对待每一项性侵犯指控，并进行调查。他们还表示，他们对报复采取零容忍政策。

paras.en: SUSSMAN: We also know that after the August 2 attack, the incidents of women reporting claims of sexual assault went way down again.
paras.zh: 苏斯曼：我们还知道，8 月 2 日袭击事件发生后，女性举报性侵犯的事件再次大幅下降。

paras.en: ROSE: Many of the women that you spoke to are still in prison in Chowchilla. What have you heard from them? What is life like for them now after all of this has come to light?
paras.zh: 罗斯：与你交谈过的许多女性仍在乔奇拉的监狱里。你从他们那里听到了什么？当这一切都曝光后，他们现在的生活是什么样的？

paras.en: BOLAÑOS: Most of the women that we spoke to say that they do not feel comfortable reporting sexual assaults, and if they were able to do it over, they would not go through that process because of the retaliation that they continue to face.
paras.zh: 博拉尼奥斯：我们采访过的大多数女性都表示，她们不愿意举报性侵犯，如果她们能够重来一次，她们就不会经历这个过程，因为她们将继续面临报复。

paras.en: ROSE: If I'm hearing you right, it sounds like that the women you've spoken to who are still in the prison would do this differently. Say more about that.
paras.zh: 罗斯：如果我没听错的话，听起来那些与你交谈过的仍在监狱里的女性会采取不同的做法。多说一点吧。

paras.en: SUSSMAN: We interviewed a large number of women in the prison. Nearly every single one of them told us that they had experienced sexual assault at some point in the prison. Most of them said, I never reported because I don't want to get myself in that kind of trouble. But the ones who said that they had reported said - I wished I had not - because they feel that they face ongoing retaliation in small and big ways in their daily lives in the prison because of what they reported.
paras.zh: 苏斯曼：我们采访了监狱里的大量女性。几乎每个人都告诉我们，他们在监狱中的某个时刻经历过性侵犯。他们中的大多数人说，我从来没有报告过，因为我不想给自己惹上那样的麻烦。但那些说自己举报过的人说——我希望我没有举报——因为他们觉得自己因为举报的内容而在监狱的日常生活中面临着大大小小的报复。

paras.en: ROSE: Wow. Where do things stand now? I mean, Gregory Rodriguez has been convicted, but has anything happened to the other officers who were implicated in all of this?
paras.zh: 罗斯：哇。现在情况如何？我的意思是，格雷戈里·罗德里格斯已被定罪，但参与这一切的其他警官有什么事吗？

paras.en: BOLAÑOS: No one else has been fired or convicted for sexual assault that we are aware of, but we do know that after this DOJ report came out, several officers have been walked off the yard and are being investigated for sexual assault.
paras.zh: 博拉尼奥斯：据我们所知，没有其他人因性侵犯而被解雇或定罪，但我们确实知道，在司法部的这份报告发布后，几名警察被赶出了院子，并正在接受性侵犯调查。

paras.en: ROSE: You know, the story of Chowchilla feels really extraordinary, but is it? Or is it just extraordinary that we know about what happened in this particular incident?
paras.zh: 罗斯：你知道，乔奇拉的故事感觉真的很非凡，但真的是这样吗？或者说我们知道这起特殊事件中发生的事情只是很不寻常？

paras.en: BOLAÑOS: You know, sexual abuse is a problem across prisons in this country. That's why in 2003 Congress passed the Prison Rape Elimination Act to eliminate rape in prison. But over the last 20 years, it continues to be a problem, and, you know, that's because there's these closed-door environments with unchecked power, and that really allows for this kind of abuse to flourish.
paras.zh: 博拉尼奥斯：你知道，性虐待是这个国家监狱中普遍存在的问题。这就是为什么国会在 2003 年通过了《监狱强奸消除法》，以消除监狱内的强奸行为。但在过去的 20 年里，这仍然是一个问题，而且，你知道，那是因为存在这些权力不受限制的闭门环境，这确实使得这种滥用行为得以猖獗。

paras.en: ROSE: You know, there's another major story about sexual assault that is capturing national headlines. And I'm talking, of course, about the allegations of gang rape at Cornell University. How do you think this story that you are telling fits into this larger conversation that the country is having at the moment?
paras.zh: 罗斯：你知道，还有另一个关于性侵犯的重大故事正在成为全国头条新闻。当然，我说的是康奈尔大学轮奸指控。您认为您所讲述的这个故事如何适合该国目前正在进行的更大的对话？

paras.en: SUSSMAN: There's a lot of parallels. There's a question of bystander complicity. There's the question of a lack of accountability. One thing that's interesting to think about is this concept of closed systems where sexual assault can really flourish, so like closed families, closed churches, for example, and closed prisons. So in this instance, I think something that's from the Cornell situation is that this is all happening kind of in a black box. It's - it was very difficult for us to get any information in or out. When they finally allowed us a visit, they said we were not allowed to speak with any of the women inside the prison. And as we toured the halls, women shouted out to us, they treat us terribly in here, they treat us like animals. And we were not allowed to speak with them. So I think the lack of transparency adds a layer of fear and a layer of concern.
paras.zh: 苏斯曼：有很多相似之处。这里存在一个旁观者共谋的问题。存在缺乏问责制的问题。值得思考的一件有趣的事情是，封闭系统的概念在其中性侵犯确实很猖獗，例如封闭的家庭、封闭的教堂和封闭的监狱。因此，在这种情况下，我认为康奈尔大学的情况是，这一切都在黑匣子中发生。我们很难输入或输出任何信息。当他们最终允许我们参观时，他们说我们不准与监狱内的任何女性交谈。当我们参观大厅时，女人们对我们大喊，他们在这里对待我们很糟糕，他们对待我们就像对待动物一样。我们不被允许与他们交谈。所以我认为缺乏透明度增加了一层恐惧和一层担忧。

paras.en: ROSE: Madi Bolaños and Anna Sussman are the host and producer of the investigative podcast We Are Jane Doe by NPR member station KQED and Snap Studios. Thank you to you both.
paras.zh: ROSE：Madi Bolaños 和 Anna Sussman 是 NPR 成员电台 KQED 和 Snap Studios 制作的调查播客《We Are Jane Doe》的主持人和制作人。谢谢你们俩。

articles.title: Seafarer's union official says crews offered big money to transit Strait of Hormuz
articles.author: Michael Levitt

paras.en: Seafarer's union official says crews offered big money to transit Strait of Hormuz
paras.zh: 海员工会官员表示，船员们愿意支付大笔资金来穿越霍尔木兹海峡

paras.en: As attacks continue to mount on shipping vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, a seafarer's union official says some crews are being offered big rewards for making the crossing.
paras.zh: 随着穿越霍尔木兹海峡的运输船只遭受的袭击不断增多，一名海员工会官员表示，一些船员因穿越霍尔木兹海峡而获得巨额奖励。

paras.en: President Trump blames the Russia-Ukraine war for soaring energy costs. The war with Iran, though, is the dominant factor keeping global diesel prices high. This weekend, the U.K. Maritime Trade Operations Centre reported two oil tankers traversing the Strait of Hormuz were attacked. Nearly a hundred vessels have been hit since the U.S. war with Iran began, resulting in two dozen deaths, according to the U.N. And the attacks are taking on new forms.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统将能源成本飙升归咎于俄罗斯和乌克兰战争。不过，与伊朗的战争是全球柴油价格保持高位的主导因素。本周末，英国海事贸易运营中心报告称，两艘穿越霍尔木兹海峡的油轮遭到袭击。据联合国称，自美国与伊朗的战争开始以来，已有近百艘船只遭到袭击，造成两打人死亡，而且袭击正在呈现新的形式。

paras.en: MANOJ YADAV: Small boats that surrounded a few of the vessels and started firing with RPG and even with the guns.
paras.zh: MANOJ YADAV：小船包围了一些船只，并开始用火箭弹甚至火炮射击。

paras.en: ROSE: Manoj Yadav is the general secretary of a union representing merchant sailors from India - many of whom work in the Persian Gulf. He says because of that danger, ship captains and sailors making these transits are being offered big money.
paras.zh: 罗斯：马诺杰·亚达夫是一个代表印度商船水手的工会的秘书长，其中许多人在波斯湾工作。他说，由于存在这种危险，进行这些过境的船长和水手将获得大笔报酬。

paras.en: YADAV: Not only one time, two time, three times - five times of their salary they are getting just to transit the Hormuz Strait.
paras.zh: 亚达夫：不仅仅是一次、两次、三倍——他们的薪水是他们穿越霍尔木兹海峡的五倍。

paras.en: ROSE: And if they don't comply, Yadav says they might be punished.
paras.zh: 罗斯：亚达夫说，如果他们不遵守规定，他们可能会受到惩罚。

paras.en: YADAV: And maybe there are possibility that they will get blacklisted.
paras.zh: YADAV：也许他们有可能被列入黑名单。

paras.en: ROSE: Now, oil deliveries through the Strait of Hormuz have recently seen a recovery, maybe as much as 80% of the pre-war supply, according to trade intelligence firm Kpler. But the cost of getting through the choke point continues to hit pocketbooks around the world. And in the U.S., that's raising the political stakes ahead of the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 罗斯：根据贸易情报公司 Kpler 的数据，通过霍尔木兹海峡的石油运输最近有所恢复，可能达到战前供应量的 80%。但克服这一瓶颈的成本继续影响着世界各地的人们的钱包。在美国，这增加了中期选举之前的政治风险。

articles.title: Brewers stun Dodgers, 2-1, in NLCS Game 1 as LA's offense flops with runners in scoring position

paras.en: Even MLB's powerhouse team needs a wake-up call. And this time around in the NLCS, the Milwaukee Brewers eked out a statement win versus the boys in blue.
paras.zh: 即使是美国职业棒球大联盟的强队也需要敲响警钟。这一次，在 NLCS 中，密尔沃基酿酒人队 (Milwaukee Brewers) 战胜了蓝衣男孩队。

paras.en: The Brewers defended home turf in Game 1 of the NLCS, defeating the Los Angeles Dodgers 2–1 in a tight pitching duel. After getting swept by the Dodgers in last year's NLCS, Milwaukee hopes to rewrite the script and capitalize on their regular-season-best record.
paras.zh: 酿酒人队在 NLCS 第 1 场比赛中捍卫主场，在一场激烈的比赛中以 2-1 击败洛杉矶道奇队。在去年的 NLCS 中被道奇队横扫之后，密尔沃基希望改写剧本并利用他们常规赛的最佳战绩。

paras.en: Milwaukee flamethrower Jacob Misiorowski pitched 4 1/3 innings, allowing five hits, one run, and three walks while striking out five. He threw 94 pitches (60 strikes).
paras.zh: 密尔沃基火焰喷射器球员雅各布·米西奥罗夫斯基 (Jacob Misiorowski) 投了 4 1/3 局，失 5 支安打、1 分、3 次四坏球上垒，同时三振 5 次。他投了 94 球（60 次击球）。

paras.en: Baseball's unicorn, Shohei Ohtani, continued his postseason struggles, and LA newcomer Tarik Skubal had a forgettable outing on the mound as Pat Murphy's "underdog" Brewers edged the back-to-back champs.
paras.zh: 棒球界的独角兽大谷翔平继续在季后赛中挣扎，洛杉矶新人塔里克·斯库巴尔在投手丘上的表现令人难忘，而帕特·墨菲的“失败者”酿酒人队则击败了背靠背的冠军。

paras.en: LA scored first in the second inning, bringing in Ohtani with an Andy Pages RBI single to right. Milwaukee responded in the bottom of the fourth with a Brice Turang solo homer. The Brewers inserted 21-year-old Luis Lara in a big spot, and he delivered in the fifth with an RBI single to score Garrett Mitchell for the go-ahead run.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶队在第二局率先得分，大谷用安迪·佩奇的打点右打点打出一垒安打。密尔沃基在第四节下半以布里斯·图朗的独奏本垒打回应。酿酒人队让 21 岁的路易斯·拉拉 (Luis Lara) 占据重要位置，他在第五局打出一记打点单打，为加勒特·米切尔 (Garrett Mitchell) 取得领先。

paras.en: Skubal tallied 81 pitches through five innings, prompting LA manager Dave Roberts to activate the bullpen earlier than expected. Skubal gave up five hits and two runs while recording seven strikeouts.
paras.zh: 斯库巴尔在五局比赛中投出 81 个球，促使洛杉矶主教练戴夫·罗伯茨比预期更早启动牛棚。斯库巴尔失去了五支安打和两分，同时录得七次三振。

paras.en: The Dodgers will turn to generational ace Yoshinobu Yamamoto in Game 2, though LA rarely puts on an offensive showcase when Yoshi is on the bump.
paras.zh: 道奇队将在第二场比赛中启用一代王牌山本嘉信，尽管当山本嘉信处于困境时，洛杉矶队很少表现出进攻性的表现。

paras.en: LA struggled to bring in runners, an issue that has plagued prime NL contenders in recent memory, like last year's Brewers and 2024's NLCS Mets. The Dodgers went 1-for-5 with runners in scoring position and left eight on base. With a final chance to tie in the ninth, LA put the tying run in scoring position after Trevor Megill issued two-out walks to Kyle Tucker and pinch-hitter Josue De Paula, but Megill induced a game-ending flyout from Mookie Betts to preserve the huge win.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶队在引进跑者方面遇到了困难，这个问题在最近的记忆中一直困扰着国联的主要竞争者，比如去年的酿酒人队和 2024 年的国联大都会队。道奇队五投一中，跑垒员处于得分位置，剩下八人上垒。第九局，洛杉矶队有最后的平局机会，特雷弗·梅吉尔(Trevor Megill)向凯尔·塔克(Kyle Tucker)和替补击球手若苏·德·保拉(Josue De Paula)发出两出局保送，但梅吉尔诱导穆基·贝茨(Mookie Betts)飞出结束比赛，以保住巨大的胜利。

paras.en: The Dodgers left nine guys on base Sunday night.
paras.zh: 周日晚上，道奇队在基地留下了九名球员。

paras.en: Historically, teams that win Game 1 of a League Championship Series advance 65.6% of the time; home teams winning Game 1 hold a 67.3% win rate.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，赢得联赛冠军系列赛第一场比赛的球队晋级的概率为 65.6%；主队赢得第一场比赛的胜率高达 67.3%。

paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Pope Leo denounces death penalty as 'inadmissible' ahead of Pentagon's planned livestreamed execution

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV condemned the death penalty as "inadmissible" as the Pentagon faces criticism over plans to livestream an execution later this year.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世谴责死刑是“不可接受的”，因为五角大楼因计划在今年晚些时候直播执行死刑而面临批评。

paras.en: Leo, the first American pope, shared his opposition to capital punishment Saturday in a social media post marking World Day Against the Death Penalty.
paras.zh: 第一位美国教皇利奥星期六在纪念世界反对死刑日的社交媒体帖子中表达了他对死刑的反对。

paras.en: Citing Catholic doctrine revised under his predecessor, Pope Francis, Leo emphasized that the death penalty violates human dignity.
paras.zh: 利奥援引其前任教皇方济各修订的天主教教义，强调死刑侵犯了人类尊严。

paras.en: "The death penalty is inadmissible because it is an attack on the inviolability and dignity of the person. The common good can be safeguarded and the requirements of justice can be met without recourse to capital punishment: effective systems of detention have been developed that protect citizens while at the same time do not completely deprive those who are guilty of the possibility of redemption," Leo wrote on X.
paras.zh: Leo在X上写道：“死刑是不可接受的，因为它是对人的不可侵犯和尊严的攻击。公共利益可以得到保障，正义的要求也可以在不诉诸死刑的情况下得到满足：有效的拘留制度已经发展起来，可以保护公民，同时不会完全剥夺那些有罪的人获得救赎的可能性。”

paras.en: "#NoDeathPenalty," he added in the post.
paras.zh: “#NoDeathPenalty，”他在帖子中补充道。

paras.en: In 2018, Francis revised the Catholic Church's official position on capital punishment, declaring the death penalty "inadmissible" in all circumstances.
paras.zh: 2018年，方济各修改了天主教会关于死刑的官方立场，宣布死刑在任何情况下都“不可接受”。

paras.en: "Consequently the church teaches, in the light of the Gospel, that the death penalty is inadmissible because it is an attack on the inviolability and dignity of the person," the revised Catechism states.
paras.zh: 修订后的教义问答指出：“因此，教会教导说，根据福音，死刑是不可接受的，因为它是对人的不可侵犯和尊严的攻击。”

paras.en: Before the change, Catholic teaching permitted the death penalty in cases where it was deemed the only effective means of protecting human life from a dangerous offender.
paras.zh: 在改变之前，天主教教义允许在被认为是保护人类生命免受危险罪犯侵害的唯一有效手段的情况下判处死刑。

paras.en: Earlier popes had maintained that exception, though Pope John Paul II increasingly advocated ending capital punishment, stressing that those convicted of crimes retain their human dignity.
paras.zh: 早期的教皇一直坚持这一例外，尽管教皇约翰·保罗二世越来越主张终止死刑，并强调那些被定罪的人保留其人的尊严。

paras.en: Although Leo did not specifically mention the U.S. government's plans in his statement, his post comes after the Pentagon announced on Thursday that it had scheduled a firing squad execution for a man convicted of a mass shooting at a military base.
paras.zh: 尽管利奥在声明中没有具体提到美国政府的计划，但他的帖子是在五角大楼周四宣布计划对一名在军事基地犯有大规模枪击罪的男子进行行刑队处决之后发布的。

paras.en: Nidal Malik Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist, was convicted of killing 13 people and wounding 32 others in a 2009 shooting at the Fort Hood military base. He is set to be executed at Fort Hood on Dec. 3, which would make him the first person to be executed by firing squad by the U.S. military since 1945.
paras.zh: 前陆军精神病学家尼达尔·马利克·哈桑 (Nidal Malik Hasan) 因 2009 年胡德堡军事基地枪击事件造成 13 人死亡、32 人受伤而被定罪。他将于 12 月 3 日在胡德堡被处决，这将使他成为 1945 年以来第一个被美军行刑队处决的人。

paras.en: President Donald Trump said on Saturday he had not yet decided whether to allow the livestream plan, pushed by Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth, to move forward.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周六表示，他尚未决定是否允许五角大楼负责人皮特·赫格斯推动的直播计划继续推进。

paras.en: Vice President JD Vance, who is a Catholic, expressed skepticism about whether the Pentagon would proceed with a public execution. He said he would not watch the livestream if it were carried out.
paras.zh: 身为天主教徒的副总统 JD 万斯对五角大楼是否会继续公开处决表示怀疑。他表示，如果进行直播，他不会观看。

paras.en: Several lawmakers, including Republicans, have spoken out against plans to broadcast the execution.
paras.zh: 包括共和党人在内的几位立法者已公开反对广播执行死刑的计划。

paras.en: "Public executions are what oppressive dictatorships like Iran and Afghanistan do," Sen. Thom Tillis, R-N.C., said on Thursday. "It should not be happening in America."
paras.zh: “公开处决是像伊朗和阿富汗这样的专制独裁国家所采取的做法，”北卡罗来纳州共和党参议员托姆·蒂利斯周四表示。 “这不应该发生在美国。”

paras.en: Cardinal Pietro Parolin, the Vatican secretary of state, criticized the proposed broadcast, calling it "truly incomprehensible" and warning that it was "unacceptable to turn death into a spectacle."
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈国务卿红衣主教彼得罗·帕罗林批评了拟议的广播，称其“确实难以理解”，并警告说“将死亡变成奇观是不可接受的”。

paras.en: "The Church’s position is one of total opposition to the death penalty; it is incompatible with human dignity and serves as no deterrent," Parolin told reporters on Friday. "It is truly incomprehensible that anyone would want to use this system today — I don’t know for what purpose. It is certainly unacceptable to turn death into a spectacle; even if the person is guilty, of course, there are other methods."
paras.zh: 帕罗林周五对记者说：“教会的立场是完全反对死刑；它与人的尊严不相容，也起不到威慑作用。” “今天居然有人想要使用这个系统，真是令人难以理解——我不知道出于什么目的。把死亡变成一场奇观当然是不可接受的；即使这个人有罪，当然还有其他方法。”

paras.en: He added that the death penalty "is incompatible with human dignity and does not serve as a deterrent."
paras.zh: 他补充说，死刑“与人的尊严不相容，也起不到威慑作用”。

paras.en: The head of the U.S. bishops conference, Archbishop Paul Coakley, expressed "shock" and "great sorrow" about the public execution plan and urged the U.S. to reconsider.
paras.zh: 美国主教团主席保罗·科克利大主教对公开处决计划表示“震惊”和“极大悲痛”，并敦促美国重新考虑。

paras.en: "In no way can Hasan’s actions be condoned but this decision is a barbaric promotion of a culture of death and must be reconsidered," he said in a statement on Friday. "The public execution even of one who has done grave harm will only further undermine the moral fabric of our nation and be a blight on the conscience of its people."
paras.zh: 他在周五的一份声明中表示：“哈桑的行为决不能得到宽恕，但这一决定是对死亡文化的野蛮宣扬，必须重新考虑。” “即使公开处决一个造成严重伤害的人，也只会进一步破坏我们国家的道德结构，并损害人民的良知。”

paras.en: Leo's statement also did not mention the botched lethal injection of Christa Gail Pike in Tennessee. Pike survived the attempted execution despite two doses of pentobarbital being administered late last month.
paras.zh: 利奥的声明也没有提到田纳西州克里斯塔·盖尔·派克注射死刑的失败事件。尽管上个月末注射了两剂戊巴比妥，但派克在这次处决中幸存下来。

paras.en: The Associated Press and Reuters contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社和路透社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Backup quarterback Tyler Huntley leads Baltimore Ravens to improbable OT win over Atlanta Falcons

paras.en: You would have been forgiven if you had turned this game off sometime around the middle of the second quarter.
paras.zh: 如果你在第二节中间的某个时候关闭这场比赛，你会被原谅。

paras.en: After all, both offenses were struggling to move the ball and the Baltimore Ravens were trotting out Tyler Huntley at quarterback in place of the injured Lamar Jackson.
paras.zh: 毕竟，双方进攻组都在努力转移球，而巴尔的摩乌鸦队则用泰勒·亨特利担任四分卫，代替受伤的拉马尔·杰克逊。

paras.en: However, just when it looked like this Sunday Night Football game was going to turn into a snoozer, the scoreboard decided to show a little life, as the Ravens came back to win 30-23 in overtime.
paras.zh: 然而，就在这场周日晚间足球比赛看起来即将进入暂停阶段时，记分牌却显示出了一点生机，乌鸦队在加时赛中以 30-23 逆转获胜。

paras.en: The Falcons took advantage of the aforementioned Huntley for much of the first half as the front seven specifically hounded the Ravens' offensive line to the tune of four sacks and numerous pressures.
paras.zh: 猎鹰队在上半场的大部分时间里都利用了前面提到的亨特利，前七名球员专门围堵乌鸦队的进攻线，进行了四次擒杀和无数的压力。

paras.en: When it counted though, Huntley made clutch play after clutch play with both his arms and his legs, showing both off on the game-tying final drive in regulation.
paras.zh: 不过，到了关键时刻，亨特利用他的双臂和双腿完成了一次又一次的关键比赛，在常规赛中扳平比分的最后一击中展现了这两种能力。

paras.en: From there, a steady dose of Huntley and ageless wonder Derrick Henry would score the only touchdown of the extra frame.
paras.zh: 从那时起，亨特利和永恒的奇迹德里克·亨利的稳定剂量将在加时赛中取得唯一的达阵。

paras.en: Huntley's three touchdowns (two through the air and one on the ground) all came after the first half, when the Ravens couldn't muster much of anything to penetrate the Falcons' defense.
paras.zh: 亨特利的三次达阵（两次空中达阵，一次地面达阵）都是在上半场之后完成的，当时乌鸦队无法集中力量突破猎鹰队的防守。

paras.en: On the other side of the field, Atlanta QB Michael Penix Jr. was opportunistic, converting on several third and longs in the second half to keep drives alive and effectively distributing the ball to his weapons.
paras.zh: 在球场的另一边，亚特兰大四分卫小迈克尔·佩尼克斯（Michael Penix Jr.）则善于机会主义，他在下半场进行了几次三分球和长投，以保持突破并有效地将球分配到他的武器上。

paras.en: As usual, Bijan Robinson had a nice night at the office, tallying over 100 yards from scrimmage, while wide receiver Drake London led the team with seven catches and 118 yards.
paras.zh: 像往常一样，Bijan Robinson 在办公室度过了一个美好的夜晚，距离混战超过 100 码，而外接手 Drake London 则以 7 次接球和 118 码领先全队。

paras.en: Even Kyle Pitts got in on the fun and looked closer to his 2025 All-Pro form, reeling in five receptions for 42 yards including an eight-yard score in the first half.
paras.zh: 就连凯尔·皮茨 (Kyle Pitts) 也乐在其中，看起来更接近 2025 年全职业球员的状态，他接球 5 次推进 42 码，其中上半场推进 8 码。

paras.en: When the Falcons' "big three" are all having productive games, this offense can be hard to stop.
paras.zh: 当猎鹰队的“三巨头”都打出富有成效的比赛时，这种进攻很难阻止。

paras.en: In the end, though, their efforts were ultimately in vain.
paras.zh: 但最终，他们的努力最终是徒劳的。

paras.en: Penix was unable to finish the game after taking a shot to the ribs late in the fourth quarter.
paras.zh: 佩尼克斯在第四节末射中肋骨后未能完成比赛。

paras.en: Backup Tua Tagovailoa came on in relief for one play before taking over permanently in overtime.
paras.zh: 替补图阿·塔戈瓦伊洛亚 (Tua Tagovaailoa) 替补登场，在加时赛中永久接替了球队的角色。

paras.en: After a promising start to the potential game-tying drive in the extra frame, Tagovailoa would toss an interception to Baltimore All-Pro safety Kyle Hamilton to seal Atlanta's fate.
paras.zh: 在加时赛中，塔戈瓦伊洛亚在加时赛中取得了有望扳平比分的开局，随后他将一次拦截传给了巴尔的摩全职业安全卫凯尔·汉密尔顿，从而锁定了亚特兰大队的命运。

paras.en: The Ravens needed this win, as the victory pushes them to 4-1 and nets them sole possession of first place in the AFC North.
paras.zh: 乌鸦队需要这场胜利，这场胜利将他们的战绩推向4-1，并让他们独占亚足联北区第一名。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Falcons will fall to 2-3, and head coach Kevin Stefanski will be left wondering how he let this opportunity slip through his hands.
paras.zh: 与此同时，猎鹰队的战绩将落至 2-3，主教练凯文·斯特凡斯基 (Kevin Stefanski) 会想知道他是如何让这个机会从手中溜走的。

articles.title: Joyce likens US public execution to ‘Roman amphitheatre’ – as it happened
articles.author: Krishani Dhanji

paras.en: That’s all for the politics live blog today, thanks so much for joining us. Here are the headlines:
paras.zh: 这就是今天政治直播博客的全部内容，非常感谢您加入我们。以下是头条新闻：

paras.en: The Australian government should block the “barbaric” broadcast or live stream of a US military execution, Greens senator Sarah Hanson-Young says. She found a somewhat unlikely ally in Barnaby Joyce who said the execution was like “Roman amphitheatre” and should not be watched. The government was a lot less forthcoming on whether the stream should be banned.
paras.zh: 绿党参议员莎拉·汉森-杨表示，澳大利亚政府应该阻止美国军事处决的“野蛮”广播或直播。她在巴纳比·乔伊斯（Barnaby Joyce）中找到了一个不太可能的盟友，他说处决就像“罗马圆形剧场”，不应该被观看。政府对于是否应该禁止该直播的态度却不太明确。

paras.en: Small business minister Anne Aly was in the question time spotlight today, pressed by the opposition on how and when she found out the ATO would ban credit card payments (she says she found out with the rest of the public).
paras.zh: 小企业部长 Anne Aly 今天成为提问时间的焦点，反对派追问她如何以及何时发现 ATO 将禁止信用卡支付（她说她和其他公众一起发现的）。

paras.en: Australian engineer Robert Petherhas been allowed to leave Iraq after being detained for more than four years in a Baghdad jail cell that his family feared would kill him.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚工程师罗伯特·佩瑟在巴格达监狱被关押了四年多后，被允许离开伊拉克，他的家人担心这会杀死他。

paras.en: The NSW government will seek to amend legislation to give One Nation access to the independent Parliamentary Budget Office in a bid to challenge the populist party to cost their promises.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州政府将寻求修改立法，让一国党能够进入独立的议会预算办公室，以挑战民粹主义政党兑现其承诺。

paras.en: The peak body for the oil and gas industry was the only stakeholder the New South Wales government met with before a decision to reopen gas exploration approvals for the first time in more than a decade, documents released under freedom of information laws suggest.
paras.zh: 根据信息自由法发布的文件显示，石油和天然气行业的最高机构是新南威尔士州政府十多年来首次决定重新开放天然气勘探审批之前会见的唯一利益相关者。

paras.en: NSW One Nation rejects attempt to force it to cost state policies
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州一国党拒绝强迫其牺牲州政策的企图

paras.en: NSW One Nation has pushed back against an attempt to have the party cost its state election promises, saying it would instead use access to the NSW parliamentary budget office (PBO) to cost the government’s net zero objectives.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州一国党反对让该党破坏其州选举承诺的企图，并表示将利用新南威尔士州议会预算办公室（PBO）的权限来破坏政府的净零目标。

paras.en: As we reported this morning, the Minns government will seek to amend legislation to give One Nation access to the PBO, in a bid to challenge the populist party to cost its election promises. Labor says it’s clear March’s 2027 election will see three parties competing to form government.
paras.zh: 正如我们今天早上报道的那样，明斯政府将寻求修改立法，让一国党能够进入议会预算办公室，以挑战民粹主义政党使其选举承诺付诸东流。工党表示，很明显，在 2027 年 3 月的选举中，三个政党将竞争组建政府。

paras.en: Current legislation only contemplates a Labor v Coalition contest. Minor parties like the Greens and independents can use the PBO to cost up to two policies a year.
paras.zh: 目前的立法只考虑工党与联盟党的竞争。像绿党和独立党这样的小党派可以利用 PBO 每年最多支付两份保单的费用。

paras.en: In a statement this afternoon, NSW One Nation leader and candidate for Cessnock, Mike Newman, said:
paras.zh: 在今天下午的一份声明中，新南威尔士州一国党领袖、塞斯诺克候选人迈克·纽曼 (Mike Newman) 表示：

paras.en: Our only request will be what is the total cost of Net Zero to the NSW Budget? Unless the PBO can provide a comprehensive response then One Nation will not be lectured.
paras.zh: 我们唯一的要求是净零对新南威尔士州预算的总成本是多少？除非PBO能够提供全面的回应，否则一国党将不会受到教训。

paras.en: The legislation is expected to pass this week with Coalition support. The act obliges major parties to cost their policies, but there is no actual penalty if they refuse to do so. The Greens have indicated they will not support the amendment.
paras.zh: 该立法预计将于本周在联盟党的支持下获得通过。该法案要求主要政党为其政策付出代价，但如果他们拒绝这样做，则不会受到实际处罚。绿党表示不会支持该修正案。

paras.en: That’s all for the politics live blog today, thanks so much for joining us. Here are the headlines:
paras.zh: 这就是今天政治直播博客的全部内容，非常感谢您加入我们。以下是头条新闻：

paras.en: The Australian government should block the “barbaric” broadcast or live stream of a US military execution, Greens senator Sarah Hanson-Young says. She found a somewhat unlikely ally in Barnaby Joyce who said the execution was like “Roman amphitheatre” and should not be watched. The government was a lot less forthcoming on whether the stream should be banned.
paras.zh: 绿党参议员莎拉·汉森-杨表示，澳大利亚政府应该阻止美国军事处决的“野蛮”广播或直播。她在巴纳比·乔伊斯（Barnaby Joyce）中找到了一个不太可能的盟友，他说处决就像“罗马圆形剧场”，不应该被观看。政府对于是否应该禁止该直播的态度却不太明确。
