When you can look at the stage and say, “I can’t believe this person is on stage with that person,” and creating a real musical moment — those are things we strive for in all the shows. Whether that’s six of the best guitarists on stage, six of the best vocalists, cross genres, just bringing those worlds together, that’s kind of a dream scenario for me.
paras.zh: 我有某种天上掉馅饼的梦想，我想做一些事情，让多位艺术家聚集在舞台上，有点像你在视频音乐奖上看到的那些古老的致敬，在那里你有六位最伟大的吉他手在舞台上跨越几代人。我认为这是为了将一场比生活更宏大的表演结合在一起。当你看着舞台说，“我不敢相信这个人和那个人在舞台上”，并创造一个真正的音乐时刻——这就是我们在所有演出中努力追求的目标。无论是舞台上六位最好的吉他手，六位最好的歌手，跨流派，只是将这些世界融合在一起，这对我来说都是一个梦想的场景。

articles.title: R.L. Stine’s ‘The Babysitter’ Adaptation Coming to Tubi in 2027 (Exclusive)
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: The streamer is set to release a live action adaptation of The Babysitter, based on the popular series of R.L. Stine novels first published in 1989, in 2027. The film’s announcement comes just two days after the Oct. 9 release of Pumpkinhead 2, and ahead of the streamer’s New York Comic Con panel, where Stine appeared alongside Tubi’s Chief Content Officer Adam Lewinson, Pumpkinhead writer-director Jem Garrard, and RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars’ contestant and Afraid of Clowns star Jimbo.
paras.zh: 该流媒体将于 2027 年上映根据 1989 年首次出版的 R.L. Stine 畅销系列小说改编的真人版《保姆》。这部电影的发布是在 10 月 9 日《南瓜头 2》上映两天后，在该流媒体的纽约动漫展小组讨论之前，斯坦与 Tubi 的首席内容官 Adam Lewinson、Pumpkinhead 编剧兼导演杰姆·加勒德 (Jem Garrard) 一起亮相。 《鲁保罗变装皇后秀全明星》的参赛者、《害怕小丑》的明星金博。

paras.en: The film follows a 16-year-old babysitter, Jenny, who is so desperate to earn enough money for a prestigious writing program that she takes the job despite a prowler terrorizing girls across town. But when she starts receiving threatening phone calls and a dangerous fugitive surfaces in town, Jenny’s suspicion of those around her grows. Meanwhile, danger begins closing in.
paras.zh: 影片讲述了 16 岁的保姆珍妮 (Jenny) 非常渴望赚到足够的钱来参加一个享有盛誉的写作项目的故事，尽管镇上有一个徘徊者恐吓女孩，她还是接受了这份工作。但当珍妮开始接到威胁电话，镇上出现一名危险的逃犯时，她对周围人的怀疑与日俱增。与此同时，危险开始逼近。

paras.en: Produced by Blue Ice, Garrard will write and executive produce the film, which Trevor Calverleya will direct. The Babysitter will be executive produced by Lance Samuels, Joan Waricha, Jane Stine and Garrard. Producers include Dan Bernard, Yvonne Bernard, Tebogo Maila, Darren Cameron and Adam Friedlander.
paras.zh: 该片由 Blue Ice 出品，加勒德将担任编剧和监制，特雷弗·卡尔维利亚 (Trevor Calverleya) 担任导演。 《保姆》将由兰斯·塞缪尔斯、琼·瓦里查、简·斯汀和加勒德担任执行制片人。制片人包括丹·伯纳德、伊冯·伯纳德、特博戈·麦拉、达伦·卡梅伦和亚当·弗里德兰德。

paras.en: “R.L. Stine has an incredible ability to tell stories that are scary, fun and endlessly entertaining, and that combination continues to connect with Tubi viewers,” said Adam Lewinson, Chief Content Officer, Tubi. “With The Babysitter, one of R.L. Stine’s most iconic novels, we’re delivering a fresh, fun thrill ride for longtime fans and a whole new generation.”
paras.zh: Tubi 首席内容官 Adam Lewinson 表示：“R.L. Stine 具有令人难以置信的能力，可以讲述恐怖、有趣且无穷无尽的故事，这种结合将继续与 Tubi 观众产生联系。” “凭借 R.L. Stine 最具代表性的小说之一《保姆》，我们为长期粉丝和全新一代提供了新鲜、有趣的惊险之旅。”

paras.en: The Babysitter not only marks the fourth film in an ongoing partnership between the streamer and the prolific children’s horror author, but also the first not based on a short from Stine’s Nightmare Hour or Haunting Hour anthologies. Check out the teaser, which The Hollywood Reporter can exclusively share, below.
paras.zh: 《保姆》不仅是该主播与这位多产儿童恐怖作家持续合作的第四部电影，也是第一部不是根据斯汀的《噩梦时刻》或《鬼魂时刻》选集短片改编的电影。请查看下面由《好莱坞报道》独家分享的预告片。

paras.en: First published in 1989, The Babysitter and its three sequels — The Babysitter II (1991), The Babysitter III (1993), and The Babysitter IV (1995) — were pivotal in defining Stine as a preeminent horror and children’s author. The original book followed the same 16-year-old Jenny, who begins receiving threatening calls and notes after taking on a babysitting gig, before she discovers the threat is coming from inside the house.
paras.zh: 《保姆》于 1989 年首次出版，及其三部续集——《保姆 II》（1991 年）、《保姆 III》（1993 年）和《保姆 IV》（1995 年）——在将斯泰恩定义为杰出的恐怖和儿童作家方面发挥了关键作用。原著讲述了 16 岁的珍妮在接受保姆工作后开始收到威胁电话和短信的故事，后来她发现威胁来自屋内。

paras.en: The second and fourth books follow Jenny as she attempts to recover in the immediate aftermath of the first book’s events, and years later as she faces her disturbing past and another terrorizing babysitting experience. The third installment pivots slightly, focusing more on the experiences of Debra, who is haunted and hunted in the same way as her cousin, Jenny.
paras.zh: 第二本书和第四本书讲述了珍妮在第一本书的事件发生后试图恢复的故事，以及多年后她面对令人不安的过去和另一次可怕的保姆经历的故事。第三部分的重点稍有不同，更多地关注黛布拉的经历，她和她的表弟珍妮一样被闹鬼和追捕。

paras.en: Tubi also recently announced a third Stine adaptation, Afraid of Clowns, based on The Nightmare Hour short and previously developed as a Haunting Hour (2010) episode. Written and directed by Garrard, the film, also set to release in 2027, stars Frankie Honey, Ava Ferrer, Azriel Dalman, Joe Moore and RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars winner Jimbo, and is teased at the end of Pumpkinhead 2.
paras.zh: Tubi 最近还宣布了 Stine 的第三部改编作品《害怕小丑》，该作品改编自《噩梦时刻》短片，此前曾开发为《鬼魂时刻》（2010 年）剧集。这部电影由加勒德编剧并执导，也将于 2027 年上映，由弗兰基·哈尼、艾娃·费雷尔、阿兹瑞尔·达尔曼、乔·摩尔和鲁保罗变装皇后秀全明星冠军金博主演，并在《南瓜头 2》的结尾处进行了调侃。

paras.en: The next entry in the Redhaven saga, Afraid of Clowns, sees the arrival of a mysterious clown troupe led by Ringmaster Rollo. A young resident, Frankie, begins to suspect they’re connected to the disappearance of a child years earlier, and in an effort to protect her brother, works to convince her friends to help stop the clowns before her sibling vanishes forever.
paras.zh: 雷德黑文传奇的下一篇《害怕小丑》讲述了由马戏大师罗洛领导的神秘小丑团的到来。年轻的居民弗兰基开始怀疑他们与多年前一名儿童的失踪有关，为了保护她的兄弟，她努力说服她的朋友在她的兄弟永远消失之前帮助阻止小丑。

paras.en: Pumpkinhead 2 is currently streaming on Tubi.
paras.zh: 《南瓜头 2》目前正在 Tubi 上播出。

articles.title: ‘Social Reckoning’ Goes Dark With $5.5M as ‘Other Mommy’ Delivers at Box Office
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: Other Mommy was in command at the box office in its opening weekend, while The Social Reckoning received a painful status check as Aaron Sorkin‘s follow-up to The Social Network went quiet.
paras.zh: 《另一个妈妈》在首映周末票房遥遥领先，而《社会清算》则因亚伦·索金的《社交网络》后续片陷入沉寂而遭受痛苦的状态检查。

paras.en: Universal Pictures released Other Mommy in 3,200 North American theaters, and the horror title grossed around $27.5 million for the weekend despite overwhelmingly negative responses from critics and audiences alike. Director Rob Savage’s film lands above the studio’s projected $20 million opening for the $19 million-budgeted project, which stars Jessica Chastain as a sinister entity that appears in a young girl’s closet.
paras.zh: 环球影业在北美 3,200 家影院上映了《另一位妈妈》，尽管评论家和观众的反响压倒性差，但这部恐怖影片周末的票房收入约为 2,750 万美元。导演罗布·萨维奇 (Rob Savage) 的这部电影超出了工作室预计的 2000 万美元的预算，该项目预算为 1900 万美元，由杰西卡·查斯坦 (Jessica Chastain) 主演，饰演一个出现在年轻女孩衣柜里的邪恶实体。

paras.en: The movie managed a successful launch in spite of its word of mouth, having earned a woeful D+ CinemaScore from audiences, the lowest grade for a film since Francis Ford Coppola’s Megalopolis in September 2024. Critical response has been similarly dismal, with Other Mommy holding a 19 percent approval rating from reviewers on Rotten Tomatoes, along with a 46 percent audience score. In his review for The Hollywood Reporter, critic Richard Lawson deemed the movie “an attractive but mostly vacuous collection of jumpy bits and half-baked mythology.” The studio credits the startling Other Mommy trailer that first screened ahead of Universal’s The Odyssey with creating buzz for the horror feature.
paras.zh: 尽管口碑相传，这部电影还是取得了成功，在 CinemaScore 上获得了糟糕的 D+ 评分，这是自 2024 年 9 月弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉 (Francis Ford Coppola) 执导的《大都会》(Megalopolis) 以来电影评分最低的电影。评论界的反响也同样惨淡，烂番茄上影评人的支持率为 19%，观众评分为 46%。影评人理查德·劳森在《好莱坞报道》的评论中认为这部电影是“一部有吸引力但大多空洞的集合，充满了神经质的片段和半生不熟的神话。”该工作室认为，在环球影业出品《奥德赛》之前首映的《另一个妈妈》预告片为这部恐怖片带来了轰动。

paras.en: Despite the reception, Other Mommy continues a triumphant box office year for horror titles, particularly original ones. The domestic box office is expected to generate an estimated $88 million for the frame, according to Rentrak, representing a 23.6 percent improvement over last year’s comparable weekend, which saw Tron: Ares opening to $33.5 million domestically. The 2026 domestic box office crossed the $8 billion mark on Friday and stands at $8.077 billion as of Sunday, which is up 19.6 percent over the $6.7 billion collected at the equivalent point in 2025. However, this weekend represented a box office lull after a hot summer, with FranchiseRe estimating that the frame is down around 27 percent from the combined averages for the equivalent weekends in the pre-pandemic years of 2017, 2018 and 2019.
paras.zh: 尽管反响热烈，《另一个妈妈》仍继续保持恐怖片票房的胜利，尤其是原创片。据 Rentrak 称，该片的国内票房预计将达到 8800 万美元，比去年同期的周末票房增长 23.6%，去年《创：战神》的国内票房为 3350 万美元。 2026 年国内票房周五突破 80 亿美元大关，截至周日达到 80.77 亿美元，比 2025 年同期的 67 亿美元增长 19.6%。然而，这个周末代表着炎热夏季后的票房平静，FranchiseRe 估计，这一数字比大流行前几年同期周末的综合平均水平下降了约 27%。 2017 年、2018 年和 2019 年。

paras.en: The start for Sony Pictures’ The Social Reckoning was even softer than expected, as director Aaron Sorkin’s Facebook-focused feature notched $5.5 million. This is slightly below the $7 million the studio expected for the fact-based thriller starring Mikey Madison, Jeremy Allen White and Jeremy Strong, which follows a Facebook staffer (Madison) working with a journalist (White) to expose concerning truths about the company. Earning a B- CinemaScore, the $30 million-budgeted movie launched in 2,606 North American locations.
paras.zh: 索尼影业的《社会清算》的开局比预期更为温和，导演亚伦·索金 (Aaron Sorkin) 的这部以 Facebook 为主题的影片获得了 550 万美元的票房。这略低于工作室对这部由米基·麦迪逊、杰里米·艾伦·怀特和杰里米·斯特朗主演的基于事实的惊悚片的预期 700 万美元，该片讲述了一名 Facebook 员工（麦迪逊）与一名记者（怀特）合作揭露有关该公司的真相。这部预算为 3,000 万美元的电影在北美 2,606 个地点上映，获得了 B-CinemaScore 评级。

paras.en: After winning an Academy Award for penning the screenplay for 2010’s The Social Network, Sorkin replaces David Fincher in the director’s chair for the companion piece. Starring Jesse Eisenberg as Mark Zuckerberg in the story of Facebook’s early days, that film was a bona fide hit, opening at No. 1 with $22.4 million in October 2010 before an impressive run took it to $224 million globally. Strong portrays an older Zuckerberg in the new movie.
paras.zh: 索金因撰写 2010 年影片《社交网络》的剧本获得奥斯卡金像奖后，接替大卫·芬奇担任姊妹片的导演。该片由杰西·艾森伯格 (Jesse Eisenberg) 在 Facebook 早期故事中饰演马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg)，该片大获成功，于 2010 年 10 月首映，票房收入为 2,240 万美元，位居第一，之后全球票房收入达到 2.24 亿美元，令人印象深刻。斯特朗在新电影中饰演年长的扎克伯格。

paras.en: While The Social Network boasts a 96 Rotten Tomatoes score, critics have been mixed on the follow-up, as The Social Reckoning holds a 54 percent approval from reviewers and a 71 percent audience rating. In his review for THR, chief film critic David Rooney praised it as an “engrossing whistleblower thriller.”
paras.zh: 虽然《社交网络》在烂番茄上获得了 96 分的高分，但评论家对后续影片的评价却褒贬不一，因为《社交清算》获得了 54% 的评论者认可度和 71% 的收视率。首席影评人大卫·鲁尼在《好莱坞报道》的评论中称赞该片是“引人入胜的举报惊悚片”。

paras.en: Alex Gibney’s Elon Musk-focused documentary Musk collected around $68,900 for Bleecker Street, averaging $17,225 per screen.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·吉布尼 (Alex Gibney) 执导的以埃隆·马斯克为主题的纪录片《布利克街》的票房收入约为 68,900 美元，平均每场 17,225 美元。

paras.en: Debuting in limited release from A24 was Chris Rock’s Misty Green, which nabbed $85,716 from six locations in New York and Los Angeles. Rosalind Eleazar, Adam Driver and Daniel Kaluuya star in the film about a fading actress angling for a comeback. Rooney described it as “the work of a mature director who knows what he wants to say.”
paras.zh: Chris Rock 的《Misty Green》首次在 A24 限量发行，在纽约和洛杉矶的 6 个地点斩获 85,716 美元的票房。罗莎琳德·埃利亚撒、亚当·德赖弗和丹尼尔·卡卢亚主演的这部影片讲述了一位日渐衰落的女演员寻求东山再起的故事。鲁尼将其描述为“一位成熟导演的作品，他知道自己想说什么”。

paras.en: Also launching theatrically was the documentary NAZA, earning an estimated $247,000 from 72 North American locations. The Israeli-American Council organized a protest on Friday outside of the Laemmle NoHo 7 in North Hollywood, timed to the screening of the feature that examines Israel’s military operations in Gaza.
paras.zh: 纪录片《NAZA》也在院线上映，在北美 72 个地点获得了约 247,000 美元的票房。以色列-美国委员会周五在北好莱坞的 Laemmle NoHo 7 外组织了一场抗议活动，恰逢放映以色列在加沙军事行动的专题片。

paras.en: Claiming second place was Verity, Amazon MGM Studios’ Colleen Hoover adaptation that was last weekend’s winner. It grossed $11.4 million for a domestic cume of $53.8 million, marking a decline of roughly 64 percent in its sophomore frame. Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson and Josh Hartnett star in filmmaker Michael Showalter’s thriller about a woman getting in over her head after landing a ghostwriting gig.
paras.zh: 获得第二名的是《Verity》，亚马逊米高梅影业根据科琳·胡佛 (Colleen Hoover) 改编的作品获得了上周末的冠军。该片的国内票房为 1,140 万美元，国内票房为 5,380 万美元，比第二季下降了约 64%。安妮·海瑟薇、达科塔·约翰逊和乔什·哈奈特主演了电影制片人迈克尔·肖沃尔特的惊悚片，讲述了一名女子在获得代笔工作后陷入困境的故事。

paras.en: Sony’s Resident Evil landed $8.3 million in its fourth frame to bring its total domestic take to roughly $138.5 million. Austin Abrams stars in Zach Cregger’s reboot of the franchise that adapts the video game property. The film crossed $300 million globally, with its $320.2 million worldwide cume making it the franchise’s highest-grossing title.
paras.zh: 索尼的《生化危机》第四部票房收入为 830 万美元，使其国内总票房达到约 1.385 亿美元。奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯 (Austin Abrams) 主演了扎克·克雷格 (Zach Cregger) 重新启动的改编自电子游戏产业的系列电影。该片全球票房突破 3 亿美元，全球票房达到 3.202 亿美元，成为该系列电影票房最高的影片。

paras.en: Paramount’s Heart of the Beast added $7.1 million to bring its domestic total to $49.6 million in its third weekend. David Ayer’s thriller stars Brad Pitt as a Special Forces officer navigating the wilderness with his combat dog.
paras.zh: 派拉蒙出品的《野兽之心》第三周末票房增加 710 万美元，国内总票房达到 4,960 万美元。大卫·艾尔的惊悚片由布拉德·皮特主演，饰演一名特种部队军官，带着他的战犬在荒野中航行。

paras.en: Among the offerings heading to theaters next weekend include Street Fighter, Whalefall and Sense and Sensibility.
paras.zh: 下周末即将上映的影片包括《街头霸王》、《鲸落》和《理智与情感》。

paras.en: This story was first published on Oct. 10 at 9:27 a.m.
paras.zh: 本文首次发表于 10 月 10 日上午 9 点 27 分。

articles.title: You Want Those Tattoos From ‘The Bear’? Call Benny Shields
articles.author: Lexy Perez

paras.en: Tattoo artist Benny Shields never aspired to make his mark in Hollywood, let alone on Hollywood. The L.A. inkman has adorned the arms of numerous stars, perhaps most prominently those of The Bear‘s tatted chefs, Carmen “Carmy” Berzatto (Jeremy Allen White) and Luca (Will Poulter). His first screen credit came via buddy Ryan Gosling for 2011’s The Place Beyond the Pines. When the actor’s self-drawn tattoo designs for his motorcycle stuntman character weren’t panning out, he called on Shields, whose brother Zach was a member of Gosling’s band Dead Man’s Bones.
paras.zh: 纹身艺术家本尼·希尔兹从未渴望在好莱坞留下自己的印记，更不用说在好莱坞了。这位洛杉矶墨客曾装饰过众多明星的手臂，其中最著名的可能是 The Bear 的纹身厨师卡门·“卡米”·贝尔扎托（杰里米·艾伦·怀特饰）和卢卡（威尔·保尔特饰）。他的第一部银幕作品是由好友瑞恩·高斯林 (Ryan Gosling) 拍摄的 2011 年电影《松林之外》(The Place Beyond the Pines)。当这位演员为摩托车特技演员角色自绘的纹身设计效果不佳时，他拜访了小希尔兹，小希尔兹的兄弟扎克是高斯林乐队“死人之骨”的成员。

paras.en: “When things are presented to me, I try to say yes unless I can find a good reason not to,” the 44-year-old tattooist tells THR. As for The Bear, “I had a feeling that show was going to be good.” White, as it happens, was a longtime friend for whom Shields had also done permanent ink. “They sent me the script, but a lot of who Carmy was hadn’t really been decided,” says Shields.
paras.zh: 这位 44 岁的纹身师告诉《好莱坞报道》：“当事情摆在我面前时，我会尝试说‘是’，除非我能找到充分的理由不这么做。”至于《熊》，“我有预感，这部剧会很精彩。”碰巧，怀特是一位老朋友，希尔兹也曾为他做过永久性墨水。 “他们给我发了剧本，但卡米的很多身份还没有真正确定，”希尔兹说。

paras.en: Carmy’s tattoos weren’t just decoration, they were integral to the development of the character, White notes. “Ben Shields was a really important part of my getting to understand Carmen and early,” says the actor. “He was probably the person I spoke to first about Carmy. He asked about his family, what made him feel inspired or safe. We took all these conversations and put it on paper, in sketch and scribbles.”
paras.zh: 怀特指出，卡米的纹身不仅仅是装饰，它们是角色发展不可或缺的一部分。 “本·希尔兹是我早期了解卡门的一个非常重要的部分，”这位演员说。 “他可能是我第一个谈论卡米的人。他询问了他的家庭，是什么让他感到鼓舞或安全。我们记录了所有这些对话，并以草图和涂鸦的形式写在纸上。”

paras.en: A Pyrex measuring glass with the globe on Carmy’s left forearm — among the 15 sketches that made the cut — was the actor’s idea. The fictional chef has become a style icon, body art included: His J.Crew cashmere sweater went viral and sold out, and Reddit is rife with fans showing off their Bear-inspired tattoos (the kitchen knife going through a hand is a popular one).
paras.zh: 在卡米的左前臂上放置一个带有地球仪的耐热玻璃测量玻璃——这是入选的 15 幅草图之一——是这位演员的创意。这位虚构的厨师已成为时尚偶像，其中包括人体艺术：他的 J.Crew 羊绒毛衣走红并被抢购一空，Reddit 上到处都是粉丝炫耀他们的熊纹身（穿过手的菜刀是一种流行的纹身）。

paras.en: Working on the Emmy-winning Hulu/FX series has been a full-circle moment for the onetime pizza delivery driver (in his hometown of Rochester, New York) whose first tattoo was inspired by his slice-slinging life. Before his West Coast move, Shields briefly worked for a hip-hop producer in Queens and apprenticed at a local tattoo shop “because I was out of options. I wasn’t trying to be an artist, but I was always good at doodling,” he says.
paras.zh: 对于这位曾经的披萨外卖司机（在他的家乡纽约州罗彻斯特）来说，制作获得艾美奖的 Hulu/FX 系列是一个完整的时刻，他的第一个纹身的灵感来自于他的切片生活。在搬到西海岸之前，希尔兹曾短暂为皇后区的一家嘻哈制作人工作，并在当地一家纹身店当学徒，“因为我别无选择。我并不想成为一名艺术家，但我总是擅长涂鸦，”他说。

paras.en: Shields arrived in L.A. in 2007 with a bag full of tattoo gear and soon earned such clients as Breaking Bad’s Matt Jones and Hilary Duff, whom he inked, along with her bridesmaids, ahead of her 2010 wedding to NHL player Mike Comrie.
paras.zh: 2007 年，小希尔兹带着装满纹身装备的袋子抵达洛杉矶，很快就赢得了《绝命毒师》中的马特·琼斯和希拉里·达芙等客户，在 2010 年她与 NHL 球员迈克·科姆里 (Mike Comrie) 举行婚礼之前，小希尔兹和希拉里·达芙以及她的伴娘们都为她们纹上了纹身。

paras.en: When Gosling called, Shields had a steady job building recording studios (“the money was better”) and tattooing friends including such industry pals as Honey Boy director Alma Har’el, who would later ask Shields to whip up tattoo designs for her 2019 film starring Shia LaBeouf.
paras.zh: 当高斯林打来电话时，希尔兹有一份稳定的工作，负责建造录音室（“钱更好”），并为朋友纹身，其中包括《蜂蜜男孩》导演阿尔玛·哈雷尔等业界好友，后者后来要求希尔兹为她 2019 年由希亚·拉博夫主演的电影制作纹身设计。

paras.en: Shields also created the hand-poked-style pieces for Alien: Romulus (he and director Fede Álvarez met through their kids’ preschool), which “had tons of Easter eggs,” but they never got their close-up. “There’s so much stuff in those tattoos, and then you don’t even see them because they have long sleeves on and everyone dies,” jokes Shields.
paras.zh: 希尔兹还为《异形：罗慕路斯》创作了手戳风格的作品（他和导演费德·阿尔瓦雷斯是通过孩子的幼儿园认识的），其中“有大量的复活节彩蛋”，但他们从未得到过特写镜头。 “这些纹身里有很多东西，然后你甚至看不到它们，因为它们有长袖，每个人都会死，”希尔兹开玩笑说。

paras.en: With The Bear done after five seasons, Shields is wrapping up his residency with Filson, where he’s bringing his fine-lined, black-and-white designs to the outdoor clothing brand’s Seattle store (Oct. 9 and 10) after stops in L.A. and Chicago. He’s also back into music, designing and building a recording studio for Grammy-winning producer Noah Goldstein (who has worked with Rosalía, Frank Ocean, Travis Scott and Ye) in Cypress Park.
paras.zh: 《The Bear》五季结束后，希尔兹即将结束他在 Filson 的驻场演出，在洛杉矶和芝加哥停留之后，他将在该户外服装品牌的西雅图店（10 月 9 日至 10 日）将其精美的黑白设计带到该户外服装品牌的西雅图店。他还重返音乐界，为格莱美获奖制作人诺亚·戈德斯坦（曾与罗莎莉亚、弗兰克·奥申、特拉维斯·斯科特和叶合作过）在赛普拉斯公园设计和建造了一个录音室。

paras.en: Like his tattoo appointments, Hollywood jobs have been word-of-mouth — there’s not exactly an agent for movie tattoo artists, after all. “I’m not in a guild, and I’m not a makeup person. I’m below the line,” he says. “But I’d be foolish to not be grateful; it could have been anyone. People try so hard to find their way in.”
paras.zh: 就像他的纹身预约一样，好莱坞的工作也是口口相传的——毕竟，电影纹身艺术家并没有真正的经纪人。 “我不属于公会，我也不是化妆师。我处于底线以下，”他说。 “但如果我不心存感激，那我就太愚蠢了；可能是任何人。人们非常努力地想找到入口。”

articles.title: AI’s quiet safety gatekeepers are stepping into the spotlight

paras.en: Two months ago, independent evaluators occupied a relatively sleepy corner of the multitrillion-dollar artificial intelligence industry. Now they're being asked to come to its rescue.
paras.zh: 两个月前，独立评估者占据了价值数万亿美元的人工智能行业一个相对沉寂的角落。现在他们被要求前来救援。

paras.en: While Anthropic and OpenAI are at the heart of a fierce debate over whether they can safeguard their advanced models and grow their businesses simultaneously, they're seeking support from a handful of small third-party groups like Model Evaluation and Threat Research (METR), Apollo Research, and Transluce.
paras.zh: 虽然 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 处于激烈争论的核心，即他们是否可以保护其先进模型并同时发展其业务，但他们正在寻求模型评估和威胁研究 (METR)、Apollo Research 和 Transluce 等少数小型第三方团体的支持。

paras.en: The evaluators, which mostly operate as nonprofits, are still finding their footing in an industry where capital is flowing at historic levels and new models are rolling out faster than ever. Their primary role has been to assess AI model capabilities and risks and to flag instances where the technology behaves badly.
paras.zh: 评估机构大多以非营利组织的形式运作，他们仍在资本流动达到历史水平、新模式推出速度比以往任何时候都快的行业中找到自己的立足点。他们的主要作用是评估人工智能模型的能力和风险，并标记技术表现不佳的实例。

paras.en: Without a federal push for regulation, evaluators have taken on outsized importance. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pledged to embed independent evaluators in his company last month – a move that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman quickly endorsed. President Donald Trump supported the idea, as did most of the largest U.S. tech companies. But left unanswered are questions about how those third parties should be funded, what level of access they will have and what the reporting structure will ultimately look like.
paras.zh: 如果没有联邦政府推动监管，评估人员就变得异常重要。 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 上个月承诺在他的公司中嵌入独立评估员，这一举措得到了 OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 的迅速认可。唐纳德·特朗普总统和大多数美国最大的科技公司都支持这一想法。但尚未得到解答的问题包括这些第三方应如何获得资助、他们将拥有什么级别的访问权限以及报告结构最终会是什么样子。

paras.en: "To a degree, the problem, as always, is money," Suresh Venkatasubramanian, a computer science professor at Brown University, told CNBC in an interview. "Who is paying for these companies to do their work? How are they going to support them? You need an ecosystem, you need a viable business model for this."
paras.zh: 布朗大学计算机科学教授苏雷什·文卡塔苏布拉马尼安 (Suresh Venkatasubramanian) 在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“在某种程度上，问题始终是钱。” “谁为这些公司的工作付费？他们将如何支持他们？你需要一个生态系统，为此需要一个可行的商业模式。”

paras.en: Right now, Anthropic, OpenAI and the infrastructure partners that are profiting from the AI boom are writing the rules. Critics say that's like asking the biggest banks to protect us from a financial crisis or allowing pharmaceutical companies to put drugs on the market without regulatory clearance.
paras.zh: 目前，Anthropic、OpenAI 和从人工智能热潮中获利的基础设施合作伙伴正在制定规则。批评者说，这就像要求最大的银行保护我们免受金融危机的影响，或者允许制药公司在没有监管许可的情况下将药品投放市场。

paras.en: Trump recently lauded AI executives for their "tremendous self-policing," and signaled that he intends to leave companies to their own devices, unwilling to impede the growth of the industry that's driving the economy and stock market. The president encouraged AI companies to "partner with an independent external auditor or evaluator" as part of a voluntary accord he presented in late September.
paras.zh: 特朗普最近称赞人工智能高管“强大的自我监管”，并表示他打算让公司自行其是，不愿阻碍推动经济和股市的行业增长。总统鼓励人工智能公司“与独立的外部审计师或评估员合作”，作为他在 9 月底提出的自愿协议的一部分。

paras.en: Amodei kicked off the conversation in his viral essay last month, when he called for a "slower pace" in advanced model development after researchers left his company and voiced concerns about the existential threats the technology poses.
paras.zh: 阿莫迪上个月在他的病毒式文章中拉开了这场对话的序幕，在研究人员离开他的公司后，他呼吁先进模型的开发“放慢步伐”，并对这项技术带来的生存威胁表示担忧。

paras.en: As AI labs move to put evaluators in place, friction is already emerging.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能实验室开始安排评估人员，摩擦已经出现。

paras.en: OpenAI fired three employees last week for "violating our policies on accessing and handling sensitive company information," according to a spokesperson. Two of those employees, Mikita Balesni and Tomek Korbak, said they believe they were dismissed because of how they communicated with third-party evaluators.
paras.zh: 一位发言人表示，OpenAI 上周解雇了三名员工，理由是“违反了我们有关访问和处理敏感公司信息的政策”。其中两名员工 Mikita Balesni 和 Tomek Korbak 表示，他们认为自己被解雇是因为与第三方评估人员的沟通方式。

paras.en: "My former colleagues are telling me they are confused about what to believe," Balesni wrote in a post on X on Thursday. "They also are afraid to speak, and worry their personal phones will be searched for messages to us and third parties. I worry the pervading fear to speak up and engage with third parties will mean OpenAI will cut corners on safety behind closed doors."
paras.zh: “我以前的同事告诉我，他们对于该相信什么感到困惑，”周四，巴尔斯尼在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道。 “他们也不敢说话，担心他们的个人手机会被搜查，以获取发给我们和第三方的消息。我担心，普遍害怕发声并与第三方接触，这意味着 OpenAI 会在安全方面偷工减料。”

paras.en: OpenAI disputed that characterization and said in a post on Friday that it's "actively finalizing contracts with third-party safety assessors and will announce details in the coming weeks."
paras.zh: OpenAI 对这种描述提出异议，并在周五的一篇文章中表示，它“正在积极与第三方安全评估机构敲定合同，并将在未来几周内公布细节。”

paras.en: "We are committed to embedding external assessors and continue to make close collaboration with independent safety organizations a core part of our safety work," OpenAI wrote.
paras.zh: OpenAI 写道：“我们致力于嵌入外部评估人员，并继续与独立安全组织密切合作，作为我们安全工作的核心部分。”

paras.en: An OpenAI spokesperson said in an emailed statement that its upcoming work with evaluators "builds on existing collaboration with independent safety organizations," including METR and Redwood Research.
paras.zh: OpenAI 发言人在一份电子邮件声明中表示，其即将与评估人员合作“建立在与 METR 和 Redwood Research 等独立安全组织的现有合作基础上”。

paras.en: Anthropic didn't respond to CNBC's request for comment.
paras.zh: Anthropic 没有回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

paras.en: The AI evaluator ecosystem consists mostly of small organizations, including METR and Apollo Research, and larger accounting and auditing firms like Accenture.
paras.zh: 人工智能评估者生态系统主要由 METR 和 Apollo Research 等小型组织以及埃森哲等大型会计和审计公司组成。

paras.en: AI labs have worked with evaluators in limited capacities, but Andrew Freedman, CEO of policy nonprofit Fathom, said the field is maturing quickly.
paras.zh: 人工智能实验室与评估人员的合作能力有限，但政策非营利组织 Fathom 的首席执行官安德鲁·弗里德曼 (Andrew Freedman) 表示，该领域正在迅速成熟。

paras.en: "I've worked in politics and policy for the last 20 years of my life, and I've never seen an issue move so fast on so many different political spectrums," Freedman told CNBC in an interview. He said he expects an "influx of capital" to flow into the ecosystem.
paras.zh: 弗里德曼在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“我生命的最后 20 年一直从事政治和政策工作，我从未见过一个问题在如此多不同的政治领域发展得如此之快。”他表示，预计“资本涌入”将流入该生态系统。

paras.en: Rayan Krishnan, CEO of independent evaluator Vals AI, said his for-profit startup, which builds benchmarks to measure how AI models perform on industry-specific tasks, has grown from eight employees to roughly 30 this year and announced a $40 million funding round in August.
paras.zh: 独立评估机构 Vals AI 的首席执行官 Rayan Krishnan 表示，他的营利性初创公司致力于建立基准来衡量人工智能模型在特定行业任务上的表现，今年员工人数已从 8 名增加到大约 30 名，并于 8 月宣布完成 4000 万美元的融资。

paras.en: METR, a nonprofit, announced in August that it had raised commitments of around $71 million over the last six months. That's up from total 2024 contributions of $13.6 million, according to the group's most recent filing with the Internal Revenue Service.
paras.zh: 非营利组织 METR 在 8 月份宣布，它在过去六个月内筹集了约 7100 万美元的承诺。根据该组织最近向国税局提交的文件，这一数字高于 2024 年 1,360 万美元的捐款总额。

paras.en: By late that month, METR's profile had risen further. OpenAI enlisted two of its employees and a contractor to put together a postmortem report detailing how the company's models escaped containment, accessed the open internet and breached open-source developer platform Hugging Face. METR said it did not accept payment from OpenAI for the assessment.
paras.zh: 到该月底，METR 的知名度进一步提升。 OpenAI 招募了两名员工和一名承包商来编写一份事后报告，详细说明该公司的模型如何逃脱遏制、访问开放互联网以及如何破坏开源开发者平台 Hugging Face。 METR 表示不接受 OpenAI 的评估付款。

paras.en: Kevin Werbach, faculty director of the Wharton Accountable AI Lab at the University of Pennsylvania, said the ecosystem is "not robust enough right now." For example, METR employs fewer than 50 full-time staffers, according to its website.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院责任人工智能实验室教务主任凯文·韦巴赫 (Kevin Werbach) 表示，该生态系统“目前还不够强大”。例如，根据 METR 网站的信息，该公司雇佣的全职员工不到 50 名。

paras.en: The power imbalance between small evaluators and leading labs that have raised tens of billions of dollars and employ thousands of people raises questions about potential conflicts.
paras.zh: 小型评估人员与筹集了数百亿美元并雇用数千名员工的领先实验室之间的权力不平衡引发了人们对潜在冲突的质疑。

paras.en: "If you want true third-party evaluation, you need true independence financially and otherwise," said Venkatasubramanian. "It's not just a matter of not getting paid, it's a matter of, will there be consequences if I am an auditor and I put out a report that looks unfavorable to this company? Is my business going to dry up?"
paras.zh: “如果你想要真正的第三方评估，你就需要在财务和其他方面真正的独立，”Venkatasubramanian 说。 “这不仅仅是拿不到报酬的问题，而是如果我是一名审计师，我发布了一份看起来对这家公司不利的报告，会产生什么后果吗？我的业务会枯竭吗？”

paras.en: Anthropic acknowledged the complexity in a blog post last month, announcing it will embed employees from Faculty, Accenture's specialist AI business, to test safeguards and assess whether models will behave in line with human values. Anthropic said that "given the importance and urgency of this work," it will fund Accenture's contributions directly.
paras.zh: Anthropic 在上个月的一篇博客文章中承认了这一问题的复杂性，并宣布将聘请埃森哲专业人工智能业务部门的员工来测试保障措施并评估模型的行为是否符合人类价值观。 Anthropic 表示，“鉴于这项工作的重要性和紧迫性”，它将直接资助埃森哲的捐款。

paras.en: "There are, as yet, no standards for what information embedded evaluators should have access to, or how they should report what they find. There is also no settled system for funding independent evaluation," Anthropic said. "Long-term, we think funding should come from pooled or government sources."
paras.zh: Anthropic 表示：“到目前为止，还没有关于嵌入式评估人员应该访问哪些信息，或者他们应该如何报告他们发现的信息的标准。也没有固定的系统来资助独立评估。” “从长远来看，我们认为资金应该来自集体或政府来源。”

paras.en: Anthropic said it's in discussions with METR and other nonprofit evaluators that are planning to use their own funding to pilot "elements" of embedded evaluation.
paras.zh: Anthropic 表示，它正在与 METR 和其他非营利评估机构进行讨论，这些评估机构计划使用自己的资金来试点嵌入式评估的“要素”。

paras.en: In June of last year, Fathom introduced a marketplace framework for Independent Verification Organizations, or IVOs. The government would license these groups and authorize them to test whether AI companies meet various safety criteria.
paras.zh: 去年 6 月，Fathom 推出了独立验证组织 (IVO) 的市场框架。政府将向这些团体发放许可证，并授权他们测试人工智能公司是否符合各种安全标准。

paras.en: Freedman, the group's CEO, said government oversight is key because, without it, third-party evaluators could become beholden to large AI labs for revenue, incentivizing them to "start rubber-stamping stuff" to maintain favor.
paras.zh: 该组织首席执行官弗里德曼表示，政府监督至关重要，因为如果没有政府监督，第三方评估人员可能会受制于大型人工智能实验室的收入，从而激励他们“开始橡皮图章”以维持青睐。

paras.en: IVOs are a key provision of the ''Frontier Risk Oversight, National Transparency, Independent Evaluation, and Reporting" (FRONTIER) Act, which Reps. Lori Trahan, D-Mass., and Jay Obernolte, R-Calif., introduced in July. Freedman said Fathom helped draft language and provided technical expertise for the bill.
paras.zh: IVO 是《边境风险监督、国家透明度、独立评估和报告》(FRONTIER) 法案的一项关键条款，该法案由马萨诸塞州民主党众议员洛里·特拉汉 (Lori Trahan) 和加利福尼亚州共和党众议员杰伊·奥伯诺特 (Jay Obernolte) 于 7 月提出。弗里德曼表示，Fathom 帮助起草了该法案的措辞并提供了技术专业知识。

paras.en: OpenAI global affairs chief Chris Lehane told reporters in September that he sat down with one of the bill's sponsors on Capitol Hill to express support for the IVO provision.
paras.zh: OpenAI 全球事务负责人 Chris Lehane 在 9 月份告诉记者，他在国会山与该法案的一位发起人进行了会面，表达了对 IVO 条款的支持。

paras.en: "It was important for them to hear that and hear it from us, and we wanted to be really clear about that," Lehane said, according to reports.
paras.zh: 据报道，勒哈恩说：“对他们来说，听到这一点并从我们这里听到这一点很重要，我们希望真正清楚这一点。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, lawmakers in California, Connecticut and Virginia have taken steps to implement IVOs, and states like Massachusetts are weighing independent safety evaluations more broadly.
paras.zh: 与此同时，加利福尼亚州、康涅狄格州和弗吉尼亚州的立法者已采取措施实施 IVO，马萨诸塞州等州正在更广泛地权衡独立安全评估。

paras.en: California Governor Gavin Newsom recently signed two bills involving IVOs, one establishing a "first-in-the-nation framework," and the other creating a state registry for AI auditors. Anthropic threw its support behind both bills in August, and OpenAI formally endorsed them last month, the same day Newsom signed them into law.
paras.zh: 加州州长加文·纽瑟姆 (Gavin Newsom) 最近签署了两项涉及 IVO 的法案，其中一项建立了“全国首个框架”，另一项则为人工智能审计师创建了州注册机构。 Anthropic 在 8 月份对这两项法案表示支持，OpenAI 上个月正式支持了这些法案，同一天，纽瑟姆将它们签署为法律。

paras.en: Lehane wrote in a blog post at the time that "we prefer independent technical assessments to be required at the federal level," but in the absence of federal action, "California can help establish the rules of the road."
paras.zh: 勒哈恩当时在一篇博客文章中写道，“我们更希望在联邦层面进行独立的技术评估”，但在联邦政府不采取行动的情况下，“加州可以帮助制定道路规则。”

paras.en: Freedman said he thinks it will be "really difficult" for companies like OpenAI and Anthropic to work out how to engage with independent evaluators on their own. However, with the government's role unclear, "it's a muscle worth developing in the interim," he said.
paras.zh: Freedman 表示，他认为对于 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 这样的公司来说，自行研究如何与独立评估者合作将“非常困难”。然而，由于政府的角色不明确，“这是一个值得暂时发展的力量，”他说。

paras.en: For now, the industry's closest thing to a set of standards is what Trump called a "morally binding" agreement at a luncheon he hosted for tech leaders at the White House late last month.
paras.zh: 目前，该行业最接近一套标准的是特朗普上个月末在白宫为科技领导人举办的午餐会上所说的“具有道德约束力”的协议。

paras.en: The one-page accord says that "every company is responsible for developing its own technology safely and in a way that builds trust with customers and the public." It also encourages signees to work with an "independent external auditor or evaluator to carry out independent assessments."
paras.zh: 这份一页纸的协议称，“每家公司都有责任安全地开发自己的技术，并以建立客户和公众信任的方式。”它还鼓励签名者与“独立的外部审计员或评估员合作进行独立评估”。

paras.en: Top execs at Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, SpaceX and Nvidia signed the document, in a rare show of solidarity between leaders who have shared conflicting views on addressing AI's risks. The executives still have to chart their own paths forward.
paras.zh: Anthropic、谷歌、Meta、OpenAI、SpaceX 和 Nvidia 的高管签署了这份文件，这是在解决人工智能风险问题上持有不同观点的领导人之间罕见的团结一致。高管们仍然必须规划自己的前进道路。

paras.en: "It was a performance of an attempt to show action when in fact no action actually happened," Venkatasubramanian said. "The things that they promise to do are things they should have been doing already, and, in fact, have claimed that they were doing in the past."
paras.zh: 文卡塔苏布拉马尼安说：“这是一场试图展示行动的表演，但实际上并没有发生任何行动。” “他们承诺做的事情是他们应该已经做的事情，而且事实上，他们声称他们过去就做过。”

paras.en: Amodei, in his September essay, said Anthropic will equip evaluators with desks, access badges, company laptops, and permissions that are "mostly comparable" to internal risk assessment teams. Additionally, evaluators will be supported with contracts that give them "the right to publish key findings," with Anthropic reserving "the narrow ability" to redact certain security-sensitive or confidential information.
paras.zh: Amodei 在他 9 月份的文章中表示，Anthropic 将为评估人员配备办公桌、访问徽章、公司笔记本电脑和与内部风险评估团队“基本相当”的权限。此外，评估人员将获得合同的支持，赋予他们“发布关键发现的权利”，而 Anthropic 保留编辑某些安全敏感或机密信息的“狭隘能力”。

paras.en: "This is an unusual step for a company, but we think it is important to prove out the concept of embedded external reviewers," Amodei wrote.
paras.zh: 阿莫代写道：“这对于一家公司来说是不寻常的一步，但我们认为证明嵌入式外部评审员的概念很重要。”

paras.en: OpenAI published its own proposal days later, and said evaluators should work on "scoped and mutually agreed upon claims for assessment," clearly explain their methodology and standards, demonstrate relevant technical expertise and disclose conflicts of interest.
paras.zh: 几天后，OpenAI 发布了自己的提案，并表示评估人员应致力于“范围内且双方商定的评估要求”，明确解释其方法和标准，展示相关技术专业知识并披露利益冲突。

paras.en: The AI Evaluator Forum, which includes METR, the AI Verification and Evaluation Research Institute (AVERI), and other groups, published a public letter last month titled, "Minimum Conditions for Embedding Evaluators."
paras.zh: 包括 METR、人工智能验证与评估研究所 (AVERI) 和其他团体在内的人工智能评估者论坛上个月发表了一封题为“嵌入评估者的最低条件”的公开信。

paras.en: The letter said evaluators should be transparent, shielded from retaliation and granted access equivalent to AI companies' "own highly privileged employees."
paras.zh: 这封信称，评估人员应该保持透明，免受报复，并授予与人工智能公司“拥有高度特权的员工”同等的访问权限。

paras.en: "Embedded evaluations cannot address all oversight needs and should be treated as a complement to, rather than a replacement for, broader efforts by frontier AI companies to expand external oversight," the letter said.
paras.zh: 信中称：“嵌入式评估无法满足所有监督需求，应被视为对前沿人工智能公司扩大外部监督的更广泛努力的补充，而不是替代。”

paras.en: Freedman said he's seen a shift in posturing from OpenAI and Anthropic in recent months, largely because they've realized they can't roll out their advanced systems without the public's trust.
paras.zh: Freedman 表示，近几个月来，他看到 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的态度发生了转变，这主要是因为他们意识到，如果没有公众的信任，他们就无法推出先进的系统。

paras.en: "I don't think you need to trust that they've suddenly turned altruistic or that there's anything but corporations acting like corporations," Freedman said.
paras.zh: 弗里德曼说：“我认为你不需要相信他们突然变得无私，或者除了公司表现得像公司之外什么都没有。”

paras.en: That underscores perhaps the central problem, Werbach said. OpenAI and Anthropic are, first and foremost, competing as they march toward the public markets and seek trillion-dollar-plus valuations.
paras.zh: 韦巴赫说，这也许凸显了核心问题。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 在进军公开市场并寻求超过万亿美元的估值时，首先是在竞争。

paras.en: "There is a tremendous amount of personal distrust between those two companies," Werbach said. "Even though there's also tremendous agreement about the need for this kind of evaluation to happen."
paras.zh: “这两家公司之间存在巨大的个人不信任，”韦巴赫说。 “尽管人们对于进行这种评估的必要性也达成了巨大的共识。”

articles.title: Trump says he is 'going to look at' joining Saudi Arabia in the fight against Iran-backed Houthis after deadly airport strike

paras.en: President Donald Trump said he is considering joining Saudi Arabia in its retaliation against Tehran-backed Houthis in Yemen after a deadly attack on Riyadh's main airport, a move that could draw the U.S. further into a second front in the Iran war.
paras.zh: 美国总统特朗普表示，在利雅得主要机场遭受致命袭击后，他正在考虑与沙特阿拉伯一起对德黑兰支持的也门胡塞武装进行报复，此举可能将美国进一步拖入伊朗战争的第二条战线。

paras.en: "We may. We're going to look at it," Trump told reporters outside the White House on Saturday when asked if the U.S. would back Saudi Arabian strikes. "We just found out about the recent attack. So, we'll make a decision. We move very quickly."
paras.zh: 当被问及美国是否会支持沙特阿拉伯的袭击时，特朗普周六在白宫外对记者说：“我们可能会考虑。” “我们刚刚发现最近发生的袭击事件。所以，我们会做出决定。我们行动非常快。”

paras.en: Two Saudi Arabian government officials told MS NOW that the kingdom is requesting "urgent defense support" from the U.S. following the attacks.
paras.zh: 两名沙特阿拉伯政府官员告诉《MS NOW》，袭击发生后，该国正在请求美国提供“紧急防务支持”。

paras.en: The officials, including a senior member of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, did not want to be identified because of the matter's sensitivity. They added that the U.S. needs to intervene "as soon as possible" to help the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen fight the Houthis.
paras.zh: 由于此事敏感性，包括外交部一名高级官员在内的官员不愿透露姓名。他们补充说，美国需要“尽快”干预，帮助沙特领导的也门联军打击胡塞武装。

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to a CNBC request for comment.
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

paras.en: On Sunday, a projectile struck a passenger terminal at the Riyadh airport, one day after a missile struck the same terminal, the Associated Press reported. No immediate details were available about the latest strike on the King Khalid International Airport complex for terminals 3 and 4 for domestic flights, AP said.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，周日，一枚导弹袭击了利雅得机场的一个客运航站楼，一天前，一枚导弹击中了同一航站楼。美联社称，目前还没有关于哈立德国王国际机场 3 号和 4 号国内航班航站楼最近一次罢工的详细信息。

paras.en: The Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation said Saturday's attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh killed 12 people and injured 309 others, the country's official Saudi Gazette media outlet reported.
paras.zh: 据沙特官方媒体《沙特公报》报道，沙特民航总局表示，周六利雅得哈立德国王国际机场发生的袭击造成 12 人死亡、309 人受伤。

paras.en: Colonel Turki Al-Maliki, the spokesman for the Saudi-led Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen, which has been leading the fight against the Houthis, described the attack as a "war crime."
paras.zh: 沙特领导的支持也门合法性联盟的发言人图尔基·马利基上校称这次袭击是“战争罪”，该联盟一直领导打击胡塞武装。

paras.en: "Therefore, the Joint Forces Command of the Coalition will respond decisively to this terrorist attack in accordance with the Customary International Humanitarian Law," Al-Maliki said in a post on X.
paras.zh: 马利基在 X 网站上发帖称：“因此，联军联合部队司令部将根据习惯国际人道主义法对这次恐怖袭击做出果断反应。”

paras.en: It was the second deadly assault on Riyadh's airport in less than a week.
paras.zh: 这是不到一周内利雅得机场发生的第二起致命袭击事件。

paras.en: Three Saudi nationals, including a pilot, were killed in attacks on the facility by Iran-backed Houthi militants on Thursday.
paras.zh: 周四，包括一名飞行员在内的三名沙特国民在伊朗支持的胡塞武装分子对该设施的袭击中丧生。

paras.en: Following Saturday's attack, the Houthis renewed their warning against using Saudi airports.
paras.zh: 周六袭击事件发生后，胡塞武装再次警告不要使用沙特机场。

paras.en: "We renew our warning to all airlines, experts, employees, workers and travellers against using Saudi airports and airspace, as they are vulnerable to attack and have become a theatre of operations for our forces, with the exception of the airports in (the holy cities of) Mecca and Medina," the Houthis said in a post on X.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装在 X 网站上发帖称：“我们再次警告所有航空公司、专家、雇员、工人和旅客，不要使用沙特机场和领空，因为它们很容易受到攻击，并且已成为我们部队的行动战场，但麦加和麦地那（圣城）的机场除外。”

paras.en: Saudi Arabia, a key U.S. ally in the Middle East, intervened in Yemen's civil war between the Houthis and its internationally recognized government after the group seized the Yemeni capital Sanaa in 2014.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯是美国在中东的重要盟友，在胡塞武装于2014年占领也门首都萨那后，该组织介入了也门胡塞武装与其国际公认政府之间的内战。

paras.en: Last month, the Trump administration approved the potential $24.3 billion sale of nearly 50 F-35 warplanes to Saudi Arabia in what was seen as a major boost for the kingdom as it faces intensifying attacks from the Houthis. The sale is under congressional review.
paras.zh: 上个月，特朗普政府批准了可能以 243 亿美元的价格向沙特阿拉伯出售近 50 架 F-35 战机，这被视为对沙特面临胡塞武装袭击加剧的重大推动。此次出售正在接受国会审查。

paras.en: The Saudi energy ministry said a long-planned international energy conference will still take place in Riyadh on Sunday, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，沙特能源部表示，一场计划已久的国际能源会议仍将于周日在利雅得举行。

paras.en: The five-day WPC Energy Congress is taking place at a convention center near King Khalid airport. State television told Reuters that more than 70 ministers, 300 company executives and representatives of more than 25 international energy organizations have confirmed their attendance, though it was not clear whether the participants would attend in person or virtually.
paras.zh: 为期五天的 WPC 能源大会将在哈立德国王机场附近的会议中心举行。国家电视台告诉路透社，超过 70 名部长、300 名公司高管以及超过 25 个国际能源组织的代表已确认出席，但尚不清楚参与者是亲自出席还是以虚拟形式出席。

paras.en: Reuters said a ministerial meeting of the International Energy Forum is also set to take place, with its plenary session to be held behind closed doors.
paras.zh: 路透社称，国际能源论坛部长级会议也将举行，全体会议将闭门举行。

paras.en: In addition to attacks on civil aviation, the Houthis have also been trying to choke off oil tanker traffic through the Bab el Mandeb strait, a key entry point to the Red Sea, as Iran has effectively done in the Strait of Hormuz to the north of the Arabian Peninsula.
paras.zh: 除了对民航发动袭击外，胡塞武装还试图切断通过曼德布海峡的油轮运输，曼德海峡是红海的一个关键入口，伊朗在阿拉伯半岛北部的霍尔木兹海峡实际上就是这样做的。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Yemeni government forces said they reclaimed the strategic port city of Mokha from the Houthis.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，也门政府军表示，他们从胡塞武装手中夺回了战略港口城市莫卡。

paras.en: Energy prices have soared since the start of the Iran war, which began with U.S. and Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets on Feb. 28, putting pressure on consumers globally.
paras.zh: 自2月28日美国和以色列对伊朗目标发动空袭以来，伊朗战争爆发，能源价格飙升，给全球消费者带来了压力。

paras.en: The surge in domestic fuel prices has been a key issue for voters ahead of next month's U.S. midterm elections.
paras.zh: 在下个月的美国中期选举之前，国内燃油价格飙升一直是选民关注的一个关键问题。

paras.en: But that support would be expensive militarily.
paras.zh: 但这种支持在军事上代价高昂。

paras.en: "Potential U.S. involvement in the Saudi-Yemeni government air campaign to degrade Houthi ballistic missile capabilities would mark the first direct U.S. military action against the group since the conclusion of Operation Rough Rider in May 2025," according to the Critical Threats Project, part of the American Enterprise Institute think tank.
paras.zh: 美国企业研究所智囊团“关键威胁项目”表示，“美国可能参与沙特-也门政府旨在削弱胡塞武装弹道导弹能力的空袭，这将标志着自 2025 年 5 月“粗暴骑士行动”结束以来，美国首次针对该组织采取直接军事行动。”

paras.en: The offensive aimed to suppress the Houthis' capabilities, but recent attacks show the group has regrouped.
paras.zh: 这次攻势旨在压制胡塞武装的能力，但最近的袭击表明该组织已经重新集结。

paras.en: "After seven months of war, there are questions about the U.S. capacity to wage a sustained campaign against the Houthis, return to combat against Iran if necessary, and prepare for contingencies in other parts of the world, notably East Asia," Steven Cook, an expert on Arab and Turkish politics at the Council on Foreign Relations think tank, wrote last month.
paras.zh: 美国外交关系委员会智囊团阿拉伯和土耳其政治专家史蒂文·库克上个月写道：“经过七个月的战争，人们对美国是否有能力对胡塞武装发动持续的打击、在必要时重返打击伊朗以及为世界其他地区（尤其是东亚）的突发事件做好准备的能力表示怀疑。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, the United Kingdom's defense secretary said his government is also examining how to support Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 与此同时，英国国防部长表示，英国政府也在研究如何支持沙特阿拉伯。

paras.en: "I've spoken to my Saudi counterpart [Khalid bin Salman] on a number of occasions in recent weeks to look at what more we can do to support Saudi Arabia, and I'm afraid last night explains precisely why we are providing that support," Wes Streeting said in an interview on BBC television on Sunday.
paras.zh: 韦斯·斯特里廷周日在接受 BBC 电视台采访时表示：“最近几周，我多次与沙特外长（哈立德·本·萨勒曼）交谈，探讨我们还能做些什么来支持沙特阿拉伯，恐怕昨晚就准确地解释了我们提供这种支持的原因。”

paras.en: Streeting said the U.K. is not getting involved in offensive operations "at this stage."
paras.zh: 斯特里廷表示，英国“现阶段”不会参与进攻行动。

paras.en: "We've always been clear that there isn't a military solution to this conflict," Streeting added.
paras.zh: “我们一直明确表示，这场冲突没有军事解决方案，”斯特里廷补充道。

articles.title: From BJ’s to Lululemon, retailers are trimming assortments to boost business

paras.en: Retailers are trimming assortments in an effort to clean up their balance sheets.
paras.zh: 零售商正在削减产品种类，以清理资产负债表。

paras.en: As shoppers cut spending in the face of high gas and food prices, businesses have pulled more levers to boost profitability and appease investors. During earnings calls this year, a range of retailers have highlighted efforts to reduce the number of items they sell, commonly tracked as stock keeping units, or SKUs.
paras.zh: 随着消费者在汽油和食品价格高涨的情况下削减支出，企业采取了更多杠杆措施来提高盈利能力并安抚投资者。在今年的财报电话会议上，许多零售商都强调了减少销售商品数量的努力，这些商品通常被称为库存单位（SKU）。

paras.en: In March, Dollar General said it trimmed 1,500 SKUs. In August, Under Armour said it shrunk SKUs by 25% over the past few years and plans to cut another 25%, while BJ's Wholesale Club said it plans to reduce roughly 20% of SKUs. In September, Lululemon said it cut North America SKUs by 15%.
paras.zh: 3 月份，Dollar General 表示削减了 1,500 个 SKU。 8月份，Under Armour表示，过去几年将SKU减少了25%，并计划再削减25%，而BJ's Wholesale Club则表示计划减少约20%的SKU。 9 月，Lululemon 表示将北美 SKU 削减了 15%。

paras.en: Trimming inventory can help a business stabilize its sales or even get back to growth, and can reduce the chances a company gets stuck with unwanted inventory. But the move can also leave consumers with less choice — a trade-off many retailers have been willing to make.
paras.zh: 削减库存可以帮助企业稳定销售甚至恢复增长，并可以减少公司陷入不必要库存的机会。但此举也可能导致消费者的选择减少——这是许多零售商一直愿意做出的权衡。

paras.en: When a brand struggles to sell certain products, it can lead to discounting, which hurts profitability. Some markdowns are expected when businesses roll the dice on new products that don't end up selling well, but too many promotions can cause problems.
paras.zh: 当一个品牌难以销售某些产品时，可能会导致折扣，从而损害盈利能力。当企业押注于最终销量不佳的新产品时，预计会出现一些降价，但过多的促销可能会导致问题。

paras.en: "If you have zero discounting, you're not taking enough fashion risk," said Guggenheim Securities senior retail analyst Simeon Siegel. "But discounting needs to be fixing mistakes. It needs to be done quickly."
paras.zh: 古根海姆证券公司高级零售分析师西蒙·西格尔表示：“如果你的折扣为零，那么你就没有承担足够的时尚风险。” “但打折需要纠正错误。需要尽快完成。”

paras.en: Under Armour and Lululemon are both facing repercussions from what investors see as too many markdowns.
paras.zh: Under Armour 和 Lululemon 都面临着投资者认为降价过多的影响。

paras.en: Under Armour's operating income, which illustrates its underlying profitability, turned negative in fiscal 2025 and 2026. The company said its problems would not be solved by chasing unhealthy sales volume or short-term revenue.
paras.zh: Under Armour 的营业收入（体现其潜在盈利能力）在 2025 财年和 2026 财年转为负值。该公司表示，通过追逐不健康的销量或短期收入无法解决其问题。

paras.en: "Today, we're managing for quality. Fewer products with greater purpose, tighter execution and a clear reason to buy," said Under Armour CEO Kevin Plank on the company's fiscal first-quarter earnings call in August. "We will sell so much more of so many less products at a much higher full retail price."
paras.zh: Under Armour 首席执行官凯文·普兰克 (Kevin Plank) 在公司 8 月份的第一财季财报电话会议上表示：“今天，我们正在追求质量。更少的产品，更大的目的，更严格的执行力和明确的购买理由。” “我们将以更高的零售价销售更多更少的产品。”

paras.en: Siegel said that when a retailer acknowledges it wants to shrink revenue, the goal is to regain pricing power.
paras.zh: 西格尔表示，当零售商承认想要缩减收入时，其目标就是重新获得定价权。

paras.en: Lululemon grew its sales by more than $500 million from fiscal 2024 to 2025. Yet its operating profit fell by about $300 million in the same time span. Shares are down around 65% over the past two years.
paras.zh: 从 2024 财年到 2025 财年，Lululemon 的销售额增长了超过 5 亿美元。但同期其营业利润却下降了约 3 亿美元。过去两年股价下跌约 65%。

paras.en: "Selling fewer options is not the same as selling fewer things," said Siegel. "Lulu has a long way to go, and simply cutting SKUs, simply saying we need to have better product is not the answer."
paras.zh: “出售更少的期权并不等同于出售更少的东西，”西格尔说。 “Lulu 还有很长的路要走，简单地削减 SKU、简单地说我们需要有更好的产品并不是答案。”

paras.en: Siegel said too much of even the best product can dilute the value of a brand.
paras.zh: 西格尔表示，即使是最好的产品，使用过多也会削弱品牌的价值。

paras.en: Lululemon reported $6.3 billion in U.S. sales in fiscal 2025. Siegel said $3 billion to $4 billion in domestic revenue is where companies typically hit a healthy saturation level.
paras.zh: Lululemon 报告称，2025 财年美国销售额为 63 亿美元。西格尔表示，国内收入在 30 亿至 40 亿美元之间时，公司通常会达到健康的饱和水平。

paras.en: "It's a level where they can be large and still cool. Above that, they start cheapening what they stand for, literally cheapening the product, but also cheapening the perception," said Siegel.
paras.zh: 西格尔说：“在这个水平上，它们可以很大，但仍然很酷。除此之外，它们开始降低它们所代表的东西的价格，实际上是降低了产品的价格，但也降低了人们的看法。”

paras.en: He noted that Nike is an exception to this rule, after posting $20 billion in North American sales in fiscal 2026.
paras.zh: 他指出，耐克是这一规则的例外，其 2026 财年北美销售额达到 200 亿美元。

paras.en: Still, the apparel and footwear giant, which has seen shares crater around 45% this year, said it is "rebalancing" its portfolio, having reduced revenue from classic footwear franchises by more than $2 billion in fiscal 2026, according to its fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter earnings call in June.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这家今年股价下跌约 45% 的服装和鞋类巨头表示，根据 6 月份的 2026 财年第四季度财报电话会议，公司正在“重新平衡”其投资组合，在 2026 财年将经典鞋类特许经营收入减少了超过 20 亿美元。

paras.en: For small-box stores such as Dollar General and big-box retailers like BJ's, cutting down the assortment doesn't necessarily give them the ability to raise prices.
paras.zh: 对于 Dollar General 等小型商店和 BJ's 等大型零售商来说，减少品种并不一定能让他们有能力提高价格。

paras.en: Rather, for those stores carrying thousands of brands, removing certain products can help them better manage inventory and refine their offerings to help stabilize the business.
paras.zh: 相反，对于那些拥有数千个品牌的商店来说，删除某些产品可以帮助他们更好地管理库存并改进产品，以帮助稳定业务。

paras.en: "When you shrink a box ... and say, I'm going to focus more on curation, you're getting smaller, but you're trying to reestablish why someone's walking into your box in the first place. And so it does get better, but it doesn't necessarily help your bottom line as much," said Siegel.
paras.zh: “当你缩小一个盒子......并说，我将更多地关注策划，你变得更小，但你试图重新确定为什么有人走进你的盒子。所以它确实会变得更好，但它不一定对你的利润有多大帮助，”西格尔说。

paras.en: BJ's CEO Robert Eddy said reducing choice, such as cutting the number of scents of body wash, pushes sales into the remaining products on shelves and then makes room for more product categories that weren't previously offered.
paras.zh: BJ 的首席执行官罗伯特·艾迪 (Robert Eddy) 表示，减少选择，例如减少沐浴露的香味数量，可以推动货架上剩余产品的销售，然后为更多以前未提供的产品类别腾出空间。

paras.en: "That is sourcing sales growth as well and sort of giving us the formula where we can cut SKUs, and see sales go up, and see margin dollars go up," Eddy said on the company's fiscal 2026 second-quarter earnings call in August.
paras.zh: Eddy 在该公司 8 月份的 2026 财年第二季度财报电话会议上表示：“这也促进了销售增长，并为我们提供了减少 SKU、销售额上升和利润率上升的公式。”

paras.en: In June 2025, Dollar General said the elimination of 1,000 SKUs from the previous year opened up more shelf space for its best-selling products and added to its top line. By March 2026, the company said, it had reduced up to 1,500 SKUs, providing benefits to the overall supply chain.
paras.zh: 2025 年 6 月，Dollar General 表示，去年减少了 1,000 个 SKU，为其最畅销的产品开辟了更多货架空间，并增加了其营收。该公司表示，到 2026 年 3 月，已减少了多达 1,500 个 SKU，为整个供应链带来了好处。

paras.en: "Being more productive there means getting product to the shelf faster and being there for the consumer with the right amount of items and products that she's looking for as quickly as we possibly can," Dollar General CEO Todd Vasos said in the company's fiscal 2026 second-quarter earnings call in August. "As we go forward, the team is looking at continued SKU rationalization, albeit probably more surgical in nature."
paras.zh: Dollar General 首席执行官托德·瓦索斯 (Todd Vasos) 在 8 月份的公司 2026 财年第二季度财报电话会议上表示：“提高生产效率意味着更快地将产品上架，并尽快为消费者提供所需数量的商品和产品。” “随着我们的前进，团队正在考虑持续的 SKU 合理化，尽管本质上可能更加手术化。”

paras.en: Successfully slashing products from shelves is difficult in practice.
paras.zh: 在实践中，成功地将产品从货架上砍下来是很困难的。

paras.en: Box stores risk losing customers to competitors that offer the products they scrapped. BJ's, for instance, acknowledged that a previous attempt to cut SKUs was unsuccessful.
paras.zh: 盒装商店可能会因为竞争对手提供他们报废的产品而失去客户。例如，BJ's 承认之前削减 SKU 的尝试并未成功。

paras.en: "We just cut SKUs which cut sales, and then we added some SKUs back and so really what we're doing now is removing unnecessary choice," Eddy said on the company's earnings call in August. "Think about in traditional soda, we don't carry cans and one-liters and two-liters of the same product anymore."
paras.zh: Eddy 在公司 8 月份的财报电话会议上表示：“我们只是削减了导致销售额下降的 SKU，然后又添加了一些 SKU，所以我们现在所做的实际上是消除不必要的选择。” “想想传统的苏打水，我们不再销售罐装以及一升和两升的同一产品。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, publicly traded brands that acknowledge sales need to decline in order for the business to grow still have answers to investors in the near term.
paras.zh: 与此同时，承认销售额需要下降才能实现业务增长的上市品牌在短期内仍能向投资者提供答案。

paras.en: "It's hard for a company ever to say we need to shrink anything, but it's dramatically harder to say we need to shrink revenues," said Siegel. "Frequently we find that brands hit a peak, a healthy peak, extend past the peak by forcing it and then find their way back down pretty harshly."
paras.zh: “对于一家公司来说，很难说我们需要缩减任何东西，但更难说我们需要缩减收入，”西格尔说。 “我们经常发现品牌达到了一个高峰，一个健康的高峰，通过强迫它超越高峰，然后又艰难地回落。”

articles.title: Mathematicians marvel, and grumble, at OpenAI’s trove of new results

paras.en: It’s been two days since OpenAI’s “slop drop” of AI-generated results on 372 open math and computer science problems. Scientists are just beginning to parse through the heap and pick out the most exciting breakthroughs in their own fields.
paras.zh: 距离 OpenAI “倾斜”发布 372 个开放数学和计算机科学问题的 AI 生成结果已经过去两天了。科学家们刚刚开始解析这些堆数据，并挑选出自己领域中最令人兴奋的突破。

paras.en: It will be months, perhaps years, before we understand just how much novel mathematics was added to the literature this week, but everyone agrees it’s been a week without precedent. “Yesterday will be the day when a new era of math and mathematical physics began,” Harvard University mathematician Michael Douglas told Scientific American on Tuesday. It was an even bigger moment, he thinks, than last month’s solution of the Navier-Stokes problem, one of math’s million-dollar challenges, by the same new internal model at OpenAI.
paras.zh: 我们需要几个月甚至几年的时间才能了解本周文献中添加了多少新颖的数学，但每个人都同意这是史无前例的一周。 “昨天将是数学和数学物理新时代开始的一天，”哈佛大学数学家迈克尔·道格拉斯周二告诉《科学美国人》。他认为，这比上个月 OpenAI 相同的新内部模型解决纳维-斯托克斯问题（数学百万美元挑战之一）的解决方案更重要。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Already certain aspects of this new era are becoming clear. Many of the results, experts say, are far better written than the Navier-Stokes proof, suggesting that OpenAI’s math team is working to overcome its model’s inability to explain its math clearly to humans. Hector Pasten, a mathematician at the Pontifical Catholic University of Chile, says the papers he’s looked at improve on the company’s notorious lack of citations. “I think they are doing a better job of giving credit,” he says.
paras.zh: 这个新时代的某些方面已经变得清晰起来。专家表示，许多结果比纳维-斯托克斯证明要好得多，这表明 OpenAI 的数学团队正在努力克服其模型无法向人类清楚解释数学的问题。智利天主教大学数学家赫克托·帕斯滕 (Hector Pasten) 表示，他所研究的论文改善了该公司臭名昭著的缺乏引用的问题。 “我认为他们在给予信任方面做得更好，”他说。

paras.en: But the quality remains extremely uneven—mathematicians are finding some papers readable and others utterly nonsensical. “Others are much, much harder to make sense of—they’re sort of this AI slop,” says Roland Bauerschmidt, a mathematician at New York University. “If I had received these by e-mail from a nobody, I probably would have deleted it, it’s so badly written.”
paras.zh: 但质量仍然极其参差不齐——数学家们发现一些论文可读，而另一些则完全毫无意义。纽约大学数学家罗兰·鲍尔施密特 (Roland Bauerschmidt) 表示：“其他的则很难理解——它们有点像人工智能的废话。” “如果我通过电子邮件收到这些，我可能会删除它，它写得太糟糕了。”

paras.en: Even much of that seeming nonsense, though, is ostensibly correct. At this point, 42 percent of the results are coded in the programming language Lean, which means their logic is almost certainly sound, even if their English-language write-up is too hard to follow.
paras.zh: 不过，即使很多看似无稽之谈，表面上也是正确的。此时，42% 的结果是用 Lean 编程语言编码的，这意味着它们的逻辑几乎肯定是正确的，即使它们的英文书写太难以理解。

paras.en: On the other hand, three of the papers have already been withdrawn after experts uncovered a significant error, causing some to question the more than half of the proofs that aren’t yet Lean-verified. “While I expect most of these will ultimately be found to be correct, or at least correctable, we should expect some of the proofs to contain mistakes, possibly serious ones,” says Andrew Sutherland, a mathematician at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
paras.zh: 另一方面，在专家发现一个重大错误后，其中三篇论文已经被撤回，导致一些人对一半以上尚未经过精益验证的证明提出质疑。麻省理工学院数学家安德鲁·萨瑟兰（Andrew Sutherland）表示：“虽然我预计其中大部分最终都会被证明是正确的，或者至少是可以纠正的，但我们应该预料到一些证明会包含错误，甚至可能是严重的错误。”

paras.en: The community’s reaction to the way OpenAI chose to drop the results has been mixed, to say the least. Sutherland argues that OpenAI should also release the problems its model failed to solve, which the company has said number in the thousands. “I expect they will not want to do that,” he adds, “but that is how open science works. You need to report your negative results along with your positive results.”
paras.zh: 至少可以说，社区对 OpenAI 选择放弃结果的方式反应不一。 Sutherland 认为 OpenAI 还应该公布其模型未能解决的问题，该公司称这些问题有数千个。 “我预计他们不会愿意这样做，”他补充道，“但这就是开放科学的运作方式。你需要在报告积极结果的同时报告你的消极结果。”

paras.en: The lack of transparency goes further. A number of mathematicians have told Scientific American that they doubt anyone on OpenAI’s team would have thought to ask some of the questions the model answered, either because they’re extremely niche or because they contradict a belief most experts previously held. Several independently suggested that it seems the model itself is coming up with problems to solve, perhaps in an extended conversation between a swarm of agents. This idea seems corroborated by the fact that a number of papers contain strikingly similar ideas and methods—as if their authors were communicating. OpenAI didn’t reply to a request for comment on this question.
paras.zh: 缺乏透明度的情况更进一步。许多数学家告诉《科学美国人》，他们怀疑 OpenAI 团队中的任何人都会考虑提出该模型所回答的一些问题，要么是因为这些问题非常小众，要么是因为它们与大多数专家之前持有的信念相矛盾。一些人独立地表示，模型本身似乎正在提出需要解决的问题，也许是在一群智能体之间的长时间对话中。许多论文包含惊人相似的想法和方法，这一事实似乎证实了这一观点——就好像它们的作者在交流一样。 OpenAI 没有回复对此问题的置评请求。

paras.en: Others in the community have been more outspoken in their criticism. A statement from the Association for Human Mathematics decries the company’s actions. “Releasing over 700 files at once is not a demonstration of scholarship, but a demonstration of power,” it reads. “We urge mathematicians to discontinue their work with OpenAI and to return to a vision of science that centers human understanding.”
paras.zh: 社区中的其他人则更加直言不讳地提出批评。人类数学协会的一份声明谴责了该公司的行为。 “一次性公布700多个文件不是学术的展示，而是权力的展示，”它写道。 “我们敦促数学家停止与 OpenAI 的合作，回归以人类理解为中心的科学愿景。”

articles.title: The most exciting claims from OpenAI’s heap of new proofs

paras.en: On Tuesday afternoon OpenAI dropped more than 700 manuscripts reporting proofs, solutions and progress on 372 open problems across theoretical research.
paras.zh: 周二下午，OpenAI 发布了 700 多份手稿，报告了理论研究中 372 个开放问题的证明、解决方案和进展。

paras.en: It will take time for mathematicians to trudge through all the artificial-intelligence-generated results. No one, not even OpenAI researchers themselves, has been able to even read through everything yet. And not all of the proofs were certified as correct by the automatic logic verification platform Lean—in fact, some have already been retracted after outside scientists found mistakes. OpenAI also did not include full prompts or run-time details for how their agents uncovered the proofs, and officials admitted in a blog post about the results that citations and written descriptions of findings could be improved in future releases.
paras.zh: 数学家需要时间来研究所有人工智能生成的结果。目前还没有人能够读懂所有内容，甚至包括 OpenAI 研究人员本身。并不是所有的证明都被自动逻辑验证平台 Lean 证明是正确的——事实上，有些证据在外部科学家发现错误后已经被撤回。 OpenAI 也没有提供有关其代理如何发现证据的完整提示或运行时详细信息，官员们在一篇有关结果的博客文章中承认，在未来的版本中可以改进对结果的引用和书面描述。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Despite these issues, experts say the results are jaw-dropping. The papers span mathematics, theoretical computer science, physics, and more. Some of the discoveries could have easily netted a human author a top research award just a year ago
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些问题，专家表示结果还是令人瞠目结舌。这些论文涵盖数学、理论计算机科学、物理学等。就在一年前，其中一些发现可以轻松地为人类作者赢得最高研究奖

paras.en: Here are just some of the most important problems OpenAI claims to have solved, according to the experts.
paras.zh: 专家们表示，以下只是 OpenAI 声称已经解决的一些最重要的问题。

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis is the scariest open problem in math—experts told Scientific American earlier this year that they barely think about it because they have no idea how to even start tackling it. That might have just changed.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想是数学中最可怕的开放性问题——专家们今年早些时候告诉《科学美国人》，他们几乎没有考虑过这个问题，因为他们甚至不知道如何开始解决它。这可能刚刚改变。

paras.en: The hypothesis centers on a special, complicated equation called the Riemann zeta function—specifically, which numbers you can put into this function to make it come out to zero. If you could magically know all of these special inputs, you would essentially know all of the prime numbers—mathematicians’ favorite objects and the building blocks of the entire number line.
paras.zh: 该假设以一个称为黎曼 zeta 函数的特殊复杂方程为中心，具体来说，您可以将哪些数字放入该函数中以使其结果为零。如果你能神奇地知道所有这些特殊输入，你基本上就会知道所有素数——数学家最喜欢的物体和整个数轴的构建块。

paras.en: OpenAI’s drop contains two major results about these “zeros.” One proves the “quasi-Riemann hypothesis,” which is a huge step toward the holy grail of proving the full thing. “Plenty of applications of the Riemann hypothesis did not need the full Riemann hypothesis,” says Hector Pasten, a mathematician at the Pontifical Catholic University of Chile. “The quasi-Riemann hypothesis is way more than enough for many applications.” For instance, mathematicians now have a better estimate of where the primes sit as you go up the number line than they ever had before.
paras.zh: OpenAI 的下降包含有关这些“零”的两个主要结果。有人证明了“准黎曼假设”，这是朝着证明全部事实的圣杯迈出的一大步。 “黎曼假设的大量应用并不需要完整的黎曼假设，”智利天主教大学数学家赫克托·帕斯滕 (Hector Pasten) 说。 “拟黎曼假设对于许多应用来说已经足够了。”例如，数学家现在可以比以前更好地估计沿着数轴上升时素数的位置。

paras.en: As to whether this proof is a path toward solving the full hypothesis, it’s too early to say. “Some people claim it is progress toward Riemann; other people say it’s not,” Pasten says. “Usually the word progress makes sense after the fact, when you see how it eventually gets solved.”
paras.zh: 至于这个证明是否是解决整个假设的一条途径，现在说还为时过早。 “有些人声称这是向黎曼迈进；其他人则说不是，”帕斯滕说。 “通常，当你看到问题最终如何得到解决时，“进步”这个词才有意义。”

paras.en: The second result shows that neither the zeta function nor many of its generalizations, called “Dirichlet L-functions,” have a “Siegel zero,” a certain, especially problematic type of zero that would contradict the hypothesis. “This is not just progress on Siegel zeros—it settles the question,” Pasten says. “This is amazing.”
paras.zh: 第二个结果表明，zeta 函数及其许多推广（称为“狄利克雷 L 函数”）都没有“西格尔零”，这是一种与假设相矛盾的特定的、特别有问题的零类型。 “这不仅仅是西格尔零点的进展——它解决了问题，”帕斯滕说。 “这太棒了。”

paras.en: Hilbert’s 10th problem is about which mathematical truths are and are not knowable. It asks whether it’s possible to build an algorithm that sorts all simple algebra problems into two piles. One pile holds equations that have whole-number solutions, such as y2 = 2x (where x = 2 and y = 2 is a solution). The other pile consists of equations without a solution in which the variables are whole numbers, such as y2 + x2 = –1.
paras.zh: 希尔伯特的第十个问题是关于哪些数学真理是可知的，哪些是不可知的。它询问是否可以构建一种算法，将所有简单的代数问题分为两堆。一堆包含具有整数解的方程，例如 y2 = 2x（其中 x = 2 和 y = 2 是一个解）。另一堆由没有解的方程组成，其中变量是整数，例如 y2 + x2 = –1。

paras.en: In 1970 mathematician Yuri Matiyasevich showed that such an algorithm is impossible. No computer can tell you whether or not any equation has a solution with whole numbers. But since then mathematicians have been struggling to extend this result, asking if a computer can sort equations when you allow their variables to have a wider range of values, such as fractions, square roots or imaginary numbers. OpenAI’s model proved that even when the variables are allowed to be any rational number—a whole number or a fraction—the mathematical world remains unsortable.
paras.zh: 1970 年，数学家 Yuri Matiyasevich 证明这样的算法是不可能的。没有计算机可以告诉你任何方程是否有整数解。但从那时起，数学家们一直在努力扩展这个结果，询问当你允许方程的变量具有更广泛的值（例如分数、平方根或虚数）时，计算机是否可以对方程进行排序。 OpenAI 的模型证明，即使变量可以是任何有理数（整数或分数），数学世界仍然是不可排序的。

paras.en: The new proof uses two of Pasten’s ideas from seemingly different areas of mathematics—even he hadn’t realized they could be put together in this way. “It’s extremely surprising to me that they connect,” Pasten says. “Their general strategy is original.”
paras.zh: 新的证明使用了帕斯滕的两个看似不同的数学领域的想法——即使他也没有意识到它们可以以这种方式组合在一起。 “他们之间的联系让我感到非常惊讶，”帕斯滕说。 “他们的总体策略是原创的。”

paras.en: The Kakeya conjecture can be thought of as sliding and twirling a piece of chalk around on a tablet so that it points in every direction but covers as small an area with chalk as possible. Mathematician Hong Wang won a Fields medal this summer for solving the three-dimensional version of this problem with mathematician Joshua Zahl. In that version, you twirl the stick around in midair—showing the minimum possible 3D space the twirl can occupy. Now OpenAI’s model has solved the problem for four dimensions.
paras.zh: 挂谷猜想可以被认为是在平板电脑上滑动和旋转一块粉笔，使其指向各个方向，但用粉笔覆盖尽可能小的区域。今年夏天，数学家王宏因与数学家约书亚·扎尔 (Joshua Zahl) 一起解决了该问题的三维版本而获得了菲尔兹奖。在该版本中，您在半空中旋转棍子 - 显示旋转可以占据的最小可能的 3D 空间。现在OpenAI的模型已经从四个维度解决了这个问题。

paras.en: Other important number theory results include Artin’s conjecture on primitive roots, which is about special number systems that stop at a certain, highest number, as well as a proof of perhaps the most famous conjecture of storied problem-poser Paul Erdős and progress that is relevant to the Langlands program, a sweeping set of conjectures sometimes called “a Grand Unified Theory of Mathematics.”
paras.zh: 其他重要的数论成果包括阿廷关于原根的猜想，该猜想涉及到停止于某个最高数字的特殊数系，以及对著名问题提出者保罗·埃尔多斯（Paul Erdős）最著名的猜想的证明，以及与朗兰兹纲领相关的进展，朗兰兹纲领是一组广泛的猜想，有时被称为“数学大统一理论”。

paras.en: On its face, the “nonlinear sigma model” doesn’t sound like it has anything to do with particle physics. At every point on a grid, you place an arrow in a different direction to represent interacting, spinning atoms. The goal is to show that rotations of the arrows in one place cannot be detected far away. But that aim bears a striking, hidden resemblance to “the Yang-Mills existence and mass gap problem,” one of the five remaining Millennium Prize Problems, which aims to underpin the “Standard Model” of particle physics with rigorous mathematics. “This goes back 50 years, much like Yang-Mills, and is widely considered the ‘warm-up’ for Yang-Mills,” says Michael Douglas, a mathematical physicist at Harvard University.
paras.zh: 从表面上看，“非线性西格玛模型”听起来与粒子物理学没有任何关系。在网格上的每个点上，您都可以在不同方向上放置一个箭头来代表相互作用、旋转的原子。目标是证明箭头在一处的旋转无法在远处被检测到。但这一目标与“杨-米尔斯存在性和质量间隙问题”有着惊人的、隐藏的相似之处，这是剩下的五个千年奖问题之一，旨在用严格的数学来支撑粒子物理学的“标准模型”。哈佛大学数学物理学家迈克尔·道格拉斯 (Michael Douglas) 表示：“这可以追溯到 50 年前，就像杨米尔斯一样，并且被广泛认为是杨米尔斯的‘热身’。”

paras.en: OpenAI’s repository contains several papers claiming to completely resolve the equivalent of the Yang-Mills problem for this simpler model. New York University mathematician Roland Bauerschmidt says the first of these papers is both groundbreaking and comprehensible. “I haven’t digested it or understood all the details, but it seems very reasonable,” he says. The rest of the papers related to this problem are incomprehensible slop, he says, too hard for even a human expert to verify. “The second paper is horrible,” Bauerschmidt says. “If these results had been sent to me by a nobody, I would have deleted the e-mail.”
paras.zh: OpenAI 的存储库包含几篇论文，声称完全解决了这个更简单模型的 Yang-Mills 问题的等效问题。纽约大学数学家罗兰·鲍尔施密特表示，第一篇论文既具有开创性又易于理解。 “我还没有消化它或理解所有细节，但它看起来非常合理，”他说。他说，与这个问题相关的其余论文都是难以理解的废话，即使是人类专家也难以验证。 “第二篇论文太糟糕了，”鲍尔施密特说。 “如果这些结果是由任何人发送给我的，我就会删除该电子邮件。”

paras.en: Physicists know a strange state of matter called the “Bose-Einstein condensate” is possible because researchers have made it in a lab—winning them the 2001 Nobel Prize in Physics. This material is where all the atoms in a gas occupy the exact same quantum state, producing weird quantum effects at unusually macroscopic scales. Albert Einstein originally predicted its existence in work that built upon a 1924 paper by physicist Satyendra Nath Bose, but he only proved that the state is mathematically possible for an unrealistic gas where no two atoms interact. OpenAI’s model extended the prediction to a case with interactions. It used similar techniques to prove a major conjecture about the math of ferromagnetism—one that the famous mathematical physicist Freeman Dyson erroneously claimed with two collaborators in 1976.
paras.zh: 物理学家知道一种被称为“玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚”的奇怪物质状态是可能存在的，因为研究人员已经在实验室中实现了这种状态，并为他们赢得了 2001 年诺贝尔物理学奖。在这种材料中，气体中的所有原子都占据完全相同的量子态，在异常宏观尺度上产生奇怪的量子效应。阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦最初在物理学家 Satyendra Nath Bose 1924 年发表的论文基础上预测了这种状态的存在，但他只是证明了对于没有两个原子相互作用的不切实际的气体来说，这种状态在数学上是可能的。 OpenAI 的模型将预测扩展到具有交互的案例。它使用类似的技术来证明一个关于铁磁性数学的重大猜想——著名数学物理学家弗里曼·戴森 (Freeman Dyson) 与两名合作者在 1976 年错误地提出了这个猜想。

paras.en: Anyone who's taken a linear algebra course can attest that matrices—ensembles of numbers in a two-dimensional array—underpin many different fields of computer science. Manipulating and performing operations on them quickly is important for computer graphics, complex simulations and machine learning itself. “Matrix multiplication is needed all over the place," says Virginia Vassilevska Williams, a computer science professor at MIT who researches the problem. "But also, its complexity is one of the great mysteries in computer science." Multiplying two matrices together requires a tedious amount of arithmetic.
paras.zh: 任何学习过线性代数课程的人都可以证明矩阵（二维数组中的数字集合）是计算机科学许多不同领域的基础。快速操纵和执行它们对于计算机图形、复杂模拟和机器学习本身非常重要。 “到处都需要矩阵乘法，”研究这个问题的麻省理工学院计算机科学教授 Virginia Vassilevska Williams 说。 “而且，它的复杂性也是计算机科学中最大的谜团之一。”将两个矩阵相乘需要大量繁琐的算术。

paras.en: The number of mathematical operations it takes to do these matrix multiplications scales with the cube of the length of the matrices. Scientists have sought a way to shrink the size of the exponent. If they had to do fewer than a cube of the length, it could mean exponential time savings. A few years ago, Vassilevska Williams and her colleagues had gotten that exponent down from 3 to around 2.37, the lowest ever achieved. Problem 107 claims a new lowest boundof 9⁄4, or 2.25. Paper 109 supposedly uses similar methods to find new, faster ways to multiply integers together, too. “In a maybe diabolical sense, the advance on matrix multiplication can be seen as an attempt by the LLMs to speed themselves up," Vassilevska Williams says.
paras.zh: 进行这些矩阵乘法所需的数学运算数量与矩阵长度的立方成正比。科学家们正在寻找一种缩小指数大小的方法。如果他们必须做的长度少于立方体，则可能意味着指数级的时间节省。几年前，Vassilevska Williams 和她的同事将该指数从 3 降至 2.37 左右，这是有史以来达到的最低值。问题 107 声称新的最低界限为 9⁄4，即 2.25。 Paper 109 据称也使用类似的方法来寻找新的、更快的整数相乘方法。 “从某种意义上来说，矩阵乘法的进步可以被视为法学硕士为加快自己的速度而做出的尝试，”Vassilevska Williams 说。

paras.en: If algorithms research is about the best ways to solve problems, complexity theory asks the reverse: How hard is it to find the best solutions to problems—the ideal algorithms that can’t be beat? This challenge involves thinking about what kinds of resources a computer has at its disposal and asking which resources let one solve more problems. A classic quandary about problems computers can solve called P versus NP, likely one of the hardest of the Millenium Prize Problems, is perhaps the most famous complexity problem.
paras.zh: 如果算法研究是关于解决问题的最佳方法，那么复杂性理论则提出了相反的问题：找到问题的最佳解决方案（不可击败的理想算法）有多难？这一挑战涉及思考计算机可以使用哪些类型的资源，并询问哪些资源可以让人们解决更多问题。关于计算机可以解决的问题的经典难题称为 P 与 NP，这可能是千年奖问题中最难的问题之一，也可能是最著名的复杂性问题。

paras.en: A key to both algorithms and complexity is asking how the solution or problem scales with the size of its input. For example, in the case of multiplication, researchers would want to know not just the best way to multiply two 100-digit numbers but how long it takes to multiply numbers of any size as a function of how many digits they have.
paras.zh: 算法和复杂性的关键是询问解决方案或问题如何随着输入的大小而扩展。例如，在乘法的情况下，研究人员不仅想知道两个 100 位数字相乘的最佳方法，还想知道将任意大小的数字相乘需要多长时间，作为数字位数的函数。

paras.en: L, also known as LOGSPACE, is the complexity class of problems that can be answered with very little space—logarithmic in the size of the problem’s description. RL and BPL, meanwhile, are randomized versions of LOGSPACE in which the computer can harness randomness and only needs to be right most of the time. Proving that L = RL = BPL, as Problem 103 claims to do, shows that every problem of this type that can be done with randomness can also be done without it, known as derandomization.
paras.zh: L，也称为 LOGSPACE，是可以用非常小的空间（问题描述的大小的对数）来回答的问题的复杂性类别。与此同时，RL 和 BPL 是 LOGSPACE 的随机版本，其中计算机可以利用随机性，并且只需要在大多数时间都是正确的。正如问题 103 声称的那样，证明 L = RL = BPL 表明，可以使用随机性完成的此类问题也可以在没有随机性的情况下完成，称为去随机化。

paras.en: In practice, computer programs use randomness all the time, but many researchers think it probably doesn’t speed up algorithms. “We have strong reasons to believe that, but we don’t know how to prove it,” says Ran Raz, a complexity theorist at Princeton University. While there was evidence that L = RL was likely to be true, proving it directly has been elusive until now. “I didn’t see any directions that were promising [before],” Raz says.
paras.zh: 在实践中，计算机程序一直在使用随机性，但许多研究人员认为它可能不会加快算法速度。 “我们有充分的理由相信这一点，但我们不知道如何证明这一点，”普林斯顿大学复杂性理论家兰·拉兹说。虽然有证据表明 L = RL 可能是正确的，但迄今为止直接证明这一点还很难。 “（之前）我没有看到任何有希望的方向，”拉兹说。

paras.en: The unique games conjecture also falls under complexity theory. First pitched in 2002, it implicitly asks how hard it is, given a set of constraints, to satisfy some portion of them. Here the resource under the microscope is approximation—that is, instead of getting an exactly correct answer to a given problem, the computer only needs to get close to the answer. Although the unique games problem isn’t explicitly about approximation, showing that it’s difficult would imply that finding approximate answers to many problems is as hard as finding the answer directly.
paras.zh: 独特博弈猜想也属于复杂性理论的范畴。它于 2002 年首次提出，含蓄地询问了在给定一组约束的情况下满足其中某些约束有多难。这里显微镜下的资源是近似值——也就是说，计算机不需要得到给定问题的完全正确的答案，而只需接近答案即可。尽管独特的游戏问题没有明确地涉及近似，但表明它很困难意味着找到许多问题的近似答案与直接找到答案一样困难。

paras.en: Problem 102 claims to do just that, proving that the unique games problem is hard. This solution has been a bit controversial. Other researchers who had caught wind of OpenAI’s work on the problem rushed out their partial progress toward the answer in fear of being scooped by AI.
paras.zh: 问题 102 声称可以做到这一点，证明独特的博弈问题是困难的。这个解决方案引起了一些争议。其他听说了 OpenAI 在这个问题上的研究成果的研究人员担心被 AI 抢先，因此急忙拿出部分进展来寻找答案。

paras.en: Over in the land of quantum computing, meanwhile, Problem 283 could give a better picture at how difficult truly quantum problems are. Scientists understand how bits in a classical computer work and can be manipulated, but they have less of a handle on quantum computing’s analogue to the classical bit, the qubit.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在量子计算领域，问题 283 可以更好地说明真正的量子问题有多么困难。科学家们了解经典计算机中的位是如何工作和操作的，但他们对量子计算与经典位的类似物——量子位——的了解较少。

paras.en: The unitary synthesis problem was first posed by researchers Scott Aaronson and Greg Kuperberg in 2006. It tries to relate working with qubits to working with bits. In this case, OpenAI showed that for any manipulation of a quantum state of qubits—called a unitary—they can build a quantum circuit and a problem dealing with only classical bits such that the circuit and problem can be used to calculate these manipulations, i.e., it can “synthesize” that unitary. Importantly, this solution gives some evidence that hard quantum problems may not be that much harder than hard classical problems, a surprising result that was not clear to researchers in the field before now.
paras.zh: 酉合成问题最初由研究人员 Scott Aaronson 和 Greg Kuperberg 于 2006 年提出。它试图将量子比特的工作与比特的工作联系起来。在这种情况下，OpenAI 表明，对于量子位的量子态（称为酉）的任何操作，他们都可以构建一个量子电路和一个仅处理经典位的问题，这样电路和问题就可以用于计算这些操作，即它可以“合成”该酉。重要的是，这个解决方案提供了一些证据，表明硬量子问题可能并不比硬经典问题难多少，这是一个令人惊讶的结果，该领域的研究人员此前并不清楚。

paras.en: The Fast Fourier Transform, an algorithm whose discovery dates back to 1965, is crucial to the Internet and other forms of digital communications. In many applications, including the Web and medical scans, it converts information received from signals into actual machine-usable frequency data. The transform works by summing a bunch of signals and multiplying each by a special exponential factor. Although brute forcing these multiplications takes quadratic time (the time is proportional to the square of the number of signals), the “fast” protocol takes about n log n time(where n is the number of signals received), which is fast enough to use for things like the Internet.
paras.zh: 快速傅里叶变换是一种算法，其发现可以追溯到 1965 年，它对于互联网和其他形式的数字通信至关重要。在许多应用中，包括网络和医疗扫描，它将从信号接收到的信息转换为实际机器可用的频率数据。该变换的工作原理是对一堆信号求和并将每个信号乘以一个特殊的指数因子。虽然暴力破解这些乘法需要二次时间（时间与信号数量的平方成正比），但“快速”协议大约需要 n log n 时间（其中 n 是接收到的信号数量），这足够快，足以用于互联网等事物。

paras.en: Paper 130 claims to reduce this n log n time to ... n (log n)0.999....Specifically, the model got it down from a factor of log n to a factor of (log n)^1–10–13, a tiny improvement over the state of the art. On an objective level, this is so close to n log n that the distinction almost doesn’t matter. It does break a longstanding barrier to digital communications, however, and many researchers hope that by studying the proof techniques used, they could one day find a Faster Fourier Transform.
paras.zh: 第 130 篇论文声称将这个 n log n 时间减少到...n (log n)0.999...具体来说，该模型将其从 log n 因子降低到 (log n)^1–10–13 因子，这比现有技术有了微小的改进。从客观角度来看，这非常接近 n log n，以至于区别几乎不重要。然而，它确实打破了数字通信的长期障碍，许多研究人员希望通过研究所使用的证明技术，他们有一天可以找到一种更快的傅里叶变换。

articles.title: Could Tutankhamun's tomb hold clues to a mysterious Egyptian queen?

paras.en: A growing body of research is generating renewed interest in potential hidden spaces beyond the decorated walls of Tutankhamun’s burial chamber in Egypt.
paras.zh: 越来越多的研究对埃及图坦卡蒙墓室装饰墙壁之外的潜在隐藏空间产生了新的兴趣。

paras.en: Some researchers have raised the possibility that these concealed chambers—if they exist—could contain the burial place of Nefertiti, Tutankhamun’s stepmother and mother-in-law. Nefertiti was made famous by a remarkable painted bust of her head found in Tell-el Amarna, Egypt, in 1912.
paras.zh: 一些研究人员提出了这样的可能性：这些隐蔽的墓室（如果存在的话）可能埋葬着图坦卡蒙的继母和岳母纳芙蒂蒂。 1912 年，在埃及泰勒阿玛纳发现了一座引人注目的彩绘半身像，奈费尔蒂蒂 (Nefertiti) 因而名声大噪。
